name: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Paradise Las Vegas

reviews.title: Excellent property
reviews.text: All around great property, clean, helpful courteous staff, I would definitly visit again and recommend to friends

reviews.title: Large room, and clean!
reviews.text: This hotel was very clean and quiet. The room was large and updated. The bed was very comfortable. Easy access to the Monorail. We practically had the pool to ourselves one morning! Overall, a great stay, and I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Better Hilton’s in the area at a lower cost
reviews.text: I stayed at the Hilton at resorts world which I enjoyed a lot but we transferred to this hotel which didn’t have any Hilton benefits as a HHONORS gold member. That is quite a disappointment and the hotel charges a resort fee for what? A pool that looks like a prison with a view on a car park. I guess I didn’t get the concept. We didn’t have breakfast at the hotel but it didn’t look that fantastic.The price was higher than the other better Hilton so that’s what I will opt for next time as the hotel could use a refresh too.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Paradise Las Vegas
reviews.text: Stay was excellent- the 2 bedroom apartment was very comfortable, very well maintained & well equipped. Hotel is a little far from the Strip so the easiest way there  is to take a cab. Not much of amenities - so Resort fee not justified. But as an RCI resort it is very good value for money.Also, the Grocery store at the Resort rather expensive so better to order online.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Loved our resort!!  Beds very comfortable, staff friendly and helpful, added bonus was free bottles of water!!  Only downside was the hot tub's heater was broken, so we didn't get to enjoy that, but the pool was wonderful!  Was within a 4 minute walk to a Monorail station!!  Will definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Convenient for conventions held at the Las Vegas Convention Center.
reviews.text: It was very convenient for us since I was in town for an Expo held at the LV Convention Center. I stay there every 3 years.

reviews.title: Vegas Oct, 2025
reviews.text: Had an excellent time staying at the HGV Paradise. Resort was clean and provided everything we needed for a great stay. Going in October was a great move because the weather was perfect. Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel
reviews.text: I had originally left a negative review because of improper fines I received from parking garage. However, after receiving call from Executive Ambassador Donna B, I have changed my review to a more accurate review. As for the parking issue Donna handled it without decency, respect, and most importantly, professionalism. Tho hotel was clean, quiet, and our suite was excellent. Staff was friendly, helpful. They are very close to the monorail. All in all I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Clean Hotel, No Frills
reviews.text: This venue is new to the Hilton Grand Vacation Club.  They are still making modifications.  It is not a large property. Although, there is a closed unused outdoor parking lot I'm guessing they will use that to expand the space.  The hotel is very clean. It is suited for families and larger guest parties. It's away from the strip (near the Stratosphere), so consider that when making your travel plans. There is a 24 hour gym. The pool is not that large, but big enough and there is a jacuzzi. There is a lifeguard on duty. Lots of lounge chairs for sunbathing. There's a grill and outdoor couches with a flat screen television for everyone to use. Like most of the Hilton vacation venues there is the Marketplace that sells cold and hot food, breakfast and lunch, even Starbucks coffee. Complementary free parking in a parking structure. No need for tickets. It scans your license plate. You can catch the monorail at The Westgate. It's a little bit of a walk, but doable. I received complimentary bottled water and 3 additional water vouchers.  I had a 1 bedroom suite. All the vacation venues include a washer/dryer, full kitchen (fridge, microwave, dishwasher, oven, cutlery, pots, pans, etc), living/dining area. It was very spacious, & again, clean. The television guide wasn't working to show you what was on, but the hotel said they were working on that function. You can call if you had any concerns & also communicate via text. They were very punctual in response time. Check out is fast and easy. There are no casinos, restaurants or bars at this venue. Again, they are still making modifications to this venue. I don't know if that is in the plans for a future date. There are 2 lounge areas. One of them, has billard and foosball table, and a small arcade.

reviews.title: Fees
reviews.text: Watch out for daily resort fees and taxes!  Nothing special here that would justify the fees and taxes.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay.
reviews.text: Lovely, spacious and comfortable two-bedroom suite included a full kitchen and dining area, spacious living room and three great beds.

reviews.title: Great Weekend Stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for the weekend and upgraded to the king suite. Was surprised how spacious it was with big living room space and kitchen. Love the fact that it has washer and dryer. It's really close to Westgate, and convention center. The pool was never too crowded and always has chairs available. The only complaint would be if you are light sleeper, installation is not that good. You can hear toilet flashing, people turning on the sink and footsteps from above. Check in was a breeze and overall would def. return for the convenience of the kitchen and other amenities.

reviews.title: Great Place - Short Walk From Monorail
reviews.text: Didn’t really want to stay north of the strip, but I gave it a short.Room was big (had a one bedroom suite with adjoining two bedroom room) and clean. They have a marketplace downstairs if you are missing anything.They didn’t offer me a timeshare meeting because my wife wasn’t with me, I honestly was just interested in pricing.I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Greatest Place to stay
reviews.text: So laid back and easy to vacation here. My wife and I are having a very nice time simply doing a Staycation at The Hilton on Paradise

reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: Close to the strip. On the edge of the safe area to walk. Close to 2 monorail stations. Garage could use cameras. A guy was peeing at the third floor elevator entrance one morning when I went to the car. Luckily I was taking the stairs.

reviews.title: No communication
reviews.text: I booked a seven day vacation since Dec 2024. Checked in May 2025. The resort was under construction, which no one notified me. There was no pool, amenities were missing/lacking. This was Las Vegas 90+degrees weather. They insisted on charging a resort fee even though I am an Owner. It was far away from the strip and cost a lot of money for Uber.

reviews.title: Pool is closed for renovation
reviews.text: The staff at this resort was friendly and helpful. Check in took a while, There are a maximum of 3 clerks and we arrived around 6pm on a Friday and there was a wait. When we arrived we found out that the entire pool area was closed for renovation. No pool and no hot tub in May in Vegas. Not good. The rooms have been refreshed, but there is very little drawer space in the large one bedroom. The closet is small because they put in a bench and mirror. (?) No dressers, there are shelves. The outlets in the nightstand are great, until you knock over your water in the middle of the night, then they are a fire hazard. The outlets should be on the wall like they were at the refreshed MGM Grand rooms.

reviews.title: Vegas Girls TRip
reviews.text: Hilton Grand is a very nice property.  five minute walk to the tram that takes you along the whole strip. For a decent fee you can ride the tram 24 hrs.  easy like a hop on hop off.  The condo is great two bedrooms and privacy for both.  WIll definitely go back

reviews.title: Off the strip quiet
reviews.text: Clean and quiet.  Monorail station nearby.  Uber friendly. BBQ grills were nice and clean. Key card to use the elevator.  Pool under construction.

reviews.title: Charged for demolished pool
reviews.text: We were charged a resort fee for the privilege of watching workers demolish the pool.  We had a late airline departure and had planned to laze by the pool before leaving. Not to be.  They said we could traipse down to the Westgate and use their pool.  Lame.

reviews.title: Charged for demolished pool
reviews.text: We were charged a resort fee for the privilege of watching workers demolish the pool.  We had a late airline departure and had planned to laze by the pool before leaving. Not to be.  They said we could traipse down to the Westgate and use their pool.  Lame.

reviews.title: Hilton doesn’t disappoint
reviews.text: We stayed here April 27- May 1 of 2025 the location is nice and parking is free for guests. Checking in, we got greeted and the staff were attentive and sweet. We stayed in the one bedroom suite. It has a washer and dryer, bathtub, walk in shower, double vanity, a tv in the bedroom and one in the living area, pull out couch, & a kitchen etc. The king size bed is comfortable and clean and the pillows are fluffy and comfortable. The room itself was clean. The AC worked great. They have a store down stairs with all the essentials you need. They also have a game room down stairs. I  always try to stay with Hilton and I have to say, they never disappoint. Thank you Hilton, Pabla J M

reviews.title: we weren't that impressed
reviews.text: We never felt unsafe at this hotel, as some recent reviews have said.However we were really peed off that the pool was closed when it stated on our booking that it would be open start of April. BS, it looks like its going to be closed for the forceable future.When we complained they really couldn't care less. pointing out that you can use another resort pool, some 15 minutes walk away.. yea right!Hotel is in need of renovating, it looks tired and worn.Resort charge of $25 per day + tax is a complete rip off. you get nothing except 2 small bottles of water a day, which they use to justify charging you.The only thing 'Hilton' about this hotel is its name, not the standard you would expect.

reviews.title: Not a Gold Crown - Choose another Property
reviews.text: There are several issues with this Time Share -1. It needs renovation - it is not a Gold Crown2. There is not enough security as street people have access to the property.3. The pool is undergoing renovation and it is not noted on their website.4. The parking garage is dirty.5. The plumbing has issues.

reviews.title: Clean hotel but felt unsafe
reviews.text: My daughter and I recently stayed at this hotel while on vacation visiting from Hawaii.  The first night we checked in our hotel room was robbed while we were out at a show.  I believe it was the staff because whoever went into the room would have had access to a key card.  They took my wallet which had money, my daughters air Pods, and a birthday card that had cash in it.  Luckily I had my license and debit card with me while at the show so we could fly back home to Hawaii.  When I reported it to security and the RM they didn't seem to care, even after I showed them that my credit cards had fraudulent charges on it at a nearby Target and liquor stores.  After waiting a couple weeks they denied any claims saying that they're not responsible for things taken in your room.  Please be careful when staying here at this specific location. Use the safe for any valuables.  There are no cameras at all in the hallways or anywhere on the premises.  Also, the pool is under construction.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend staying at this hotel. Service was excellent. Close by to the monorail and easy access to a parking garage right next door. Rooms have been recently upgraded.

reviews.title: Awesome Stay!
reviews.text: It's always a pleasant stay and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The location is close to the LV monorail and it's easy to navigate the property. We've come to this location twice now and will definitely return.

reviews.title: The pool was shut down, but still charged the resort fee!!!
reviews.text: The place was OK and it was a decent location, but even though we were up on the 15th floor, we could still hear traffic from down below which I was surprised about. The other thing that really bothered us is that they charged us a resort fee for each day we were there even though we booked through RCI and the pool was shut down the whole time we were there!!  What kind of resort has no pool. Exceptionally disappointed in the way Hilton handled this which would make me not want to stay at one of their other resorts as well.

reviews.title: Terrible Service and Room Issues
reviews.text: Bad service from Lee Ann. There were couple issue with my room a plastic thing fell off in the shower, drawer was broke, pool area not available due to renovations and bad customer service. As owner I have never had bad service from Hilton hotel, but then again I am used to staying at 5 star hotels opposed to 4 star. There is no bar, restaurant, or casino. I will not return and do not recommend. I would recommend staying at Wynn or Trump Hotel as they gave me exceptional service the last time I was in town and if I needed anything they were there to help.

reviews.title: Long-Term Business Comfort
reviews.text: I’m thoroughly enjoying my long‐term stay in the King Suite at Hilton Grand Vacations Club Paradise Las Vegas. The suite is spacious, clean, and perfectly suited for a business traveler—with a well-equipped kitchenette and all the essentials. The location is ideal: quiet yet only a short walk to the monorail and nearby attractions, making it easy to explore the area. The hotel staff are exceptionally respectful and professional, which makes every interaction pleasant. Just a heads-up—there’s no complimentary breakfast offered, the gym is available, and the swimming pool is currently under renovation. Overall, it’s a great home base for a long-term business stay.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Near the north end of the Vegas strip.  10 minutes walk to the Deuce bus stop and 5 minutes to Bus stop for Route 108. Close to monorail as well.  Very spacious and clean one bedroom apartment.  Big kitchen stove and dishwasher,  washing machine and dryer and bath. Nice and quiet room. 24 hour reception,  and there is a cafe/ small convenience store on site, as well as gym, business lounge, pool and activities room.  What else can you ask for!

reviews.title: Great family Vacation
reviews.text: Great location for the family as it is off the strip but close to the monorail, which we used daily to get to the strip. Beautiful accommodations and loved having a full kitchen to make breakfast and lunch in. The room was spacious and tons of natural light from the big windows. We felt very safe as key card access was needed at all doors.

reviews.title: Good location & spacious rooms
reviews.text: The rooms were spacious, and the resort is close to the Las Vegas strip.  The staff was friendly and helpful. There is a deli on site for your basic needs. There are no restaurants or convenience stores nearby, but food delivery was convenient. We had a good time and would definitely come back.

reviews.title: Felt like a small hotel
reviews.text: The two bedroom unit felt too small compared to others in the area. The bathroom could barely fit one person in it let alone two or a family if needed. There is no room if planning on hanging out in the room between things you are doing. The amenities served their purpose and I would really only recommend this location if you are doing something at the convention center. The staff was friend and great, but we were just unhappy with the size of the unit we were given.

reviews.title: VEGAS GEM
reviews.text: Our 2 bedroom unit was clean and well-stocked for our needs. Beds and pillows were comfortable. Resort is well-maintained and clean.  Has a convenience store that serves Starbucks. We like the location which is right in between the Strip and Fremont. It's 30 minutes from Red Rock Canyon and an hour from Valley of Fire, where we enjoyed doing our hikes. This is the 3rd time we've been to this resort and we will be back. Staff is also friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Comfortable and in a great location
reviews.text: Our studio unit had been recently updated and the place was immaculate. Bed was very comfy, and the resort is very conveniently located for what we came to do. We would come back.  Be aware that the studio units are really hotel rooms.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent hotel in Las Vegas. Very hospitaliy, friendly and family! We enjoyed a lot our vacation there.

reviews.title: Excellent Holiday Stay
reviews.text: We had a great experience at the Hilton Grand Vacations Paradise. I was a bit anxious that we would be far from the "action" of the strip, but honestly, it was walkable to strip hotels and the monorail (we did have a car which made it even easier to get around). The rooms were super clean and the common areas were well kept. All of the staff we interacted with were exceptional, and really did go above and beyond to try and help when my daughter was dealing with overnight ear pain. The pool was open (shockingly!) and there is also a gym and minimart on site. Parking is free and close (shared with the Westgate to give you a sense of how close the hotels are)Overall a great option if you would like to have laundry and kitchen facilities but also be close to the Strip and other sites of Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Christmas week stay
reviews.text: This is a wonderful retreat location if you are staying in Las Vegas with a family (stayed over Christmas week)Pros:- Walking distance to Monorail (5min)- Quiet environment (no casino at hotel)- Big, spacious and clean room for a family of 4- Outstanding service! Every staff we interacted with were prompt, courteous and professional (from the service desk - Jose/Ryan to the maintenance staff - Richard)Cons:- Living room shared wall does not prevent the sound coming from next door TV if you have a noisy neighborI would definitely consider staying again if visiting Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Our 3 night stay was overall positive. The only issue we had was that one morning we had no hot water. Apparently they had a boiler down.

reviews.title: Other hotels & locations are MUCH better
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Always 5 Stars
reviews.text: Everything was superb especially customer service and attention to detail in the room. The location  being near the monorail is a significant bonus. Thank you!

reviews.title: Enjoyed Our Stay!
reviews.text: The one-bedroom unit was newly updated and spacious.  The kitchen was conveniently arranged.  It is off the strip but we could walk to the Sahara and Westgate casinos, probably others in the area.  The Marketplace has some food, breakfast sandwiches, BBQ, pizza etc. along with salads, muffins, pastries etc.

reviews.title: Best Family Resort!
reviews.text: My second time here but this time, it's with my family of four. I got the two bedroom, and the layout is the best for with kids since they each of a queen size bed to themselves while my hubby and I got the king size bed. Customer service is one of the best I've received in comparison to other resorts I've visited. It does compensate for the distance from the Strip; however, it's not far off from a monorail station, LV Convention Centre and next to another great resort (Westgate) which gives you all the missing thing (casino, restaurant, fun zone, etc.). We always rent a car, and this resort gives the best easy access to coming/going with lots of parking availabilities.

reviews.title: Perfect place for Las Vegas stay! Quiet and classy!
reviews.text: I cannot recommend this place enough! The suite is clean and beautiful, and they have thought of everything to make your stay comfortable down to the smallest detail. Parking is free and you’re within walking distance of the Strip and other attractions, and right on the Tram path. Service is excellent. I love the huge bathtub. Wonderful place to stay, we are here a week and love it.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: I stayed here for three nights in order to attend When We Were Young Festival. I traveled from abroad for the event, so practicality was a priority. The hotel is located close to the Las Vegas Festival Grounds, you can easily (as easy as huge crosswalks can work in America, the outskirts of the Strip and the not very walkable) to the site.I got the “smallest” suite I could, since I was by myself, that ended up being the one with the king bed. The room was huge. Fully equipped kitchen, dining table, living room, spacious bedroom and bathroom with a shower, and a separate space for bathtub. I did not use most amenities of the hotel (such as the pool), but I was very grateful they have a big marketplace near the lobby. I was able to buy groceries and ready to eat food - it made a huge difference to get back to my room after a 12+ hour day at a music festival and have food in the kitchen ready.I also recommend staying here to keep away from the chaos of the Las Vegas Strip and all that comes with it. Even if you enjoy the partying (which I don’t), you’ll be glad to have some peace and quiet.

reviews.title: The worst sound insulation of any Hilton I have ever stayed in
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is in a fairly otherwise empty area of the north east of the strip a few blocks from the Stratosphere, adjacent to the Car Park of the Westgate Casino, which gives easy access to the Vegas Monorail - by far the easiest way of travelling up and down the  strip. The rooms are kitted with mini kitchens and are clean and compact. There's minimum facilities on site - a pool and a small convenience store is the limit. The massive negative with this hotel is the sound insulation, of which there is practically none. I was woken multiple times by other patrons either in the corridor outside or in the room next door. The walls are paper thin to the point I could hear every morning alarm, every conversation, every phone call from the neighbours room. I could even tell which TV programmes they were watching. When you are there for business and your neighbours are excitable millennials enjoying "Vegas, baby!!!!!" this is obviously not ideal. No chance I would ever stay here again.

reviews.title: This was our first visit to this resort.  It was great, absolutely no hassles.   Close enough to the strip to walk, far enough a
reviews.text: This was our first visit to this resort.  It was great, absolutely no hassles.   Close enough to the strip to walk, far enough a

reviews.title: Excellent Property!
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. Property is beautiful and newly renovated. The rooms are spacious and clean.

reviews.title: Beautiful & Relaxing
reviews.text: Beautiful property, very clean, well laid out suits.  Clean and quiet.  Great location not too far from the strip, small grocery store on the property.  They provided two complimentary bottled waters for each of our stays. I look forward to staying at this property on my next to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Outstanding Resort
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this resort. The location is a wonderful place to return to at night away from the hustle and bustle of the strip. The proximity to the monorail makes it an ideal location. I travel to this resort every year with girlfriends for a week long getaway. The property is kept spotless inside and out. The pool is an awesome place to hang out for the day and the lifeguards are always attentive. We appreciate the resort providing the towels for the pool. Take advantage of the market if you are craving some tasty pastries or coffee. The beds are the most comfortable and they lend themselves to a great night's sleep. Every employee you interact with is pleasant and professional and we look forward to being here again next year. If deciding where to stay I highly recommend you choose this resort.

reviews.title: Great location and fantastic experience!
reviews.text: Was absolutely amazed at the accommodations, cleanliness, and personable attention regarding this facility!

reviews.title: LV stay
reviews.text: Its be second time spending the week it's quiet and very kind hotel staff and to add the manager Ryan was wonderful always willing to make sure your stay is great. What would have been great if the pool would stay open until 10 pm not closing at 6pm.

reviews.title: Great Resort, Highly Recommend
reviews.text: Very clean ,well maintained Resort! Friendly Staff!close proximity to the Las Vegas Strip.The duration of my stay was 7 days.Great  Amenities, suitable for the entire family.

reviews.title: Great room/ suite
reviews.text: Outstanding room, super clean, full kitchen, laundry, bath and show. Highly recommend for anyone looking for accommodation close to the convention centre or just don’t want to be located on the strip. Short walk to the monorail. Rooms cleaned daily- which if you are from Australia is no longer a given at many hotels.

reviews.title: Away from the main strip, due to construction hard to get to, parking a hassle.
reviews.text: Stayed for one night- rooms not as large as the other HGVC properties in Las Vegas.  Because of construction, the easy entrance from the Westgate side is closed and you have to circle around to find it, poorly marked and no directions.  Parking is all the way around to the Westin. Convenient to the Westin and the monorail, but not really close to anywhere else on the strip.  Elara/Flamingo properties easier to get to, on the strip and have larger suites.

reviews.title: Could have easily been 5 star, but ...
reviews.text: Check in was hard work. Didn't want a room on a low floor by the road (I'm a late sleeper), and it was s struggle to convince the check in representative to assign me a more suitable room. She made me feel like I was asking for her first born, even telling me they were fully booked, when I know that was not the case as I could reserve multiple rooms via the Hilton app. Location for the monorail (getting around the strip) and the convention center (15 min walk through the Westgate hotel) is VERY good. My room felt like it had been refurbished in the last couple of years, and was perfect. Everything was new(er), the bed/pillows were comfortable and the A/C & Wifi worked flawlessly. Without the check in hassle/attitude, this would have been perfect.

reviews.title: Ideal Vegas Getaway!
reviews.text: The location was perfect! It was close to The Strip, easy to access to Fremont Street and Downtown Outlet Store shopping.  Walking distance is the Westgate Casino, The hotel was modern and clean.  The mini kitchen was well stocked. The pool was nice sized. I would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: Unexpected Pleasure
reviews.text: Everything at this Hilton Grand Vacation was magnificent!!! We were pleasantly surprised with everything this stay offered us; location, cleanliness, renovated, wonderful service. We highly recommend a stay here!

reviews.title: Bed bugs
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Hilton (08/28-08/29). I was supposed to stay longer, but we found bugs on the bed. I informed the front desk, and they sent security to the room (#1123). I showed him the bag of bugs that we had found on the bed where my daughter was sleeping. He said that they indeed looked like bed bugs. They informed us that they were going to have an inspector check the room. We had to leave all our stuff there and were not able to bring anything out of the room until the inspector confirmed what kind of bugs were on the bed. After about nine hours, the manager called us back and informed us that the inspection was complete. The manager told us that the front desk would have the report, letting us know what kind of bugs were on the bed.After returning to the hotel, we requested the report, and they provided it to us. The report stated that there were bugs found in the room. When I asked what kind of bugs were found on the bed, they were unable to provide that information. They insinuated that the bugs in the room were from outside and had wings. I showed them the picture of the bug I had taken, and it did not have wings. I asked if they had requested the inspector to inspect the bugs in the room because the report did not mention anything about those bugs. The report only stated that the room had no bed bugs. The head of security did not have an answer for us and insisted that we were the ones who brought the bugs into the room, which we did not. He then started giving us a bad attitude. When I requested a refund because we no longer felt comfortable staying at the hotel due to the way we were treated, the front desk clerk said she would check us out with a refund for the day and asked us to get our belongings from the room. However, when we returned, she was no longer there, and another front desk clerk informed us that she had left for her break. I asked Hope at the front desk how long it would take for her to come back because she was going to help us. Hope said she did not know. We waited for about half an hour, and she had not returned. We ended up leaving to check in at another hotel. I asked Hope to have the front desk lead give us a call back when she returned. After four hours, I still did not get a call back. I called the hotel again, and Hope answered. I asked if she was back, and she said she would transfer me. When I was transferred, it was to voicemail. I hung up and called again, but once more, I was transferred to voicemail. I called again and was able to speak to the front desk lead, and she informed us that they were not going to give us any refund.I had uploaded the pictures of bugs that we found on the bed. So you guys can look for yourself how the bugs look like. Do your research. Looks like bed bugs to

reviews.title: Great Location and Beautiful Units
reviews.text: Everything from start to finish was great... even when we had a small issue they came and took care of it immediately. The units were beautiful and the hotel staff did everything possible to meet our requests.

reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text: Our family traded a timeshare for a week at the Hilton Grand Vacation Paradise. While the paradise part better reflects the location (off Paradise Avenue) versus a veritable resort oasis, the vacation club exceeded our expectations. Here are the top ten things to know about the “Paradise”:1.	Room renovations are ongoing, and the renovated rooms are superb. Everything has been updated and upgraded. However, growing pains are part and parcel to change. The television system was glitchy, and we needed an engineer to reset it. The dishwasher was finicky, and it also needed a reset to start the job. And the air conditioning vent – quieter than most – still rattled. Nevertheless, the suites launch this vacation property into a new tier.2.	Rooms facing the west and south have eye-catching strip views. East-facing rooms offer mountain and plane (not plain) views. When winds call for a southerly landing, approaching plans are practically a stone’s throw from the room.3.	The recreation areas are small compared to the hotel size. The fitness space is appropriate for a home gym (with a Peloton!). The pool is slightly larger than the residential version. While the fitness center was rarely occupied, the pool was a crowd magnet. 4.	The pool closes promptly at 6:00 p.m. and not a minute later. But it’s a Vegas standard to close the pool early, so the hotel is not an outlier.5.	The on-site coffee shop and market is a lifesaver for last-minute food, alcohol, or general merchandise purchases.6.	Like most on- and off-strip hotels, cars live in an adjacent garage. This parking structure is not connected to the hotel, so car-to-room involves two elevators and some outdoor steps.7.	Location (part one) - Two long blocks from Las Vegas Boulevard, the setting offers a more peaceful sin city experience. Two monorail stops are 5-minute strolls. While the monorail is fun, it’s not a cheap date ($5.50 per ride). And it also drops you off on the backside of most hotels, so it’s still a hike to get to the action. If you like to be on action’s doorstep, this is not the property for you. If you (like me) enjoy a few hours on the strip before reaching threat level midnight, staying away from it all is perfect.8.	Location (part two) – The north end of the strip is still dicey. The neighborhood starts to turn north of the Fontainebleau, so most of the action happens due south of the property.9.	Location (part three) – Longtime Vegas aficionados will recognize that the next-door neighbor is the famed and former Las Vegas Hilton, home to one of the tallest freestanding signs in the world.10.	Check-in was a breeze, and I rarely saw more than one or two people waiting in the lobby. Compared to the never-ending lines at the strip hotels, getting into your room quickly feels like paradise found.We would eagerly return to the Grand Paradise Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Youth Travel Ball Tourney in Vegas? This is your spot.
reviews.text: We just visited here for the weekend and were in town for a basketball tournament for a youth basketball event (AAU).  This is the place to be if you are traveling for a youth sports tournament. There is no smoking and there's not a casino on the property.  The rooms have washing machines and dryers and full size refrigerators in the units, so that you can keep your athlete fed healthy food and keep their uniforms washed over a period of days in the HEAT.  There's a pool there that was cool.  On the first floor is a pool table and a foosball table and lounge for the kids to be able to hang out, but without worrying about smoke and gamblers.There is a self- park garage adjacent to the property so that you don't have to constantly call down to valet and deal with that headache. You can have groceries delivered through instacart or other services.  Housekeeping was lovely.  Fullsize 12 cup coffee makers in the room.  And the staff were so great and let us check in early because our flight was so early that day.  And they give you bottled water everyday, which in Vegas, is super important in the summer.  GREAT experience.

reviews.title: Great location, afforable.
reviews.text: Good:  This hotel is nice.  Room had microwave, fridge and safe.  Pillows and beds were EXCELLENT.  Free parking.  Price was afforable and location is great.   5-7 min walk to Westgate monorail.Bad:  TV stations, most would not work.   Pool hours were terrible.  10am - 7pm.   Need to be in pool by 7:00am to avoid extreme heat.  Ugly:   Bathroom was horrible.  Smallest bathroom of any hotel I have stayed in.  Water pressure was terrible and shower needed to be updated.   Walls are very thin.Overall it is a decent hotel for the money.  If you can afford to stay elsewhere I would.  But economically not bad.

reviews.title: Mostly Good Things
reviews.text: The room was big and beautiful and very clean.  The pool closes at 6pm, so we were not able to enjoy the pool.  We were charged $25/day for the amenities but we were not able to enjoy the pool.  That was frustrating.

reviews.title: No Heads Up on Construction!
reviews.text: The resort was under construction and NO ONE gave us the opportunity to say that wouldn't work for us!  You would think if you are going to do construction it would be for the better! The Kitchen doesn't have enough storage,  the drawers hit each other.  Nice furniture in the living room , TV didn't work in any room! Can you tell I was not happy at all!  I look opinions,  allow me to choose construction,  don't hide it until I arrive!

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacations club was a fabulous resort with very friendly staff.  Our two bedroom condo was a renovated one and was clean and great size for the 4 of us.

reviews.title: Relaxing week in Vegas
reviews.text: A great week in Vegas relaxing at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club. Very nice room, so nice to have extra space and kitchen. The unit was very well maintained, coffee shop and convenience store in building was a great bonus, well stocked for a coffee and danish in the morning, or drinks and snacks for the day. We loved that the Sahara was around the corner, we ate there several times and enjoyed the fact that the strip was a couple blocks away, we like to walk! We enjoyed the pool, it was 110* all week, so didn’t last to long even beside the pool!

reviews.title: great value
reviews.text: This two bedroom suite was very clean and all amenities were excellent. Our room overlooked the pool area and inner  courtyard, which was very pleasant.

reviews.title: Perfect place off the strip
reviews.text: Everything was very clean, the rooms are big with full or half kitchen, great remodeling and up to date appliances.

reviews.title: Great Room just off the strip
reviews.text: The 2 BD 2 BA room that we shared with another couple was great for our stay in Las Vegas.  It was just off the strip, so it was quiet.  The only issue we ran into was some construction going on in the building, but it didn't bother us after the first night.

reviews.title: Easy to get around the strip
reviews.text: .  The Hilton Grand is a small well kept resort.  The staff was always available when needed and the best part is that the monorail is right at your doorstep....and they do have free parking.

reviews.title: Terrific unit, great location, and wonderful service!
reviews.text: We stayed at HGVC-Paradise Las Vegas after a wonderful tour of Valley of Fire State Park, Zion National Park, Bryce Canyon National Park, Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, Vermilion Cliffs National Monument, and the North Rim of Grand Canyon National Park. After thinking we were going to be checking in a day late because we had a motel room at Grand Canyon Lodge, we decided our accommodations in Las Vegas would be much more luxurious and made the four hour drive back from the Grand Canyon after seeing all the overlooks we planned to see. We were so glad we did!The front desk staff was incredibly friendly and eager to accommodate us. We had a two-bedroom unit (one-bedroom + studio lock-off) reserved, but really only needed the nice one-bedroom for the two of us. When I mentioned that, the front desk staff immediately offered us some nice compensation for not taking the studio lock-off on the busy Memorial Day weekend. (We really didn't expect anything for it but just didn't want that room to go to waste during our stay.)We got a terrific unit on the 15th floor with views of the Strat and north end of the Strip out our windows. Everything was shiny clean and in good working order. The in-unit washer and dryer were a very welcome surprise; we thought the resort only had a guest laundry room available. We enjoyed the soaking tub (plenty of room for a couple celebrating their anniversary!) There were so many thoughtful elements to make our stay more convenient and comfortable that we agreed it probably was the nicest timeshare unit we'd ever gotten through RCI.Every single staff person we interacted with was friendly, helpful, and very professional. The Hilton influence was apparent everywhere.The resort is very convenient with easy access to everything Las Vegas has to offer.  In particular, it adjoins (and shares the parking deck with) the Westgate Resort where Elvis had his longest-running Las Vegas residency. We really enjoyed the "Soul of Motown" show there and danced in the aisle during that show more than we have danced in years! The Las Vegas monorail also has a station at the Westgate and runs right past the Sphere. We agreed the monorail itself was a nice attraction for sightseeing.We certainly look forward to returning to HGVC-Paradise the next time we return to Las Vegas. Viva!

reviews.title: Room was in rough shape.
reviews.text: Stay was ok. Nice & helpful people at the front desk. Pretty convenient location for getting to the Strip or the convention center. Not much in the way of food options within this facility. Room was worn out, scuffed up, tired and in need of a facelift.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: Great accomodations. Quiet! Not near big casinos, but easy to get to them. We used rental car, but monorail is next door (2 min walk). Loved the inexpensive food options at the "Market Place" in the hotel - hot breakfast, lunch, & dinner options! Fresh salads, drinks, deserts and more!

reviews.title: Home Away From Home
reviews.text: Sitting out by the pool that opens at 10:00 am I’m enjoying this lovely weather.  Clear skies, dry air, and the beautiful sounds of song birds.  I’m within walking distance of a mall and spa. The staff in the market on site are so friendly and they remember me each time I come to visit.  It’s a quiet place if you are looking for a place to rest during the day and go see the entertainment at night.  The staff checks in with me once a day to make sure I’m good.  It’s nice to be home when I’m away from home❤️. Beds are incredibly comfortable.

reviews.title: Last minute trip
reviews.text: This trip was last minute and I was traveling with family that included 4 small children. The two bedroom unit was just right accommodating all of us. The 2bathrooms and kitchen was very usef when traveling with a baby who required formula.

reviews.title: Many extra fees
reviews.text: Mamy fees involved,  exchange fee, resort fee and housekeeping fee.... The EV spots limited and hard to get in.

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: I was able to check in early with no fee. Entire staff has excellent customer service. I felt welcomed. My room was very spacious, clean and comfortable. The window view is amazing, facing the monorail with a partial view of the sphere. Definitely recommend coming to this location if you’re not a fan being around a large crowd. The atmosphere here is soothing and relaxing. I'm here for 4 nights and currently on my 3rd night right now. I’m satisfied with everything and I rate this hotel a high 5

reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Sisters and daughters took this trip to plan the "ultimate" girls trip.  In addition to our planning, we took the bike rail trip in Boulder City.  If you have never done that, do it!!  We had a ball.  Everything was wonderful.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Paradise Las Vegas is an excellent resort property at a great location with a wonderfully attentive staff and HGV Club Paradise is very well maintained, so naturally we loved it!

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: I'm a technology rep and just had a three night stay in this property and I was pleasantly surprised. My room was impeccably clean. The bed was comfortable and the room was large with a general living room area. a kitchen and then the bedroom in a separate room. I honestly don't care about being on the strip as the premium you pay to be on the strip is not worth it in my opinion. I am in Vegas a couple times a year and I would stay at this hotel again. Easy check-in, friendly staff and as I mentioned my room was spotless. The value is definitely their for this property.

reviews.title: March Madness
reviews.text: No restaurant or casino on property, no pool bar, basic hotel. Monorail at resort next door. Beside convention center but far from Strip. Clean but if you’re in Vegas choose something closer to the Strip

reviews.title: Dream hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at the Hilton for 4 days, and what can I say, very high quality hotel. Friendly staff, room with attached hydromassage tub, very comfortable bed and above all the lovely pool area. Very close to the center of nightlife.

reviews.title: Vegas off the Strip
reviews.text: The resort was not quite to the HGV standards yet, but could easily be with a few upgrades. Excellent access to the monorail system, so getting around was nice. Local area not bad, but not far from a so so neighborhood.

reviews.title: cleanliness, ample space in our suite, quality in everything, comfort and very quiet without the noise and smells of smo
reviews.text: cleanliness, ample space in our suite, quality in everything, comfort and very quiet without the noise and smells of smo

reviews.title: Nice!
reviews.text: Not on the strip, but a few blocks away and a block from the shuttle to get you quickly to any part of the strip. Very friendly and helpful staff. Rooms have ample room and are well maintained. Plus no hassle free parking.

reviews.title: Anniversary getaway
reviews.text: My wife and I celebrated our 40th anniversary celebration this year. The room is large and, beautiful. It is next to the Westgate hotel and casino. Off the strip and crowds and traffic. We had a two bedroom unit.

reviews.title: A good deal for an extended Vegas stay.
reviews.text: This Hilton resort is a nice, quiet, off the strip location, with some basic amenities like a nice pool, workout room, a market to buy food, snacks, and necessities, as well as free parking for guest.  The staff were all friendly, they provided suggestions on places to go out, and responded quickly to request. The rooms are spacious, clean, and comes with all of the necessities for an extended stay, especially those with families who prefer to cook instead of eating out for every meal. The resort is close to a couple of hotels with casinos, restaurants and bars, if you're looking to go out, or you could take a rideshare to take you to either downtown or casinos on the strip.

reviews.title: No heat or hot water or pool or hot tub.
reviews.text: They could not get the furnace to control the temperature.  It was either too hot or too cold.  We were told the thermostat was broken but they did not attempt to replace it or move us to another room. We were not compensated for any of the many broken and or closed amenities. We were without hot water 2 mornings. The pool and hot tub were closed 6 out of the 7 nights we were there. They still charged us a resort fee of $25.00 per night even thought there were no amenities.

reviews.title: comfortable and good location
reviews.text: The staff was very kind to us, the rooms are large, clean and functional, the hotel has a very good location 8 minutes from the strip center and very close to The Strat and other tourist attractions

reviews.title: So so tired and disappointed…
reviews.text: The walls are paper thin in this place.  I had a 15 night stay there and could only stand 3 nights.  I am here on business I couldn’t sleep! If you like peace and quiet do not stay here…Neither Hilton Grand Vacations nor Expedia will refund the money from the remaining nights. So, I’m out over $3k.  I’m really disappointed in the customer service from both parties.

reviews.title: Great Hilton option in LV
reviews.text: I would definitely stay at this property again when visiting LV. Nice, modern time-share hotel with good facilities.  Great location within walking distance of Westgate Resort if you want to gamble or have more food options. and the monorail is right there for an inexpensive ride to the main strip south.

reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacations Club Paradise Las Vegas is an excellent facility to visit.  The location is very nice since you can catch the monnorail about a block away.  Facilities are excellent with pool, BBQ faciity, exercise facility, small store and great staff.  You can't go wrong visiting and taking in all the city has to offer.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet and smoke free
reviews.text: Loved the location and that there is no smokey casino on the property.  A bit expensive in Starbucks and store. Wish they cleaned room more than once per week. You have to go to front desk to use coupon to get water bottles.

reviews.title: Quiet, clean, friendly stay just a few miles from the Strip.
reviews.text: Quiet, clean, friendly experience.  Just a few miles from the Strip.  Stayed 3 nights and received friendly service at both the front desk and in the Starbucks-branded convenience store.  The jacuzzi and pool were clean and clear with lifeguard on duty when guests were on site.  Would definitely return.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Excellent and close to everything including the monorail, which was wonderful. We had a two bedroom lockout for the 2nd bedroom. The 2nd bedroom even had a small kitchen, with refrigerator, micro, dishes, extra sink, coffee pot. It was really nice.

reviews.title: Great location and excellent staff
reviews.text: The location is not far from the strip and is next to the tram station. Checking in was quick and efficient. Had a couple of very small issues but the staff was incredibly responsive and quick. I couldn't have asked for more. Simply a great place!! I would love to stay here again.

reviews.title: LV SPEEDWAY DRAG RACING MINI VACATION
reviews.text: Transportation to and from the speedway was a major pain. Ended up booking a Limo, The transportation ended up costing more than the tickets for the three day race. The major hotels need to work with the speedway to get a proper shuttle service for a reasonable cost set up. Most cab companies refuse to come out to the track to pick people up as they can make more money staying in LV.

reviews.title: Overall excellent
reviews.text: All good. Especially the room size. We had a two bedroom which actually consisted of a separate adjpinibg room, which was outstanding. Only negative was the $25 per day resort fee which was excessive for basically wifi and bottled water

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Excellent location, north of the busy, noisy areas but not far from the Westgate monorail station so great access to all parts of the Strip. Very pleasant environment, well maintained and helpful staff - someone on duty at all times. Room is spacious and has all you need to partly self-cater, with a great shop downstairs. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Off the beaten path
reviews.text: This is a great resort up to Hilton's high standards.  We chose it for proximity to the Las Vegas festival grounds, but it turned out to be close to the Strip as well, and reasonable walking distance to the Wynn, Circus Circus, and Strat.  There are also two monorail stops very close by, so transportation is no issue at all.  The resort itself has a lot of amenities, a nice little shop, pool, exercise room, etc.  I was always leery of staying this far north on the Strip, but this place allayed my fears, and I am glad I now have another location to consider when I come to Vegas.  Wonderful place!

reviews.title: Nice stay near fair grounds!
reviews.text: I was in Vegas for a music festival at the fairgrounds, which was in walking distance. The room was super clean, updated with great shower water pressure. The staff was friendly and there is a small store to buy drinks, food and breakfast sandwiches, which was convenient. Also less than 5 minute walk to the monorail so it's super easy to get to the strip. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.text: My daughter stayed in this room. Went in for first time not been cleaned. She complained and they said it’s a £100 each time to clean. What,  so when you enter your room you have to pay on top. Where does it say that on the website. Had someone else’s dirty towel on the floor. Dirty floors. Bedsheets were clean. Disgraceful. They didn’t care. As she was young she had few choices where to stay as casinos. Very disappointed. Never heard anything like it before!!!!!

reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom suite.  It was very spacious, clean and comfortable.  We were served by Natalie at the front desk for check in and out.  She was very helpful and pleasant.  Not in the heart of the strip but the quiet was appreciated.  Just a short walk to the Westgate Resort.

reviews.title: Most amazing property and team ever.
reviews.text: I have been traveling for more than 35 years and have never had an experience like this. The only thing I would change about this entire place would be the bed pillows. I would have them a bit more firmer. So what does that say? I love this resort.

reviews.title: Long Club Paradise Weekend
reviews.text: We had a great stay and really appreciated that there was no casino on the property. The 2 bedroom suite allowed each couple the ability to have quiet time and the great living room/kitchen made for perfect social/together time.

reviews.title: Average Stay
reviews.text: This hotel was pretty nice. It is a block or two off the strip, so you will have to walk or take a car to get onto the strip. The bed was comfortable and check in was easy. However, our room was very dirty and paint was chipping off of the wall. They also have a pool table and foosball table which looked like fun, but you have to pay for it.

reviews.title: Good Stay
reviews.text: Good stay.  We have just come from a week stay at this hotel. Firstly, the hotel is on the north side of the strip. It's between Westgate and Sahara and takes around 20 minutes to get to the main start of the Strip, which I consider the Resorts World.The room itself is clean and has all the amenities needed for a self-catering apartment. However, the reason for the 4 stars is that there was one major issue in the room, the water not draining properly from the sink basins.  The fitness centre could also do with adding an extra bench as it was quite busy in the mornings I recommend getting the monorail(Westgate is the nearest stop) as walking to the strip is fine one way, but we felt it was too long on the way back.

reviews.title: Pleasant Stay
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the location of this hotel because we could do a short walk to the neighbouring West Gate Hotel Monorail Station. We stayed in a studio room and then were moved into a one bedroom suite, which was much nicer, of course. The rooms were clean and quiet, and the check-in was smooth. I really enjoyed being able to get a Starbucks Coffee every morning, and Ethan later into the evening. The prices were a little inflated, but it's Vegas.

reviews.title: WATERLESS HOTEL
reviews.text: A water main broke outside the hotel. No water in hotel. When leaving for new hotel, Hilton had put cases of bottled water on every floor. Desk clerks were completely helpful, they even paid for our Uber to our replacement hotel. Also hotel is beautiful with great views. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text: Stayed with the family over the weekend. Check in was a breeze and Jessica at the bellhop desk was amazing in getting all our luggage to our room. It was too cool to go in the pool but it looked amazing! Our son enjoyed the game room, however, you pay to play. Beds were extremely comfortable and my husband loved the very hot shower water! The hotel ran into a major issue on the Sunday morning that was out of their control and they handled it with grace and V even took care of us in checking out.

reviews.title: This Is A Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: What a wonderful place to vacation. I have stayed in this location many times over the years and this is my absolute favorite. So many things to note, proximity to the monorail, next door to the Westgate, how this place is so clean and we received a mid week cleaning. The front dest staff could not have been nicer and the pool area is so relaxing. The beds are the most comfortable and the pillows perfect. Quiet at night when it's time for bed. I will be back next year.

reviews.title: Great location, clean and great parking
reviews.text: Near the Convention Center, the Strip and the monorail.  Clean, convenient and good close-by parking.  Love the location slightly out of the mainstream.  Studio is only a bit more than a hotel room with very tiny kitchen area.  No comfortable chairs or couch as most studios would.  Still would stay again rather than the huge hotels.  Small store/cafe for coffee & juice.  Nice pool. Great staff.  You do not have to walk a mile to your room.

reviews.title: Never again - any motel,is better
reviews.text: no conference rooms, no breakfast, no gambling and on top an unfriendly service that does not even care if there is a diamond member in front of them - just one of those bloody tourists that will go away and we will never see them again — attitude. And they are probably right

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: A clean and quite place to stay for relaxing and just minutes away to many casino's. Lyfy or Uber easy to caught at the resort.  The staff is very friendly and the store has breakfast and sandwiches and other items.

reviews.title: Bad Experience of life
reviews.text: Bad experience, noise issue and left wallet in room that hotel never reported. Bad house keeping and no responsive staff.Security guy/team sucks. I don’t think I will ever stay with Hilton anymore. To bad.

reviews.title: Not what you expect from a large Hilton Hotel.
reviews.text: The room service is Organizer by sms Messages and can not be changed in a day, only from one to the other day. The Bar wasn’t open on one at 10:30 p.m. due to staff problems. And last but not least they do not really have a restaurant neither a breakfast place. This brings me by a rate of +200USD/Night to three points only. Sorry.

reviews.title: meh
reviews.text: Property is ok. Location not great, but we knew that going in. I picked this location for the 2 BR set up and because it has a pool with a bar. What they have is a pool with a sign that there is a bar. It was never staffed or open. The staff we did interact with was very kind. My bad that I didn't see the $25 per day "resort fee". This was absolutely not a resort, it was a nice hotel with a pool area. The beds/pillows were super uncomfortable, but the water pressure was great in the shower. Coffee maker doesn't work. Will never come back and cannot recommend.

reviews.title: Vegas Stronger Vacation Package 4/3
reviews.text: The vegas stronger package -4 days 3 nights is sold by a bunch of "traveling salesman and women" that specialize in filling the package for the hotels they represent and they hipe the crap out of this thing !  One thing for sure is you will only get whats in writing PERIOD ... so ask they to valadate the entire package in writing before you commit to buying.  The best time to book is non-holidays and Off Peak Event Season, which is kind of limited avaiability.  But Sun, Mon, and Tues are thge best dates ... I woul play on getting to vegas early in the morning and arriving at the hotel and asking for an early check-in even if they charge its worth it.  I would then park car at the hotel, put lugage in Bell Desk Stotage, go get breakfast, and play a few slots while waiting for the room, or ask right away for all the extras your package comes with so you can get that out of the way while your waiting for the room.  Then pick the latest time possible to attend the 60 minute timeshare pitch.  That way you'll have time for a short nap, hit the gamdeling again, set up dinner and watch the program, then go see a show.

reviews.title: nice modern style condo. free parking but not good Location
reviews.text: Unit had all the modern appliancesfree parkingClose to the monorail which is expensiveNothing you could walk to except stratospherePool was closed most of the timeWi-Fi was slowCable TV was good

reviews.title: Check In Nightmare
reviews.text: We arrived late, after midnight out time zone, and were told we couldn’t check in because we were not listed on the reservation, even though my parents and I share the same last name.  I explained that my father had passed away and we were working through the title transfer with our home resort before we could get the transfer done with RCI.  The agent basically said “too bad” we had to have a guest certificate.  We called RCI after hours and had to leave a message.  After 30 minutes we still hadn’t received a call back, so we asked the agent what other choices we had.  She said we had to go to the web and basically book another room even though our paid for condo at there unoccupied.  Since it was now after 1AM, we went ahead and booked another room at a cost of nearly $450.  The next morning we did get a hold of RCI and the Hilton team took care of the charges, but the whole check in experience was totally unacceptable.  I am an Elite Hilton member, which made the whole thing even more frustrating as there was zero understanding of the circumstances.

reviews.title: Very Nice Accommodations
reviews.text: This vacation club is really nice. The staff is very friendly and the place is very clean. Each of the units has a full kitchen and large bathroom as well as a large bedroom. Very comfortable stay. The location is between the Westgate and the Sahara and is easily accessible by monorail. It's just a short walk from the Westgate Monorail station. They have a nice pool for their guests and it's easy to get anywhere on the Strip quickly via monorail for just a small price. Would strongly recommend this Hilton Vacation Club

reviews.title: This resort is a winner!
reviews.text: This resort is a winner!  We were greeted with a warm hello and welcome as soon we entered.  Check in was smooth and efficient.  The room was clean and the view of the light show was spectacular at night.  Overall it was no competition.  We made an excellent choice.

reviews.title: Great place! Really clean!
reviews.text: This place is awesome! Very clean, great service, and wonderful suite. My mom and I had a 2 bedroom with 2 bath, living room, and full kitchen. Basically, one bedroom and bath on one side was a regular hotel room with a connecting door to the larger one bedroom suite with jacuzzi tub. There was also a washer/dryer! There is a small convenience type store, but no onsite restaurant, which is ok due to having a kitchen but I was not there to cook. It was convenient to the Westgate where my brother was in the pool tournament. The monorail is also there. We received excellent service, right down to the quick delivery of a scooter for my mom, with help from the concierge. I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Quiet Location, good beds but otherwise lacking
reviews.text: It’s quiet and the beds are comfortable and there’s enough space and a full kitchen and laundry which is nice but the parking sucks and there is no restaurant. At least it’s non smoking but they pump vanilla spray into the air in the lobby.  Some of the staff are really unhelpful  and can’t be bothered. This is definitely not a full service hotel.  Pool is mostly in the shade and is just so so.  Requested towels and trash service three days in a row and did not receive even though they kept saying they would send someone.

reviews.title: Very nice resort in a convenient downtown Las Vegas location
reviews.text: Great accommodations and amenities.  Walking distance to a monorail station.  Quiet, at night.  Friendly and helpful staff.  (Be sure to park in the end of the parking garage closest to the Hilton property.)  Only disappointment was that the pool area closed at 6pm daily.

reviews.title: Nice and Clean
reviews.text: Hotel is clean and relaxing with a big pool area. Though it’s on the strip it’s away from the noise. The food and cocktail drink at this hotel is horrible, it’s time they get a new chef. Otherwise it’s an ok stay!

reviews.title: Great, relaxing Las Vegas stay
reviews.text: A short way away from the strip, this resort is clean, peaceful and the staff is very friendly.  It is a short walk from the monorail, so you can get the strip quickly, but then get away from it as well, returning to a peaceful oasis. I recommend this resort.

reviews.title: Best part of the trip was my Room who knew
reviews.text: The best hotel suite I have had in Vegas. I know all rooms may be renovated different but I lucked up! The suite was huge contemporary furnished. Full kitchen, living room and a small dining area.  The bathroom was updated with double sink , standing shower and a huge soaking tub that sits right outside of the bathroom connected with the master suite. There is also an apartment size washer & dryer in the unit. The pool area is well kept with attendants willing to help with questions & there is also a small grilling area open for residents with utensils available upon request. This hotel had all the amenities of home. I was more than pleased with my stay thank you!

reviews.title: Best Place to Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: One of the best places to stay in Las Vegas. The room & linens were pristinely clean. The check in process was quick. All the Staff were friendly, welcoming & provided right information.Easily accessible to Strip.No negatives. Definitely & highly recommended.

reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.text: I had never stayed at a time share in Vegas, but found it a lot more relaxing for a busy city. It was a change to stay on a different end, however I actually liked the west gate sportsbook  and food, and Sahara has been renovated.  Also easy to take monorail anywhere on the strip, or to check out resorts Hotel also had a nice pool and hotub, and tiny but usable gym that was usually empty. It was also kept very clean and had friendly staff.  I will definitely stay here or at another Hilton timeshare in Vegas !

reviews.title: Excellent service and great rooms.
reviews.text: The hotel has very clean rooms. The staff is super helpful and welcoming. The best part is that the parking structure is beside the hotel and totally free. We loved our stay here and would come back to stay again.

reviews.title: Great space
reviews.text: Great great space for our group. Clean hotel. Very good staff all made me feel welcomed. Location I did not like was far away from the strip had to take an Uber so it cost me a lot for transportation.

reviews.title: Perfect location, comfortable and clean
reviews.text: This was the perfect location in Vegas since it was far enough from the Madness yet very accessible by the monorail. We arrived late at night so special shout out to Stephanie for making our check in and stay so pleasant.

reviews.title: Great location just off the strip
reviews.text: As we prefer an apartment style property versus a hotel room, we chose this property. It is very walkable to the strip, monorail and numerous great restaurants and lounges. Sahara & Westgate are both the closest hotels.The biggest disappointment is that the hot tub is only available 10am-6pm so not optimal as we generally like to utilize this in the evenings.There is a convenience store on-site that has pretty much most things you would need at fairly reasonable prices.

reviews.title: Not posh - but great place to stay.
reviews.text: Overall, very positive experience.  Good staff, no issues.  Did not use the market.  Fitness center good.  No issues for parking.  Arranged for and obtained early check-in without issues.  I am HGV points owner, but used RCI points for this stay and there were no issues with this not being on HGV point stay.  Rooms were in good repair - all appliances in good working order.  No calls for a timeshare presentation.   This was 2 BR with 2nd bedroom being a lockout room, with 2 queen beds, kitchenette, standard bath.  It was very comfortable for our guests staying with us.    The main unit with 1 bedroom - king bed, large ensuite bath, full kitchen and washer dryer. Nice large and deep soaking tub - fits 2 average sized adults easily - (no jets).  Double sink in bath.  Plenty of storage, large closet and safe.  Hot water was very hot.  The magnifying mirror was buried in a drawer - did not find it until after a few days.    The location is good, convenient for both strip and Fremont Street. Walking distance from the Strat.  The pool was open and heated, and also had operation spa that was at a good hot temp. The pool is only open 10a-6p. The weather was unseasonable cool for early April - 50's and 60's, but the heated pool and spa were still great in the sunshine.  We did not use the monorail/tram but is within walking distance.    Overall, would recommend staying there - no complaints.

reviews.title: Quiet spot off strip
reviews.text: Hilton has this property it is well kept. And the staff are terrific. There is no timeshare sales pitch👏. If you want a spot close to the strip that can be quiet and relaxing, this is the place.Hilton on Paradise.

reviews.title: Very Clean and Accommodating
reviews.text: although there is no food & beverage outlet, I like the fact that it didn't have any slot machines and/or feeling of a gambling hall. I was there for a business trip with a group and I only used the room to sleep, shower and get ready for my meetings. so it worked out for me.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful staff, clean rooms, nice furniture, fully equipped kitchen with washer and dryer at a quiet location. This is exactly what we needed. Really enjoyed the stay. Will definitely come back next time.

reviews.title: Good property, nice people
reviews.text: Nice locations, nice property, good service from housekeeping and front desk, lousy "engineers/maintenance staff". The check in was very easy and water coupons were given. Staff was polite and welcoming. The refrigerator ended up leaking onto the floor, and a large amount of water was at the bottom of the fridge. The "engineer" simply turned up the controls and said that would fix it. It did not. They kindly gave us a new room but other things went wrong. The toilet paper holder was falling off the wall with a pocket door. The "engineer" fixed it with 2 1/2" nails. Scratched the door and fell off again. Part of our stay the tv in the living room didn't work but the bedroom tv did. They said it was the fault of the cable service. Very strange!

reviews.title: Las Vegas Convention
reviews.text: The entire staff was very friendly, welcoming, helpful from check-in, to meeting maintenance to shopping in the market.  Clean, nicely laid out room.  Kitchenette was adequate for my quick meals in the morning with a good size refrigerator, microwave, counter top area.

reviews.title: Accommodations only no casino onsite and Tesla Chargers in front.
reviews.text: I reserved 3 2 bedroom suites for my dads birthday.  all the grandkids were there.  It was good experience for the family because it is just accommodations without the smoke filled casino that we didn't want the kids to be around.  Parking in front of the property is limited to 4 handicap spots and 4 loading spots.  no valet and self parking is connected to the Flamingo Hotel so it is a trek to go from the parking lot to the property.  The area is not the safest because there are a lot of homeless people sleeping everywhere.  Most resorts are good with keeping the urban campers away from the strip or in the downtown area only. I like that there is a Starbucks in the property but closes too early.  the pool is small for a timeshare that size.  however the location is great and I love it because it is next to the Tesla charging lot.

reviews.title: Paradise in Vegas - it is true
reviews.text: We visited for the SuperBowl.  The venue is close to the WestGate which has shopping and Casinos.  It was nice to stay in a resort that does not have smoking/casinos on site.  The pool was very nice but it was too cool to actually use it.  The rooms were spacious and my family was very comfortable.  The service and attention to anything we needed was 100% on par.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Rough surrounding neighborhoods
reviews.text: Rent a car or get a monorail pass. Nothing enjoyable is near property. Literally nothing in reasonable walking distance other than WESTGATE . The location is basically a hotel without dining areas, not resort feel at all. It’s good for smallerbusiness meetings etc.

reviews.title: It was just ok
reviews.text: We took advantage of a package offer to stay at Hilton Grand Vacation in Vegas that included a timeshare presentation.  Our stay was not at the main hotel where they presented the timeshare.  The property we did stay at was not as updated or had the amenities as the one shown in the timeshare offer.  The room we stayed in had a running toilet and no hot water one morning.  The timeshare sale team repeatedly said this was a "no pressure" presentation, but when we decided not to move forward with purchasing a timeshare package, the salesperson was visibly unhappy and pouted the rest of the time as we wrapped up with the other agents.  The timeshare sales team said they would report the toilet issue to the hotel, filled out a form in front of us and then nothing was happened and the toilet was never repaired.  The we stayed at only had a small marketplace to buy snacks and coffee and no other food options.

reviews.title: Location
reviews.text: I highly recommend this resort for both business and pleasure.  The location is great for conventions as it is so close to the convention center but also the monorail can take you to the strip for food and fun!  We had a two bedroom unit with a nice sized common area.  Beds were comfortable, no issues with hot water, nice to have a full kitchen but we did not really cook. The market in the lobby was great for coffee and a quick breakfast.

reviews.title: Has potential but lacks in execution
reviews.text: Free parking is a blessing in Vegas. Staff was nice, and friendly. Rooms were clean when we got there. Location is convenient.But....... the shower was luke warm at best and usually just cold. Doesn't matter what time. According to staff it is a known issue and management does nothing to address it. There is no bar or restaurant on the property. There is space if they chose to accommodate visitors with a lounge. There is a $25 daily resort fee, which is normal, but it should have been waived since we had no hot water. Also, if you want your room cleaned, they charge another $25 . What is the resort fee for?As per the title, has potential, but needs improvements and we will not go back. I would not recommend it to friends, maybe to folks i don't care for.

reviews.title: Cold weather and hot slots
reviews.text: Very satisfied with our stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club Paradise Las Vegas.  There was construction in the parking garage so some limitations but the staff was very helpful and explained all the options.  The location was great for our purpose of enjoying both the Strip and Downtown attractions.

reviews.title: Bummer it wasn't better
reviews.text: I was there at a tradeshow and the location is very convenient for the convention center.  The two big issues - the shower approached tepid water.I tried at 630am, 715 am, and 8am.  If I wanted a hot shower it needed to be at 10pm.  I was told it was a known issue and moving wouldn't help.  The second issue was the pool and hot tub were undergoing maintenance.  I didn't see anyone working on it so that seemed suspect.  We were told that we could use one of their other properties but there is no shuttle.  We weren't up for calling a car, going to another property, and then calling a car to take us back.  I am a Hilton Member.  I was seriously disappointed.  The rooms were nice and the extra space was great.  There is no bar, cafe or casino.

reviews.title: Quieter Than the Strip
reviews.text: Easy walk to the monorail, good restaurant suggestions by the concierge, and very clean hotel throughout. Pool closes at 6:00, which seems early, but probably cuts down on partying. There is no restaurant or bar on site; we found everything easily by heading out toward Fremont Street.

reviews.title: 10 day stay
reviews.text: Great hotel, rooms had everything you need and they were clean. You could catch the monorail to the strip about a 5 min walk also bus stop to catch bus to Fremont st . Only complaint was the market inside the hotel was very expensive for necessities, as far as buying potato chips and junk food that was very expensive but you could do without.

reviews.title: Grand Vacations was a superb stay!
reviews.text: The Hotel accommodations were terrific. Despite being a bit further north than most of the rest of the Vegas Strip, it is still a manageable to get to everywhere you need to go. Wonderful service and the downstairs store is convenient if you don't want to travel elsewhere for basic personals or food and snacks.

reviews.title: Surprisingly convenient and nice units
reviews.text: I did not know what to really expect.  I have never stayed this far North or off the strip when traveling to Vegas.  But this resort was literally less than 5 minutes to the Westgate Monorail stop.  The monorail ran frequently and was not crowded and could get you anywhere on the strip in a few minutes.  It was nice to stay someplace with a laid back pool area, but still close to the night life. And the unit was a good size and very comfortable.

reviews.title: Not Clean
reviews.text: The room was not clean. The garbage can under the kitchen was completely full. There was hair in the shower/bathtub. I always stay at a Hilton property and I was disappointed with this Hilton property.

reviews.title: Very mediocre off strip Hilton property.
reviews.text: Typical high rise Hilton property which needs an updating. Stayed just one night to be off the strip as a pass through Vegas on our way to the Utah parks. Tried to find a decent Hilton property easy to get in and out of, which this property fits the bill. The problem is it’s in a poor location, in a semi rough area and has nothing good about it other than it’s a place for a quick stay.  Another issue is we are Diamond Hilton members, and when we asked if there was a room upgrade, we were told by the desk person “we don’t have anything and if there was something, you’d have to pay a higher fee”.  That was the most ridiculous answer I’ve heard since we know the hotel was lucky to be half full on a Thursday night. Can’t believe they would tell a loyal Hilton member such nonsense.  May have to start being more loyal to Marriott properties after that experience. I would not recommend this Hilton property.

reviews.title: Nice quiet resort in a busy city
reviews.text: We stayed here as it is a short tram ride to the convention center.  While it on the north side of Las Vegas, it is a short walk to the tram and access to the strip.  It is a fairly well maintained resort with a nice pool area.  Downside is no onsite dining.  There is a small store with drinks and snacks, but nowhere to purchase a drink or a meal.

reviews.title: Not a fan of Hilton and RCI
reviews.text: Not everything as promised. This was a miss for us as timeshare owners. There was no cleaning service provided yet we were charged a fee of $70. In addition, RCI now charges a resort fee of $25 a day.  Did I mention I am a Hilton timeshare owner? What am I paying all these fees for exactly?

reviews.title: Another Triumphant Return
reviews.text: We were  in Las Vegas for one of our annual conferences.  We once again decided to stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations Paradise Property.We were happily greeted at the front desk by Zach.
