Zach graciously gave us a wonderful top floor corner suite with a fantastic view.  All the suites are great but this one was fantastic.  Thank you Zach.Everything in my previous review remains the same except that they have added the ability of both flatscreen TV’s in the room to work off your phone or tablet so you can watch whatever may not be included in their extensive channel lineup.I also want to thank housekeeping for a spotless room throughout our stay.This is one of the few properties in the chain that I am able to get an uninterrupted great nights sleep.  I have no idea why-  it may be the ultra silent AC system, the super quiet bedroom, the Hilton bed or perhaps the Hilton pillows.  Maybe it is the comfortable feel home layout of the suite.  Whatever it may be - it works.I am scheduled to be in Las Vegas for meetings in November, and although all my Associates are staying at the Venetian (very nice property), I am once again choosing the the Hilton Grand Vacations Paradise for another great stay and sleep experience.

reviews.title: Terrible Room Location
reviews.text: Before evening walking into the hotel and strong smell of a terrible perfume hits you. The entire first floor smelled of this perfume. It was so strong it felt like they were trying to compensate and 'cover up' the smell of smoke or something else.Upon check-in, we were given two options for our room, one on the first floor by the pool and the other on the 7th floor. We selected the one on the 7th floor since it seemed like the better choice since the first floor smelled terribly of a stale strong perfume and it would have the heavy foot traffic of everyone going to the pool creating a bunch of noise. I asked a few times to ensure there were no other possible options for a room. We settled on the room on the 7th floor thinking there'd be less traffic and might be a little quieter than the room located near the pool. The room was updated except for the kitchenette that had really worn cabinets, where you could see that the finish had come off around the highly touched areas. The only other complaint about the room itself was that the AC was unable to be turned down to a lower temperature. Unfortunately, we quickly learned, rather heard, that our hotel room was located in a very noisy area. The cleaners had their closets on the other side of the wall of our headboard, so we consistently heard the slamming of the doors all day and into the evening. The ice machine was also located on the other side of that wall so we got to hear the loud sound of ice being dropped into the bucks all day, night and wee hours of the morning. The hotel insisted that the only other room was on the first floor and since we had terrible headaches from the perfume on that floor we stuck with the 7th floor room. The noise levels did get worse as our week went on, with someone drilling and hammering in the room above us.

reviews.title: Great place, great location, great amenities. Las Vegas's best kept secret.
reviews.text: This place is Las Vegas' best kept secret. You can find great value by staying here. The amenities were fantastic. The beds were super comfy. The full kitchen was very helpful and the staff was super friendly and also helpful. Plus the location is amazing. You are just across from the WestGate MonoRail station where you can have access to great transportation around the strip.

reviews.title: Party of 21!
reviews.text: Stayed at the hotel with 20 other people (mainly couples). Everyone was impressed with the space available in each room, along with the included amenities (had the rooms with a full kitchen included). We were spread across 5 different rooms, and only one of them was filled to capacity. Some people had their own beds (if they didn't come along with a plus one). I appreciated that the hotel accommodated to our large party by having us all on the same floor. This hotel is close enough to the north end strip to where Uber/Lyft rides averaged 20-30 minutes to reach our destination, depending on the time of day we were going. It was also away from the strip to where there was peace and quiet when back to sleep. Definitely will be back next time I am in Vegas!

reviews.title: Excellent Say
reviews.text: Our stay was wonderful.  The rooms were spotless, and the view was beautiful with the sunrise over the mountains.  The Front Desk staff was so pleasant and helpful in making you feel at home.  They checked to make sure you are enjoying your stay, which is great.

reviews.title: Quiet, Clean, Relaxing, and Nice
reviews.text: My family really enjoyed the room, pool, hot tub, and activity room. We loved that we saw families there or servicemen. It was a really peaceful and family oriented stay.  You can't beat cleanliness and safety.

reviews.title: Awesome place to stay for relaxation and visit to Strip
reviews.text: This hotel had great access to the monorail station, making it very easy to visit the Strip. The amenities were great. We used the pool almost every day. The rooms were spacious and modern, and the hotel had great wifi. Overall, great stay.

reviews.title: Best Experience
reviews.text: I had the best experience. The customer service was amazing and the place was very clean. The housekeeper were on top of what we asked from the towels to the trash bags we requested. They came quick and with a smile; very friendly. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: No Housekeeping
reviews.text: Paid a fee for housekeeping,, there was no housekeeping for our entire stay,, no clean linen or garbage removal either,, when asked about the $70 fee,, I was told that it was simply a fee that has to be paid

reviews.title: Small Resort with Big Convenience
reviews.text: Loved this resort wright next to Westgate.  Easy to get around and access to all the casinos on the strip. We will definitely stay there again. My husband does not like the huge resorts with large crowds so this resort was perfect.

reviews.title: First experience with HGVC in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We were greeted pleasantly and the check-in process was flawless. The front desk staff all were so friendly and pleasant at all times and also knowledgeable. The 2 bedroom 2 bath unit was really two adjoining 1 bedroom units, which was fine since there were 5 of us and we are all family. There were no issues with air conditioning or bugs, but we did experience dirty floors in the bathroom and kitchen. I had spilled coffee in the bathroom and when I sopped it up with bath towels and began to wipe, the towels were dirty. I reported this to management and I was assured it will be addressed. Other than that incident, our stay was great!

reviews.title: Great relaxing accommodations
reviews.text: This has always been our favorite HGVC . We are not owners at this property but always spend most of our time at this location. The staff always makes our stays very comfortable and clean. Can’t go wrong

reviews.title: Not the worst, but not worth the money
reviews.text: 1. Room would not cool down below preset temperature of 72 even after calling maintenance. Maintenance said there were movement detectors which reset the ac when you leave the room and are sleeping. My room faced the sunset so it was uncomfortably warm the entire time. 2. The kitchenettes wood was peeling in multiple places. It was quite ghetto.3. The only place to apply my makeup was in the bathroom and the light was extremely dim and yellow. 4. The coffee maker would not work. With all the choices in Las Vegas I will not be returning to this particular one.

reviews.title: Hotel without a Casino
reviews.text: I travel to LV often for business, it's so expensive at Casino's for parking and eating. The rooms at Hilton Grand Vacation had a kitchen, sitting room which was very comfortable and had utensils and dishes to where you could cook for yourself. I loved it. Pool was great too.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations is always a favorite
reviews.text: Very clean, modern room with all the amenities. Love the huge tub and all the phone chargers in front of the TVs. Very spacious room and luxury bathroom. The washer and dryer was really a nice touch. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Zero Service
reviews.text: Very little to no help. No great food options. Tried getting coffee at the coffee bar and they were constantly closed. Room didn’t have basic toiletries, asked for towels, coffee filters, and shampoo never got anything the three days I was there.

reviews.title: Stay somewhere else
reviews.text: They charge a daily resort fee for use of pool because they have nothing else on-site. Really strong odor in lobby and hallways. It is far down the strip so plan on car rental or taking an Uber wherever you go. Homeless people sleeping around perimeter of property.

reviews.title: Short stay but sweet
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for 3 nights, midweek to Saturday because we could get better airline flight to Las Vegas.  Enjoyed our stay.  All amenities worked well.  Comfortable bed and sofa. Good location near monorail.

reviews.title: Hilton Grande Vacations Las Vegas, Karen Ave
reviews.text: Not sure what other studios look like but this was a hotel room. It lacked the elegance that you see when you view timeshare properties. In addition to paying the exchange fee, when we arrived, we also had to pay a resort fee. The drink machines didn't work. I didn't see any activities planned for the guests

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation Spring Break
reviews.text: Let me get the negative stuff out of the way first just to save you some reading. Upon check-in you are charged $170 for absolutely nothing at all. This goes to the resort and that is on top of most likely the fee you paid to transfer to get to this Resort. There is no restaurant on site but a small type grocery store that has limited hours and charges pretty much twice to three times as much as a regular grocery store. The pool closes at 6 every day I don't know why. Our room happened to be right next to Karen Avenue which is a very busy road night and day and it makes for a terrible night sleep from all of the traffic. Not only that behind the resort is what I would say the shady area which I would not walk around at night and there are homeless roaming around during the day and night which gives an uneasy feeling. Now some of the positive things. The staff is very friendly. The rooms are very nice. The cleanliness of the resort is kept up fairly well. Resort is located next to the Westgate which has the tram that goes up and down the strip for a fee so it could be one way to avoid a rental car. If you happen to need an Uber or a Lyft driver they are there within minutes. If you want to do sightseeing to Red Rock Canyon you will need to either go with a tour group or rent a car because the Uber or Lyft drivers say that there is no reception for you to call a driver to pick you up. All of the major Resorts all the way down to the Luxor you can pretty much get a ride or take the tram and be there within 10 to 15 minutes easy. The resort has a nice feel to it the beds are comfortable the rooms are nice. Its location is just a bit sketchy I'm sorry to say. We are definitely going back to Vegas next year during spring break there's a lot of fun things to do but we are going to be choosing a different location. Hope this helps with your decision

reviews.title: Full satisfaction
reviews.text: We stayed here for four nights in early April 2022. We stayed on the tenth floor overlooking the Stratosphere Hotel. We were very satisfied with our overnight stay, the room and bathroom were very clean and the bed was very comfortable. Parking is available across the street in the large parking lot for free as well as in the adjacent parking garage. All together a successful time at this hotel.

reviews.title: Get away vacation
reviews.text: We arrived after midnight due to flight changes.No problem with check in.Staff extremely friendly and very helpful.Had the one bedroom unit complete with a full kitchen.What really surprised us was the instant hot water and great pressure in the shower.The bed was huge and very comfortable.Room also has a tub.Great view from the 11th floor of tower 2.Walking distance to the Sahara where one can jump on the monorail and ride anywhere on the strip.Sahara has a great Breakfast at Zeffers,walking distance to both IHOP and Denny's.Only drawback is there is no restaurant attached to the hotel,however jump on the monorail and buzz down to the strip.Great snack bar at the pool.Great place to stay if one does not want all the glitz of down town.Highly recommend!Almost forgot,Market place has  food items for any needs,actual eggs,pizza etc.Like movies?How about free DVD's

reviews.title: Not so great
reviews.text: This was a timeshare stay with my family so I guess the accommodations are not the same as if you stayed as a regular hotel guest.  Because we were there using a time share, the room was not cleaned the entire time, dirty towels were in a heap in the closet, we had to ask for towels daily, 1 small bathroom garbage can which was overflowing by the time we left after 5 days 4 nights.  The market inside the hotel closed at 8pm and there were no restaurants close by.  Pool closed at 6pm and I am not sure why as it was it like there was a life guard on duty so why the early close time.  It was just a horrible stay.  I prefer the resorts which still clean the rooms daily, provide fresh towels without being asked and food is available.  While the front desk was always nice, I don't ever have to come back here!

reviews.title: Ideal off-strip property that could get away with saying it is a strip property
reviews.text: This a great base for any Vegas vacation.  We were more about hiking in the mountains this time and were looking for free parking and a quick route out of town.  This checked those boxes and so much more.  You get great off-strip value in a luxury that is hard to find in Vegas.  Our suite was huge, spotless and so comfortable.  We were overjoyed to not have to hike through a casino every day, but when I got that urge, the Westgate and the Sahara were only steps away.  Our trip was too short to enjoy the monorail station that was also steps away for quick access to all the properties farther down.

reviews.title: Girls week in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The hotel was ha ar to find on arrival. The attendant at the check in desk said that I needed to purchase a voucher to use the property since my husband's name is primary on the account, and he wasn't with us since it was a girls getaway. Other than that, everything was good.

reviews.title: No restaurant on premises... overinflated prices in Marketplace!
reviews.text: There is no restaurant on premises, no hot food choices.. no restaurant in walking distance.. bring good walking shoes if you don't rent a car. The pool stays open til 6pm and I am not sure why? Most adults want a late night swim or hot tub.

reviews.title: Good for me/not for everyone
reviews.text: Looking for a quiet, spacious place to stay?  Then this may be for you.  It has no casino and no restaurant, but it does have spacious apartments at a reasonable price.  Clean and comfortable.  We would stay again.  It is walking distance from the Westgate which has a casino and multiple restaurants and entertainment options.  The monorail is right there also.  So, if you want to be in the heart of the Vegas beat, choose elsewhere.  If you want access, but some restful breaks, this might just be for you.

reviews.title: clean, close and easy
reviews.text: i found this unit incredibly clean, comfortable and very close to all the things we wanted to do during our las vegas trip - the monorail is next door at the westgate which makes getting around vegas very very easy even though you are not ON the strip.   we stayed at this resort as part of a vegas getaway and it was a good location overall

reviews.title: A week in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We really enjoyed this resort. The staff is very helpful and our room was perfect for the 2 of us. Even though we were off the strip, we found the monorail extremely helpful, less expensive and just a 5 minute walk from the resort. I normally would not have wanted to stay a week, but glad we did it here.

reviews.title: Perfect place to stay for gymnastics meet next door
reviews.text: I'm hesitant to spill our secret, but while everyone else with our group was staying at the nearby Westgate for a gymnastics competition we stayed at the Hilton.  While they had a smoky crowded casino we had a quiet and clean oasis just across the parking garage.  An even more special bonus is that our pool was heated and open, and the pool at the Westgate was closed for the season.  While they were crammed into outdated hotel rooms we had a 2BR suite.  Definitely won the dad lottery on this one!Thanks Hilton!

reviews.title: Ok, not great!
reviews.text: Nice location, clean room, friendly staff. The room was stuffy and hot! The entertainment / Tv was not great. This was a staycation type of trip for us and having the guide not be accurate was annoying. Since this was a timeshare rate promotion I’m ok with this. I would be disappointed if I had spent full price.

reviews.title: Always the best
reviews.text: I actually booked a hotel on the strip very well known hotel at that , my room had to be changed twice due it not being cleaned after the second room I immediately checked out  and went back to where I knew it would be clean , after that experience I know for sure I will only stay here in Las Vegas like I been doing ..

reviews.title: December in Vegas
reviews.text: We had a great time!  We explored Westgate’s Superbook for football, checked out the strip for New Year’s, and watched the Stratusphere fireworks from our room. Because the light rail was so close we never had to drive once we were there.

reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: This was a birthday/girls trip with family and friends as well as my first time in Vegas. The hotel accommodations and room was above our expectations. We loved everything about the two bedroom suite. Thank you to the staff.

reviews.title: Birthday vacation
reviews.text: The check in policy for friends and family arriving before you (on the same date) by both this resort and RCI needs to be changed.  Being held hostage to purchase and over price guest certificate so your friends and family don't have to sit in the lobby for several hours before you arrived is one of the many reasons why people hate the time share industry.  Both this resort and RCI need to do better!!!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel and perfect location
reviews.text: This is a great hotel.  Very quiet.  One block off strip but next to the monorail stop so you can go anywhere and never move your car.  The staff was beyond helpful and friendly.  Room was brand new and very clean.  I hightly recommend.  There is a little food and beverage store on site.  We had a mufffin for breakfast, they have fresh pastries.

reviews.title: Another great experience
reviews.text: We have stayed at this resort a few times over the last 10 years, and it never disappoints. Furnishings and beds were very comfortable. Kitchen is well equipped. Everything is kept clean, the resort looks fresh. Front desk staff are welcoming. I last wrote a review of this resort in 2015, and would not have written another review; however, I had a pleasant surprise after completing a Hilton review. I brought up a pet peeve issue. Within one hour, I received a response from the Director of Guest Services with a resolution to my pet peeve which I had not even asked for. This is great customer service. We will stay no where else on our trips to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice and Quiet
reviews.text: Looking forward a nice and quiet place to eat ape the strip - visit Hilton Grand Vacations property at 455 Karen Ave, Las Vegas. Rooms are nice and clean. Pool and fitness room was nice.  Only disappointment was choice of food on the property.

reviews.title: Umm, not the cleanest and hotel staff needs to be retrained in customer service
reviews.text: I was denied a room changed due to a noise complaint. After several complaints my room change was approved. I saw hair (long strands on my shower curtain). Something yucky in my kitchen sink. They stated it was a sewer backup. I asked for clean towels twice which never came. Worst hotel experience I’ve ever had during business and personal travel.

reviews.title: Convenient for our purposes
reviews.text: This hotel was overall a good value and convenient for our purpose (a youth football tournament). The jacuzzi and restaurant were closed, which was disappointing. The room was great - very clean and comfortable.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Room was great here. Spacious and love the full kitchen. Very clean and updated. Walls are thin so I was able to hear conversations going on next door. This resort is off the strip and not in walking distance of anything. That would be the reason I wouldn’t come back is is like to access things by foot.

reviews.title: Quiet, but close to the strip.
reviews.text: A smaller hotel without a casino.  A nice gym and pool area. My only complaint is:  No food service pantry area after 2pm.  That can be a problem if you want a snack at night.  A small 24/7 food pantry is needed.

reviews.title: Comfortable, Convenient, Clean and Friendly
reviews.text: Convenient location near a monorail stop, the resort also has a plenty of free parking, mini-mart that sells Starbucks coffee.  Our unit was clean and quiet, with a comfortable bed, full kitchen and lounging area.  Friendly staff.  I would stay here again for sure.  The only negatives are the daily resort fee for “free wifi” and other trivial benefits and a very clunky interface with streaming services which made using apps on the big screen TVs impossible.

reviews.title: My 2nd home in Vegas
reviews.text: I consider HGVC my 2nd home every time I am in Vegas which is every other 2 weeks. As Elite Premier owner in HGVC, I have other HGVC options in the area.I keep coming back to this property because the staff and management make me feel like family. This is true regardless of whether they are busy or not - even during the trying times of the early part of the pandemic. They have a more personal approach to treating their guests.I highly recommend HGVC Paradise.

reviews.title: Expected better from Hilton Grand Vacations
reviews.text: We booked our reservation for a 2-bedroom unit several months in advance for a 3-night stay to help celebrate a wedding for a long-time friend.  One day prior to arrival I called the resort to inquire about an early check-in, as we were driving 5 hours from Phoenix and we had a rehearsal dinner to attend at 5 PM in the Fremont District.  The representative said that he could not guarantee me an early check-in but to call the next day and request it at that time. He said that they start cleaning the rooms at 10 AM so it is possible the rooms may be ready before 4 PM.I called while we were driving and was told to check availability after we arrived. We arrived at the resort at 3:10 PM. Of course, our rooms were not ready. They said that one of the 2-bedroom units was clean but the 2nd side was not ready yet. I was told they would call us when the rooms were ready. My wife & I retrieved our luggage from our car & waited in lobby. There was a long line at the counter & I could see that the clerk was busy. After 15 minutes with no updates, I got back in line & approached the counter. The status was the same and it was now 3:30. I asked for a house key so that we could at least use the restrooms. I again explained that we needed to get ready for the wedding party & asked if we could use the room that was ready while they finished cleaning the 2nd room. Apparently, that wasn't an option Our room was finally ready around 4:20 - well beyond the 4:00 PM check-in time.The accommodations were acceptable. The resort fee is a money grab. You receive vouchers for bottled water, and they also claim that the fee also covers the ability to cast personal devices onto the TV. Well, I am very technically inclined and was unsuccessful in casting our devices. The outdoor spa was out of order. They did direct us to their sister property on the strip to use their spa, which we did. However, that also meant driving over there, getting a parking pass, then going to the counter to get a key to the pool area. That’s a bit of a hassle and significant inconvenience.There is a store on site that carried a nice variety of items. However, the store closes for the day at 2 PM – I guess nobody ever needs anything after 2 PM.I am a gold member of both Hilton & Marriott, & have been a timeshare owner for 22 years. I have experienced a broad spectrum of venues. I expected better from Hilton Grand Vacation. This was a very average experience, more in line with a hotel property than a resort.

reviews.title: wonderful hotel
reviews.text: The hotel had a very friendly staff and helped us checked in, we arrived a bit late into Vegas and they helped us out, Nice amenities and made us feel comfortable with or stay, Would stay again and the pool was warm

reviews.title: No help
reviews.text: the front desk was not able to help with any information in transportation available   Resort fee of 25 dollars was not warranted. Found out bus information on my own.  Also the monorail was a great way to go, but researched it myself.

reviews.title: Do yourself a favor, stay here!!
reviews.text: This Hilton hotel was so comfortable, it was like a small apartment!  Full kitchen, the most comfortable bed I have ever slept on!  Perfect for families visiting Vegas!!!  No casino which was nice, I can go to strip and Gamble and come back to my hotel and actually rest!!!

reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We had a great stay at this property.  The unit was clean, comfortable and well decorated.   All the staff were helpful, friendly, professional and efficient.  We called the front desk several times for items or assistance and our requests were handled quickly and efficiently.   The hotel is a 10 minute walk from the monorail which we used daily.   We did use Uber and taxis several nights to come back from the strip.  We cooked/ate breakfast and snacks everyday in our unit.   Even though we spent money on transportation to and from the strip we saved more money not having to eat breakfast out everyday.   We would stay at this property again.

reviews.title: Back Again!
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay with the family!This is one of 3 grand Hilton’s we always stay at while in VegasOther two flamingo and Las Vegas blvd Hilton’s are also great place to stay!Convenience of parking excellent!10/10

reviews.title: In Vegas to visit friends.
reviews.text: A short three day stay to visit friends -- appreciated that the location was not on the strip. The rooms were clean and the beds were comfortable. However, the rooms do not come with a well-stocked bar.

reviews.title: Easy Access to Attractions!
reviews.text: Nice resort located close to the strip, monorail within walking distance and other casinos also within walking distance. Loved the 2 bedroom suite with bedrooms on each side of the living/kitchen area makes privacy when traveling with other adult family members. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Too many extra fees
reviews.text: The property is nice but there are too many fees associated with it. There’s a $25 fee per night for a resort fee and a $49 fee for staying less than a week. It is off the strip and not a lot to do around there unless you have a vehicle.

reviews.title: convenient to convention center
reviews.text: I stayed here while attending an event at the convention center. the room was adequate and functional though nothing to write home about. my biggest pet peeve is that they charge you an extra $25 resort fee even if you don't use a single amenity other than your room.

reviews.title: It’s a nice place to sleep
reviews.text: It’s a nice place to sleep, but nothing else to do on the property.No pool , no Jacuzzi, no bar, no restaurant and the store where you buy things closed super early.The desk told me I could Uber myself over to another resort to go swimming. There was no shuttle so I would have to pay for that $40

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This HGV location was perfect if you want to be away from the noise and activity of the strip. It is clean, well maintained, and has extremely helpful, friendly staff. The rooms are a great size, pool area very nice, and overall a very nice place to stay.

reviews.title: Short niice getaway
reviews.text: Short stay was nice.  Nice pool area.  Pretty much just slept there and walked to the Westgate Casino which was right next door.  The monorail was also very close and very convenient to get up and down the strip.

reviews.title: Great Solo Stay
reviews.text: I received an offer in February to purchase a room for 4 days and 3 nights for a phenomenal price, i was required to sit through a timeshare sales pitch, though. This place is great!  I'm not a gambler and just needed a relaxing getaway for my "non-milestone birthday". The room was great and I had a view overlooking the pool area. The King Studio is basically a kitchenette sans stove. The resort has a small grocery store, bar area, movie rental  kiosk. The pool area has a restaurant and bar area, good music, plenty of lounge chairs and tables. Its on the south end of the strip ( closer to the Sahara, Peppermill restaurant, etc.)I had a great relaxing stay

reviews.title: Cool, Calm and Comfortable
reviews.text: Another great stay at a Hilton Vacation Property in Las VegasMany folks have asked me why I stay at a Hilton property that does not have a casino, fancy pools, or fancy restaurants.  Here is why I stayed a this property:I was cheerfully greeted upon arrival by Renée at the front desk.  She made me feel welcome and she made me feel that she was happy I was staying there.The property has a smoke free environment and smoke free rooms.  The property has a low key, stress free vibe with none of the hustle and bustle you will experience at the big Casino Hotels.The one bedroom suites have full kitchens, separate bath and shower, two sinks, coffee maker, all the plates, all the utensils, dishwasher etc.  It is like being at home with staff on call to provide you whatever you may need.  The suite was spotless, the Hilton Bed and pillows were great (a usual), the bedroom is dead silent at night which affords a great nights sleep.  AC is quiet, extensive selection of cable channels, wifi is fast, hot water comes on fast.  Bath towels are large ( not as thick as other properties).  Two big screen TV’s, dining table for 4, Counter with stools, comfortable sofa, and chairs.I was in Las Vegas for an Expo, and one of my Associates was staying at the Wynn Towers, and one of my Associates was staying at the Palazzo.  Both had very nice suites with great views but they did not have the functionality or laid back feel of our suite.If you are looking for a nice 1 bedroom suite with a full kitchen and all the amenities then this is a very good choice.  It is a 5 minute Uber or Lyft ride to the Sands Convention Center, and the Westgate Hotel is right next door (5 minute walk) if you want to eat at one of the best steak houses in Las Vegas (Edge Steakhouse).  So far this is our favorite Hilton Vacation Property in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Comfortable, peaceful and relaxing
reviews.text: Enjoy staying here. The units are very comfortable and it's a great place to come home to an night after an evening on the strip. The monorail (which I highly recommend) is convenient to get to next door at the Westgate Hotel station. So after being among the crowds it's nice to come back to a place where you know you won't be woken up by noisy groups of people. The pool and hot tub are great and the resort is kept very clean. Friendly staff. So I can highly recommend this resort.

reviews.title: Clean and welcoming
reviews.text: Hotel was extremely clean, it is about  a 5-10 minute drive to the strip but it’s also nice that you don’t have extremely drunk people all over the hotel and is on the quieter side. Staff were all very friendly and helpful

reviews.title: Pizza Expo Enjoyment!
reviews.text: Joyful experience being at HGVC/Paradise Resort Adjacent To LV Convention Center and The Westgate Hotel/Casino which were both within very short walking distance and where most pleasurable time was spent daily!

reviews.title: Grand Time on Paradise!
reviews.text: We are repeat visitors to the Hilton Grand Vacations Club on Paradise in Las Vegas. The staff is very personable and helpful. The rooms are spacious and in excellent condition, and the pool, workout area and other common areas are well apportioned. Great choice every time!

reviews.title: Poop in pool
reviews.text: Went swimming in property pool only to discover that there was human feces in the pool. 3 young lifeguards thought it was funny and used an expletive to describe it while laughing. Will NEVER RETURN. Contacted management and was told that it happens often and she would be doing me a one time favor of refunding the resort fees.

reviews.title: Vegas Family Trip
reviews.text: Overall sites were good Room bed not comfy Stayed at other facilities Hilton is preferred Keep up great workmanship in current days of uncertainty with cleanliness of facilities Will likely return during vacation

reviews.title: Abbas Taghavi
reviews.text: This place is not good for travelers, the hotel dose not offer any activities or shuttles. And it is far away from restaurants and sites. No restaurant in hotel only has market place for breakfast also it is far away from any activity, if you don’t have a car I do not recommend to anybody especially if you have children.

reviews.title: No amenities, terrible pool
reviews.text: I attended a fashion convention a couple weeks ago at the Las Vegas Convention Center and my daughter and I stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise as one of the recommended hotels by the convention.The room was spacious and nice. We felt comfortable and safe and it had a fridge and coffee maker. The problem is without taking an Uber or Taxi or having a rental car there is no where, I mean no where close to walk to get groceries let along snacks. The closest gas station is quite a walk and across a busy road. We walked next door to the Westgate to get food (where Hilton suggested we go) and their cafe is only open for breakfast and lunch. Their dinner had walk up pizza place and tex-mex but high dollar and terrible. So we ended up ordering Uber Eats to bring dinner one night and the next day went exploring the city and walked from Fashion Show Mall to Margaritaville. No food at the Hilton.Secondly I really wanted a pool day with my daughter (14). She wouldn't even attempt to go over there as it looked like a scary, hot motel pool with a few loungers in the 100 degree sun. Not what I have experienced in Vegas. I felt so bad that she didn't get to enjoy a nice pool. I called down to ask if we could go to their sister resort Hilton grand on the strip as I started reading reviews but they said we could NOT use that pool. Ridiculous. I would definitely pick a different hotel if going to the convention center or anything else in Vegas. Even the Westgate has more amenities. Even across the road is a couple chain hotels with a decent pool. I spent more money on Ubers from the convention center to the Hilton due to the walk (with luggage) than I would have staying at Westgate. If you are visiting Vegas not for a convention, I would choose MGM or many of the others on the strip or Wyndham Grand Desert for a non casino hotel.

reviews.title: First Time HGVLV Experience
reviews.text: I chose the HGV at Paradise-Convention Center for its proximity to the must visit items on my LV checklist and didn’t want to stay on the strip. This place meet and exceeded my expectations and is on the top of my list for subsequent LV visits.

reviews.title: 2 day stay!
reviews.text: Very good place to stay, wish we could have stayed longer. front desk was very helpful and friendly. Best place for going to Westgate or to ride the tram.  The bed was very good to sleep in and the pool was very nice.

reviews.title: Relaxing Stay at HGV
reviews.text: Great location close to Strip,monorail station, Fashion Show Mall & excellent restaurants. We were very pleased with the roomy, well  appointed 1 bedroom suite for 4 adults. There is a nice fitness center on site. Overall great customer service!

reviews.title: Would Not Recommend
reviews.text: No amenities .. no attraction near ! Staff suggested the Westgate next door for food ,, drinks and that’s where we spent most of our time . A waste of my money… very disappointed. AC wouldn’t go down .. room very warm and never fixed . I would not recommend the Hilton Grand to anyone.

reviews.title: Las Vegas fun
reviews.text: Convenient location Was able to walk to places. Ample parking. Very close to the tramPool was so refreshing. Rooms were comfortable. Staff was very friendly. Prices were reasonable considering how expensive everything is in Vegas.

reviews.title: Family Staycation
reviews.text: Very pleased with our stay. They offered exactly what my family needed. Will definitely stay again if the need arises. Every penny was definitely worth spending. Loved that they had life guards on duty at the pool as well

reviews.title: Great location with apartment style rooms
reviews.text: Enjoyed the resort. Great location close to Westgate for Benihana’s and other restaurants. Pool was a nice size. Only had problems with WiFi outside when getting Uber/Lyft. Would definitely come here again with family and friends

reviews.title: Far away from everything
reviews.text: This hotel is far away from everything fun. The pool closes at 4:00 pm on weekdays and 6:00 pm on weekends so no chance to get in the pool after a day in the strip. Also, they charge $25 dollars per night to RCI guests which is a lot if you are staying a week, granted they let you know on the RCI website about the charges but still paying $25 dollars a day for basically nothing. The employees there were nice and the hotel seems to be under repairs or remodeling because they turned off the water for an entire day on some floors and asked people to go down to the first floor if they needed to use the toilet or shower. We were there on June 2021. I wouldn't stay there again.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Staff was friendly, the place was clean, but food was lacking. The coffee shop needs to stay open longer and there should a vending machine with snacks. A restaurant would be even better. Breakfast would be nice also.

reviews.title: Savannah Elite Basketball
reviews.text: Location was very good close to everything! Nice quiet area! I will recommend for friends and family to stay at hotel ! Staff was awesome and very kind people! I love security also made you feel very safe

reviews.title: Incompetent female lifeguards
reviews.text: Overall our stay was wondering except for the two female lifeguards that were on duty during the day! We witnessed both lifeguards in the water with a group of young boys some of which we overheard were locals!They were not paying attention to the little children throwing rocks into the pool which me and my husband went into the water to retrieve! Nor were they paying attention to the children doing backflips off the edge of the pool! Not only that...they allowed these boys to vape near the pool and letting little children under 10 years old try the vape! My husband went in to complain...after 10 minutes with no one coming out, I went in and went off! I spoke to the pool manager Bob Ryan who came out to reprimand the girls!Well the very next day...one girl was in the water floating around on the lifeguard floating device while the other laid down on towels and took a nap!I certainly would not bring children here!Now, I must applaud the Male lifeguards who did a wonderful job! The girls should be fired! I will be checking on this next year!

reviews.title: Dissatisfied customer
reviews.text: Not enough food amenities, the towels were very rough, dingy, with a grey non clean look. Low quality linen.  The temperature control on high still did not cool room..the bathroom has no exhaust fan to remove moisture from taking a shower. Left the bathroom damp. Just not a good experience, so checked out and went to a better place for the remainder of trip

reviews.title: Great Suites
reviews.text: Great place to stay if you want to be away from the casinos.  The two bedroom suites are wonderful!  They are clean, the beds are very comfortable and the living room, dining room and kitchen area is spacious.

reviews.title: Pool closes early and water shuts down Tue and Thursday
reviews.text: It’s still 105 at 6pm, but yet the pool is closed.  After 10:30am on Tue/Th water gets shut off.  You have to go to floor one to use showers and bathroom. The pool uses a portable machine for cleaning every night.  The pool doesn’t have a filtration system that cleans the pool so during a lot of use the water is not very clean.

reviews.title: UNSANITARY!! Comforter/Blanket are not changed out **this information has been confirmed by the Director of Housekeeping
reviews.text: UNSANITARY!! Comforter/Blanket are not changed out **this information has been confirmed by the Director of Housekeeping

reviews.title: Quiet and out of the hustle and bustle.
reviews.text: Last Monorail station escalator and elevator wasn’t working. I couldn’t climb stairs, so had to walk to WestGate rail station. I know it’s not your problem. Would be nice let people know closest rail station.

reviews.title: Good Stay
reviews.text: Great hotel. The pool and hot tub were great...nice and quiet. Clean rooms and very safe. Only a few things: location isn't great...nothing in the area. Food place was closed. One person at check in with people waiting. Overall not a bad experience though.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: I would definitely not stay at this hotel again. We normally stay at Airbnb’s and this stay basically solidified that being a better choice. Cons: Major concern was the noisy neighbors who were obviously throwing a party. We got scared out of our wits when people started yelling in the hallway and then banged repeatedly on our hotel door. The hotel security came up, talked with the room supposedly, but that didn’t stop the noise. Pool closed at 6pm which was a big bummer in the Las Vegas heat. Couch bed is incredibly uncomfortable and the main mattresses aren’t terribly comfortable, I’ve definitely slept on better. The walk from the parking garage to the hotel with all our stuff was bothersome as well.ProsThe kitchen did have everything we needed for cooking, even measuring cups and spoons. It’s a quick 10 minute drive to the airport. It’s very easy to jump on the Monorail (just on the other side of the parking garage) and go down to the strip.

reviews.title: No water during the day. Short pool hours. Beware
reviews.text: Other than no water and limited pool hours it is ok. Covid is a problem at 4 01pm apparently. Walking distance to strip and clean rooms. Staff was nice. Too bad they have to deal with ridiculous restrictions for guests. Will probably plan on staying elsewhere next time

reviews.title: Great stay in Paradise
reviews.text: The staff there was very friendly. The place was exceptionally clean. I remember walking in and smelling this clean fragrance. They have an amazing business room. The pool area was well kept. Good job

reviews.title: Perfection at its best
reviews.text: Enjoyed the easiness of parking my car. I really liked the pool table and the other games. The palm trees by the pool were breathtaking as I looked up to the skys. Checking in and out was very easy. The customer service was outstanding.

reviews.title: Could have been better.  (No water Tuesday and Thursdays)
reviews.text: Biggest lesson - Call ahead to make sure there is water!This stay was exceptionally disappointing for MANY reasons.While coming into our stay, I knew that the Marketplace, Starbucks, and poolside bar would not be open, (which, I ONLY knew because I called ahead to find out - I can't imagine arriving and having that information told to me) Not starting off the trip great, but I can manage.But the fact the pool CLOSED at 4 pm?? WHY??  There was no need for it to close early.  Put up a sign that says "After 4, there is no lifeguard - swim at your own risk."  It did not take over 12 hours to clean and sanitize the pool. Let's be real.The WORST PART OF THE TRIP:  We literally did not have water for two the the days of our stay which screwed up our plans royally!  How can you shut off water DURING A PANDEMIC??  All those signs that say, "Wash your hands!"  Thanks for reminding me, since I couldn't do it??  Also, to not have water until 6:30 at night??  Ridiculous.  We had made dinner reservations at 7 during the week and had to cancel them on Tuesday because the water came on so late!  Why weren't we informed this was happening??  I am sure the guy could have mentioned it when I called only two weeks before our reservation - plumbing work like that doesn't just "pop up."My favorite part was being charged a resort fee for:Unlimited internet - well, it's 2021, I would certainly hope so, you aren't a Motel 6 or some fleabag hotelTV mirroring casting and personal technology - Casting - seriously?  I mean, I guess are people actually casting, fine. It was cool I could log into my own Netflix account...but it's not like you were giving it to me for free, since it's my account?2 bottles of water a day - Well, I would certainly hope so, because YOU TURNED OFF THE WATER.unlimited local calls/toll free calls, and domestic long distance calls - is this still a thing??  Laughable.  NO ONE USES HOTEL PHONES - we ALL have cell phones.I feel like you need better reasons than those listed above to charge people $25/day. That stuff is basically worth $25/week.Positives:The staff were ALL great.  Very friendly, very helpful.  And tried their best.  You really put them in a bad situation, and they were still all smiles and very sweet.The cleanliness of everywhere was truly amazing.  Your housekeeping staff deserves a raise.  The elevators in particular were SO CLEAN.  The hallways always looked freshly vacuumed.  The fitness room was also immaculate, and I appreciated that every other machine was wrapped up to create social distancing.  I LOVED the seals on the doors - hope you keep that up in the future.The text messaging with the front desk was awesome.The Westgate has an amazing Sportsbook and is actually pretty nice - and it's walking distance.The Sahara is also walking distance...and will be nice once they are done with construction.I realize that this was probably a one time thing, but man, it was ROUGH.  I might give this location another shot, but I don't know....with all the other places to stay, we will REALLY have to think about it.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: All the staff was very welcoming and helpful. Dany went above and beyond for us. Angie was sweet too. Hotel is beautiful and rooms are clean. We loved the property and felt so welcomed. Anything we needed, they came through for us immediately. I travel a lot to Vegas for business and am a frequent hotel guest and I will definitely  be staying here again!

reviews.title: Visit During Covid Times
reviews.text: We had stayed at this property a few years ago and were impressed with it. This time has been sort of a mixed bag of experiences.  Some things the hotel has control over and some things are "Covid-related" issues that are kind of on the website.The Good:The room is spacious and nice with a nice view of the golf course.We got their early and the room was ready.Really good response time when calling down to the front desk or texting.Free WiFi.The rooms are very quiet. The BadThe room wasn't cleaned well when I checked in. I called down to the front desk and they immediately sent up the housekeeping manager and he immediately someone to reclean the room. With Covid being a thing, I just feel like cleanliness should be at a premium. The Starbucks and marketplace on site are closed. Covid.The monorail is also closed. Covid.For May and June, they cut off the water every Tuesday and Thursday from 10:30am to 6:30pm. That info isn't on the website and something I wish I had known before I made the reservation. All in all, I'd like to come again when Vegas is really open and up to speed.

reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay!!!
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and comfortable. I loved having a kitchen and some of the amenities for our week long stay. Staff were very friendly, responsive and accommodating. We will definitely come back to a Hilton Grand Vacation resort.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: If you are looking for a great property off the strip but in a great location, stay at HGVC on Paradise.  The rooms were clean and comfortable with all the amenities that you would need.  Parking is very close and easily accessible.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Not a happy stay
reviews.text: I usually give this location a five star rating but this time I gave it a three star rating.Reasons for this rating:Kitchen supplies such as dishes, coffee cups etc were not clean or sanitary like they were supposed to be.No bell service available during Check-in or checkout. Guests not allowed to use luggage carts anymore.Water is shut off on Tuesdays and Thursdays between late morning and late afternoon during May and June.This was a surprise to us at Check-in. HGVC should mention these inconsistencies on the website prior to making reservations.I do not blame the actual property staff for this as they are always outstanding. I believe that corporate needs to step up.

reviews.title: Beware...
reviews.text: The water is not available for eight hours on Tuesdays and Thursdays b through June We found out at check in. We definitely would have stayed somewhere else had we known. No showers, toilets, or cooking.  We were going to use the pool but it closes at 4 and we couldn't shower off until after 6:30.

reviews.title: Sister Retreat
reviews.text: The condo was the perfect size for the 3 of us. We traveled during COVID so weren’t able to enjoy all the amenities. Close to the strip easy Uber ride. When things return to normal easy walking distance to a tram stop.

reviews.title: Getaway in Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was excellent. The staff was courteous and efficient, the unit was beautiful,. Everything in it's place. The location is great; away from the strip but close enough to get there in a few minutes. If you are looking for a unique dining experience, check out Zuma in the Cosmopolitan. We had the Chef's Selection.

reviews.title: Stress after check in
reviews.text: As a new member of Welk Resorts this was first booking using my points.  I was given a very small old musky smelling room. At check in (room site unseen) I asked for a complimentary upgrade, but was told  I would have to call RCI.  I took my initial room and upon entering saw it was closet size and not satisfactory.  RCI said basically it is what it is and to go back to check in for upgrade.  Been there done that.  I happened to talk to someone else at checkin (seemingly a manager/Dany Rodas) who was one of the most understanding helpful person.  He accomodated me with an upgrade to a 100% better room.  The rest of the stay there was Excellent.

reviews.title: The paradise in paradise
reviews.text: The staff is quite friendly and accommodating. They resolve issues quickly. By the far, the best hotel I have ever stand in and I travel a lot. Brandon, at the front desk, is an exceptional employee. He went out of his way to make the stay as pleasant as possible.

reviews.title: Great Hilton Experience!!
reviews.text: This was our first trip since getting vaccinated & we were very pleased with our stay at the Hilton on Paradise🥰We were greeted by friendly, helpful staff daily as we checked in & passed through the lobby each day. Strict Covid protocols were in place😷including sanitized sealed rooms👍We felt safe & comfortable. Thank you Hilton 🥰

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: The staff was amazing especially LeeAnn at the front desk. The only reason for the 4 stars is because the pool closed at 4pm which in my opinion was way too early. By the time we were done with taking the kids around we got back n the pool was closed.

reviews.title: Excellent Staff
reviews.text: Friendly staff, excellent customer service, knowledgeable of surrounding area for good suggestions, small room but very comfortable beds.  I wish they had some food, breakfast or complimentary snacks since but nothing is offered due to COVID or reduce price

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at the Hilton.  Nice break away from the casino madness.  Absolutely huge rooms, twice the size of an overpriced London hotel room as a comparison and it includes a kitchen.Great location, good sized pool.  Will stay again.

reviews.title: Nice and clean
reviews.text: We really like to stay here. The resort is clean and well kept. The parking lot is huge and so easy to find a space. The staffs are nice and helpful. We definitely come back next time. It's family friendly and away from the strip.

reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.text: We made last minute reservation and we were pleasantly surprised. Definitely will come back. The room was supremely comfortable. We will comeback for a couples getaway. Or maybe for a group of friends to celebrate someone’s birthday

reviews.title: Tragically disappointing
reviews.text: Pros: Location close to The Strip but not on The Strip, rooms are basic but nice.Cons: Rooms are nice but basic, unruly guests and a lack of attention from HGV corporate offices combined to make this a terrible experience (and the same could happen to you).(I should note part of the one-star rating for this property has to do with my growing dissatisfaction with the Hilton Grand Vacations ownership experience. This review is not meant as a commentary of our timeshare ownership but instead be read as a warning: the problems we experienced are ones that potentially affect all guests.)We took advantage of HGV's "open season" for a last-minute long weekend in Las Vegas, believing that sticking with a Hilton Grand Vacations resort was a better alternative to rolling the dice (pun somewhat intended) on another area hotel. We liked the idea of something close to The Strip but not directly on The Strip and when we arrived were happy to see the property was in a quiet area but still within a very short drive of many popular attractions.We usually stay in studio rooms (they're the cheapest, and they're all we usually need) and ours looked the same as those in many other HGV resorts- clean and pleasant accommodations on par with mid-tier hotels like Hampton Inns and Marriott Courtyards. It was fine for our four-night stay, especially because being in Vegas usually means not spending time in a hotel room.On the third night of our stay we entered our room and were greeted by the loud yelling and booming music of a party next door (it was NYE weekend so the noise was a little understandable, but overwhelmingly bothersome nonetheless). Assuming the group probably wouldn't respond to being told to quiet down we asked to switch rooms and were quickly accommodated- fine, except for the fact that we had to pack up the contents of our room, move it across the building, and settle all over again somewhere else). Unfortunately we were given another room with another equally-loud group of guests checking in next door. This is part of the problem with all HGV properties- because every room has a door connecting it to another, things like voices, music, and even unpleasant kitchen smells travel easily from one to another. In this case it meant noisy neighbors being a huge disruption.Taking into account it's Vegas where people are known to party and behave boisterously, the experience nonetheless highlights an unpleasant aspect of these HGV timeshare properties: when rooms are available, they are sold at the last minute for rock-bottom prices. Good if you're spontaneous and looking for something cheap; bad if you value neighbors who are respectful (because let's face it, non-HVC guests getting a room at the last possible minute have no reason to behave like respectful timeshare owners). Never mind the fact that upon booking, we were explicitly told the building was essentially empty and would remain so throughout the holiday weekend because it wouldn't be packed with guests.The issue boils down to having been promised one thing about the property and discovering the opposite to be true. The first two nights of our stay were nice, and the second two were a noisy, disrupted nightmare (which was even more troublesome because we had to wake up early for a flight home). Be warned if you find timeshare properties like these available for cheap at the last minute, and please don't be the kind of guest that ruins the experience for everyone else.

reviews.title: Fantastic and I hope to come again
reviews.text: This was a great hotel and fantastic room! They gave us option of which view we would like at check in. The bed was very comfortable. The entire suite was absolutely perfect for us and I was pleased with our stay and will be staying there when I come into town again!

reviews.title: worst sleep ever!!!
reviews.text: I always book with Hilton or Hilton branded hotels. I checked out of the Hilton Grand Vacation on the Las Vegas Blvd and spent our last night at this Hotel and regretted it. I paid over $150 for a horrible nights rest.I feel like I could have paid for a 2 or 3 star Hotel and would have gotten better sleep. The room was very small and yet the A/C unit couldn’t cool it down. The sink in the kitchenette made gargling sounds all night long even my children spoke about it the next morning. They did offer to come up but at that point we were packing our luggage and getting dressed. I was very irritated and upset I woke up at 4 am and just left the room and drove around because I couldn’t sleep!!!

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: I pay my RCI fee then I got charge resort fee and if you want to get your room clean it’s another fee. Ridiculous I probably could stay at the Caesar palace for cheaper price. Not worth it. I understand COVID but nothing was open in the resort pool only from 11 to 4!

reviews.title: No food
reviews.text: Hard to get transportation from this hotel and had no food not even breakfast items but other than that super clean , friendly and beautiful spacious rooms would like to stay again if they had food in the hotel

reviews.title: The worst Hilton in Vegas
reviews.text: My family was treated poorly at this hotel. As a diamond member, this Hilton is by far the worst I’ve encountered. My flight was going to be delayed so I called a few days ahead of time to make sure that my sister can check in for me. The employee told me that she could and that she would put a note in. On check-in day, it’s my mother’s bday, they drove hours to vegas, I’m in the middle of work and I got a call from my sister that they got sent away. It was Dany Rodas who rudely sent them away. Ironically, he is the guest services manager. When I spoke to him he was very unsympathetic, rude, and unhelpful even after telling him my situation and how I called ahead of time. I had to give him solutions (i.e. emailing my ID, confirming my identity when I fly down). Poor management on his part because (1) if checking in is strict, then he should’ve trained his employees about the policy so I am not given misinformation when I called ahead of time, (2) as a manager, he should be the one giving me solutions to resolve the miscommunication his employees made. I will not have my family be treated this way like this is some 1star hotel. It literally ruined my mom’s day and I am very very embarrassed I chose to stay here. When I landed in Vegas all I heard were complaints about this hotel. They put them on the second floor in the worst room! My sister was on hold for 15mins requesting for a towel so she just hung up and never got one. There’s a loud compressor noise at night. It’s like they retaliated on the fact that I fought for what’s right. The whole experience was just bad!It is very disappointing that this happened. This is like a 1star hotel. This is the first time I stayed at a Hilton while in Vegas because of the points I accrued. Had I known the service is going to be this bad I should’ve just stayed at a hotel by the strip because I also have memberships in other hotel groups. I will not recommend to anyone especially to my fellow diamond members.

reviews.title: I highly recommend this beautiful hotel!
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at this beautiful hotel during my stay in Las Vegas. I love the location, it was very relaxing to get away from the strip yet still close. The room was beautiful, very spacious, comfortable bed, beautiful view. The hotel staff was very kind and attentive. The cleanliness of this hotel was perfect. I highly recommend this!

reviews.title: My Go To Place -- a Few Missteps This Visit
reviews.text: Due to my work here this is normally my go-to place as staff is accommodating, location is easy to access and rooms are quite nice and comfortable.  The TV's ability to stream is one of the easiest and much appreciated.  This time room had a couple of issues and the staff provided me 10,000 points to offset the challenges.  The ice machine in the frig did not work and for the entire stay the water pressure in the shower was non-existent and reminded me of the Seinfeld episode.  The rooms are well maintained, large and comfortable and when everything works right it is worth 5-stars; this time not so much.  Will still be my go-to hotel when I come back and hope everything works right.  I am a Hilton Diamond member going on 11 Years.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time at this property
reviews.text: I’ve been a Hilton Diamond-level member for 7 years. I recently stayed at this property and was misled with respect to the amenities that were available, such as: on site cafe, restaurant, laundry facilities in most suites. When I arrived I found the cafe was closed a year ago, and the same for other creature comforts, too. The in-room laundry room was locked and I was told they were not available. I had to walk to the Westgate hotel to get coffee. How pathetic is that! Hilton Corp and their franchise owners love their Honors members and their loyalty, but trust me, this is just another instance where loyalty is not reciprocal. I cannot find where in their literature where they give the current state of the hotel due to COVID. It’s time to look for another business partner for my company.

reviews.title: Quality Resort
reviews.text: Great location, easy access to all Vegas has to offer. The resort Is very nice and the staff is friendly and helpful. I prefer to stay off the strip, close to everything yet nice and quiet at resort.  Very easy parking.

reviews.title: Happy Place
reviews.text: Love staying here at this beautiful and very well maintained property. Great location. Close to strip but still far enough away from crowds. Super close to monorail too which makes it super easy to get around. Staff is super friendly and always ready to help.

reviews.title: Staying off the Strip
reviews.text: We needed a change of scenery, so we left LA to spend a week in Las Vegas. To stay away from crowds during the pandemic, we chose the HGVC on Paradise. This is the fourth HGVC we’ve stayed at in LV. The room was identical to a standard HGVC unit. We stayed in a 1 br: king bed, full kitchen, dining table for 4, large soaking tub, separate shower, washer/dryer, and double sinks in the bathroom. For Covid sanitization protocol, housekeeping runs all of the dinnerware, flatware, cups, and glasses in the dishwasher between guests. It took us a bit to realize they were in there. One thing that stood out was the TV and its remote. It allows guests to log into their streaming services easily and clear all passwords at the end of your stay with one click. The hotel is far from the Strip. Although it is next to the Westgate resort, it’s still a bit far. I do encourage anyone to checkout the Westgate Sportsbook. We had a car, so leaving the resort to find food was easy.

reviews.title: family vacation
reviews.text: we have a pleasant stay friendly staff location is close to everything ,the strip, grocery and anything we need during our stay we are looking forward to stay again for our future vacation. hope to see u soon again

reviews.title: Would stay there again once COVID19 is gone!!
reviews.text: It's a great hotel and everyone there was friendly and assisted us. If you do not want to stay on Las Vegas strip this location is great.  If you have a vehicle the location is not far from the strip. The hotel is very clean and the bed was very comfortable. At some point when everything is open we would stay there again!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: My husband stayed here while celebrating our anniversary. The room was very clean and spacious. Checking in and out were both easy and fast. The check in agent was kind and courteous. We really enjoyed our stay

reviews.title: Repeat visit
reviews.text: This is my preferred hotel in Vegas. And now with Covid it makes more sense than ever. This hotel is not on the strip and one bedroom units have there own kitchen, washer dryer. The pool is clean and quiet. The staff is professional and friendly.What you should know before booking: housekeeping is up to you for now, the pool is closed Tues & Wed and the store/deli is closed. You def. need a car for Trader Joes runs. The reason I can't give 5 stars this time is with the pool closed on Wed. I was directed to go to Westgate to use their pool. Westgate was crowded, no one was wearing masks outside the pool. Then a kid threw up in the pool. After that I was out in a flash. If the Hilton staff suggests Westgate pool don't go. It's yucky but I can't exactly fault Hilton for this.That said - I would go back to Hilton on Paradise. Thanks.

reviews.title: Close to strip and Convention, but nothing in Vegas this summer.
reviews.text: This resort is a nice place, clean and pretty convenient. Unfortunately, Vegas is not fully open and things to do were quite limited.  I was hoping for pool time during the 108 degree summer weather, but pools are limited in number and hours :(.  But, when Vegas does open up again, I would return to this resort.  We are not gamblers, so location to other casinos is not a priority, but this resort is on the north end of the strip.  Many restaurants were also closed, but there are many if you can travel to them.

reviews.title: Our Wedding Stay at the Hilton
reviews.text: We arrived June 7th for 4 nights and stayed 6 nights .The staff were all fantastic ,with special thanks to Dany who greeted us on arrival like long lost friends ,and set up our perfect stay . Also special thanks to the lovely lady who took our pictures in the lobby as we set off to get married . It was a wonderful trip and your staff were a big part of making it the trip to remember .Thank you Neil and Dijana

reviews.title: Off strip, quiet and next door to the Westgate. Good free parking.
reviews.text: We stayed in a two bedroom for a week. We found it quiet with lots of free parking if you are staying there. We were at a convention or would have opted for someplace closer to the strip. We liked the short walk to the Westgate which is beautiful with live music every night. Don’t look for food after 10 p.m. unless you go to the Sports Bar at the Westgate. Also there are many shows there, reasonably priced. The pool at the Hilton Vacation Club is like a parking lot pool - not fancy but nice and clean area. We opted for cleaning 1/2 way through our week and I hate to say this but one of my cosmetics went missing afterwards. The monorail is right there so you can get a day pass or more and get to the strip easily. Best place to stay during a convention.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacation at Paradise is a very nice resort.  Very clean and the staff was excellent.  The mattress left something to be desired and the non-down pillows were flat as pancakes.  Other than than it is a nice place to stay.  Didn't get to use the pool because it was to cool during the week which surprised me for Vegas.

reviews.title: Awesome stay!
reviews.text: Awesome stay, friendly staff, very responsive and helpful and far enough away from the strip to be able to sleep! It was a quick 10ish minute uber ride. The marketplace was incredibly convenient and appreciated :)

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: This is a wonderful resort to come relax, relieve some stress, and catch up on some needed rest. Bathroom, kitchen, master bedroom, guest room, living room, etc. is very clean. Great place to come back to after a long night out on the strip, such as the excess smoking and gambling can become overwhelming. Beautiful lighting when opening the curtains, also if you want to sleep in it stays nice and dark. Controlling temperature interesting, their is one in the kitchen and both bedrooms. Overall this place is a 10/10 for me.

reviews.title: Recommend the hotel, but was hard to find
reviews.text: Recently spent five nights at this hotel and would recommend the one-bedroom unit with a full kitchen where you can cook your own breakfast. The room was spacious and comfortable and parking was free. Walking distance to the convention center and Westgate and near the Monorail. It was difficult to find the first night as there is no name on the building and the Hilton sign near the entrance is small. Would enjoy staying here again. We were invited to attend an ownership presentation and got free tickets to see Vegas, the Show!

reviews.title: A Very Nice Stay
reviews.text: Great off north strip location. Easy rail and highway accessibility. Friendly staff and clean rooms. The pool and spa were under seasonal maintenance and, as a result, the resort fees were appropriately adjusted.  Thanks, Dany.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: This property is at the North end of the strip, near the Strat.  Much quieter, but still has easy access to all of Vegas.  Not as luxurious as the Elara, but very comfortable and had a very nice time. I'd recommend this for anyone wanting a nice stay.

reviews.title: Nice friendly staff
reviews.text: The staff was very professional, accommodating and easy check in and check out.  I had a package delivered while I was staying and it was waiting for me when I arrived. The room was clean and had all the amenities.  We will be back.

reviews.title: A far walk to the strip!
reviews.text: Uber fares to mid strip will run about $8-$9.  There are two Hilton’s in the same area which causes some confusion with Uber drivers.  $19.00 Uber fare to the airport. No frills just adequate.  No close restaurants and pretty far down away from anything walkable especially at night.  Even a 15-20 walk to the tram.

reviews.title: Hilton Honors Stay
reviews.text: Great location and wonderful staff. Priscilla was the best from check in to check out. The level of security is excellence also. I highly recommend this location for families, couples, and even business needs.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was great. The room was excellent with separate sections: king size bed for parents and pull-out sleetping sofa for the kids. Also with washer/dryer in the room. Excellent WiFi. Huge fridge/freezer. And very nice bathtub, which fits two persons :-)

reviews.title: Pool area  under maintenance
reviews.text: Staff was very helpful and efficient, unit is well appointed. When I booked through RCI I was told there is daily $25 resort fee and I agreed to it. Upon arrival I was told pool is under maintenance and if I wish to use pool I will have to go to nearby sister properties. That was inconvenient and not acceptable. I asked front desk to remove or to reduce daily resort fee since I am not going to be able to enjoy pool. I am rehabbing knee and daily  pool excersisess are important for rehab. My request was denied, and honestly I was not I a mood to fight it and to ruin my vacation. I would never schedule vacation at this resort if I knew pool is not usable. To add insult to the injury when I received bill in email I noticed that in addition to the resort fee they charged me daily tax. I was not told by RCI during reservation, or by front desk during check in about daily tax. My RCI exchange fee should cover any taxes, this is first time that any resort is charging tax for time share exchange.To summarize it, they should be transparent about pool under construction during reservation process, and if they don't inform guest about any non functioning amenities they should be willing and able to compensate guest. In this case removing daily resort fee should be appropriate compensation, bottom line is that I was not able to use all resort amenities, and they charged full resort fee every day and then they added tax to the bill.

reviews.title: Home Away From Home
reviews.text: If you are planning a vacation with some quiet time, want to skip the casino floor to get to your room, the Hilton Grand vacation on Paradise is the ideal place for you. Far enough, but close enough to everything. If you want to ditch the car, you can hop on the monorail and you are in the center of the action in minutes. Hotel staff is exceptional, just like at any other Hilton venues. They know a thing or two about hospitality.

reviews.title: Disappointed HGVC Owner/Not Vegas Experience
reviews.text: At the time of my reservation it was not noted that the pool area was under construction and thus not available. Facility is clean but lacks the amenities of many of the other locations. No extra services at this location and while they offer Elara as a replacement they don it have a shuttle service. Large scale power outage hit the building the last night we were there and it took a long time for generators to kick on. Front desk staff never called or reached out to guests to at least inform them of protocol. When we called they seemed kind of oblivious to the fact that people may be alarmed. My room had a burning smell that was coming from the closet, especially after the power outage. This was never addressed or looked into. Overall was disappointed and wouldn’t have wasted my points on this location. Not as close to strip as they would have you believe. $8 Uber to next closest resort and $12-$14 Uber to strip. Monorail is close. Neighborhood isn’t in my opinion walkable at night of you’re a woman.

reviews.title: GREAT STAY!
reviews.text: The rooms were very clean. All staff were helpful & treated me well. I really liked that there were no slot machines around the lobby or in the hallways, etc. The pool & pool area are kept clean & neat.

reviews.title: Sunny Las Vegas
reviews.text: Was a lovely, quiet, well equipped 2 bdrm suite perfectly situated near the monorail for access to the casinos and restaurants. Our only complaint was that we were not notified that the pool and jacuzzi were out of service for resurfacing and we were still charged the complete activity fee for our stay.

reviews.title: Great property
reviews.text: Great hotel conveniently located, easy to park and get in and out of the room.  Great maid service with really clean comfortable rooms.  The mattresses are ok, could be a little plusher but overall nice place if you don't want to walk through a crowded casino to get to your room.

reviews.title: Super noisy !!!
reviews.text: Super noisy no privacy at all and they charge 6 dollars for water bottles so if you want quick coffe and don't want to pay 6 bucks for a water bottle use tap water. Towels were super low quality felt like sandpaper on the skin.

reviews.title: Good Times
reviews.text: For those who like visiting the LV strip but not staying there the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise by the Convention Center is perfect. You get five star treatment and amenities and a lovely new site. I have been there at least six times with my wife, it's great.

reviews.title: Seattle,WA
reviews.text: By the time we checked in the staffs are very helpful and always smile/friendly even the housekeeping has a good attitude. Our room are clean and spacious. Importantly our room doesnt smell cigarette or smoke. All the kitchen appliances are all updated. The bed are comfortable and pillows are perfectly soft. The location is great. Kids friendly place and no slots machine in the hotel because not everyone come to Las Vegas like to gamble.

reviews.title: Business stay was perfect.
reviews.text: We thought the location and value were excellent. Definitely suggest the suite for the full kitchen capabilities and tub. The tub came in handy to soak in after a long day of walking at the convention center.

reviews.title: Very upset
reviews.text: My daughters went down to the gift shop to buy something and was so racially discriminated against we left early . She was told she needed id to make a purchase with her credit card but the following girl behind us did not need id and I asked her and she immediately apologized

reviews.title: Soccer weekend
reviews.text: The location of the property was close to the soccer fields making it easy to access.  Being able to eat in the hotel instead of eating out also mad a huge difference financially also not having to here kids running up and down the hallways like other hotels have to deal with.

reviews.title: 5-star recommended
reviews.text: Extremely pleased with everything. Only recommendation would be that the Marketplace stay open until 2am for those on business trips that would need a small bite to eat.  No complaints at all.  Would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.title: Extremely Nice Resort Off the Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: The resort and the room was exceptional.  All the staff was friendly and courteous.  Conceirge was pleasant, but misquoted a spa price and didn't attempt to fix the issue.  Disappointed in their lack of effort for the customer.

reviews.title: Comfortable and quiet
reviews.text: We stay here when visiting relatives in Las Vegas.  It is convenient to the strip but not in the middle of all the hustle & bustle.  With no gaming facilities it is quiet and family friendly. Our trips a flexible, so we search the Hilton site for best pricing, and get a great rate on 1-br. 750 sq. ft. suite with full kitchen. While they have implemented a $25 resort fee, parking is free.

reviews.title: Mischarging
reviews.text: I am beyond disappointed in the application of an unreimburseable "Resort Fee" that was not included in the advertised room rate.  I can't believe that there was a charge attached to every room that was not advertised in the room rate.  I booked based on USG per diem requirements, and learned of the additional "Resort Fee" applied to every room only upon checkout, when it was too late to do anything about it.  So much for Hilton Honors loyalty.  I was screwed for my loyalty!

reviews.title: My favorite place to stay in Vegas.
