reviews.text: If you’re traveling to Vegas with family this is your resort. Clean, non smoking, rooms are exceptional and the value can’t be beat. Minutes from the strip. I don’t stay anywhere else. They have a game room and really well stocked store, save tons of money making your own food in the room with all the amenities you need. Parking is a breeze. Couldn’t get better.

Clean room, updated and spacious. Friendly and helpful staff. Would recommend it for any families that are staying one night or a few days. We only stayed as we were passing through Las Vegas on a road trip to California but helped us get quality rest during our travel.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Nice hotel with good hard and soft equipments. People work there are nice and very helpful.If I will travel there again, I will live this hotel again.Their Suite has small kitchen but it has all I need.

reviews.title: short business trip
reviews.text: Hotel was very nice, check in was easy and stafff at check in very courteous. Follow up with text messages asking if everything was good and the qualitiy of the stay. The hotel has a market and internet lounge would made it very suitable for evenings and mornings for kids to play or do other activities. Enjoyed the stay

reviews.title: Huge apart-room
reviews.text: Stayed 30 and 31st December to take in Vegas New year. Room is really a 1 bed apartment with a double sofa bed in living area. It is huge even had a washer /drier which I used.  Good water pressure on the shower - I detest a limp shower!It has huge free car park so parking was no problem. It is just off the strip towards the Stratosphere. It is a  5 -10 minute walk to monorail station down a well lit path, which felt totally safe. Probably could walk to Strat from this hotel.  Monorail is a good way to get around the strip if you do not have a car. Buy the tickets on line to get a discount and get the QR coded ticket on your phone. The hotel has everything you need and staff are friendly and attentive- and no line at reception.  It does not have a Casino- phew, but the hotel 5-10 minutes walk away does if you need one.I moved to The Paris for 1st January when the prices had dropped, to experience the Strip... so I can make a comparison....The Paris is more centrally located but very impersonal and the walk from the car park to reception through the hotel is almost as far as the walk to the monorail when staying at the Hilton.  As with most of the hotels on the strip waiting in a line at reception seems to the norm.  I would employ more staff !  Would I stay again (at the Hilton). Yes  (probably would have booked all 3 nights there if I had known what I was getting)   Was the location a problem - No (possibly a benefit)

reviews.title: Be warned; hot tub closes at 6 pm!
reviews.text: Pros: Nice place, great staff and fun games to play on main floor lobby area.  Cons: Pool hours 10 am- 6 pm; deli does not accept cash, studio bathroom - teeny tiny. Literally lock the gates to pool at 6 pm so you can not even go down and sit to enjoy outside area.

reviews.title: Unless you only want a bed, do not stay at HGV on Karen Ave
reviews.text: Uncomfortable LR chair. No DVD player. Woefully inadequate kitchen. Barriers to autos and pedestrians in parking garage making parking and accessing the HGV challenging. Whirlpools have been removed from rooms. Sparce instructions for items provided. Language problems of staff.  Example, ask for teapot and tea bags, get tea pot and plastic trash bags.

reviews.title: Nice clean place to stay
reviews.text: We had family in the hospital so wanted somewhere close but nice, this was the best option. It's a bit of a walk if you want to get to the strip but we liked the quite time when trying to sleep. Enjoy

reviews.title: Family time
reviews.text: Excellent for a quick family get away.  The room was awesome and easy for travel. We could walk or take the tram almost anywhere. Parking was convenient at the Westgate. The staff was friendly and housekeeping was prompt and brought me more than I thought I needed. Then I used it all....Excellent family vacation

reviews.title: Perfect Family Vacation
reviews.text: It's Perfect for Families to stay and relax, it's close enough to the BLVD to enjoy and far enough from the BLVD to enjoy family time. The staff are professional and very knowledgeable of Shows and of Events around Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Property Just North of Strip
reviews.text: This property is in the perfect location in my opinion. It is a 5-7 minute walk from the monorail and the ride to the center of the strip is about 12 minutes. Unless you are staying in a hotel with no intention of leaving, getting in and out of this place is much easier to visit areas outside the strip. Extremely clean and well-maintained with a year-round heated pool and Jacuzzi. The fitness room was well equipped with modern, well-maintained equipment (treadmill, free weights, universal, etc.). The room has great bedding and a large smart TV with per-installed Hulu, Netflix, and Youtube. There are plenty of USB charging ports and a charging pad for your phone. Room has a safe, fridge, wet bar, and eating utensils There is a deli and convenient store but the prices are what you would expect in Vegas. This is a nice quiet place to rest after all the hoopla of the strip. We explored several areas outside the strip and got in and out very easy. There is a Walmart and other off-strip shopping within 10-15 minutes. Staff was pleasant on check-in and check-out. The only small complaint I have is the unexpected text messages I received from the hotel thanking me for "verbally agreeing" to receive text messages. I did no such thing and the front desk only asked for my cell phone but never mentioned anything about text messages (I would not have agreed). Opting out was easy, but I would have appreciated being asked, which is what the federal law contemplates. I would definitely stay here again but will likely decline my cell phone number.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: Don’t be surprised if you love this place. Very accommodating, very friendly,very clean, and the rooms are spacious and very nice. Plenty of free parking outside or inside, very helpful if you want to go see any shows, and the shuttle bus will take you were you want to go and also pick you up to bring you back.

reviews.title: HGVC (Hilton Grand vacation club)
reviews.text: Great Hotel for HGVC .Great service and clean. What I love about this hotel was the customer service was great. When you asking for service there's no hesitations they will do it immediately. I will book in a wrong room, and the manager named Danny help me to change it to one bedroom apartments. He went out of his way and make that happen and make sure my side of my satisfaction is met.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Room is too small and location is far from strip. No proper acknowledgement from front desk regarding any issues or complaints. Need much better experience than this. There is no restaurant at this location and only one small cafe. You need to go out for food. There is major road construction going on which may be a problem at this point of time

reviews.title: Nice off the strip Hilton Property
reviews.text: Place was nice and Clean.  Staff was friendly at anytime of day that we came in.  Has a little store/cafe that can get you snacks or light breakfast.  The room was nice, I have booked the two room with a living room between.  Was very nice only thing wrong with the whole thing was they forgot to empty the trash in the kitchen but was taken care of right away.  If you are looking to be on the strip this is not the place to stay it is more between the strip and old Vegas.  We used alot of ubers seemed to be cheaper then the cabs.

reviews.title: Excellent and Quiet Vegas Facility But Has High Resort Fees
reviews.text: This Hilton was a very pleasant, quiet, clean and good location place to stay in Vegas.  The Strip railway has a stop at one corner of the property so it made visiting different casinos and restaurants on the Strip very easy and hassle free.  However there were a few items that bugged me.1.  This hotel is over 20 years old with many remodels however they never touched or upgraded the plumbing.  The kitchen plumbing frequently backed up even though we threw every bit of food in the garbage can.  Throwing buckets of boiling water down the drain helped but the hotel should have a thorough cleaning of their kitchen drains.2.  The daily resort fee of $30 a DAY is excessive to me given I had already had to pay a high price with RCI points and RCI fees.  There was the normal amount of amenities like pool, spa, workout room, pool table that other non fee charging RCI facilities have.  There was nothing extraordinary where I felt a daily resort fee was warranted.  3.  Internet/wifi service was part of the resort fee and the internet connection was fair.  Frequently their internet was overloaded and my browsing was very slow.  I was very disappointed especially since they charged me for this service.

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: I am a Hilton honors member and went for the tour to be an owner. This is exclusively for Honors members and i have never been treated like that. 3yrs stayed over 100 nights total. Totally did not feel welcome

reviews.title: Couldn't Ask For More!
reviews.text: From arrival to departure, this was a wonderful resort stay. We arrived a few hours before check in time and our room was ready and waiting. The resort was immaculate, friendly and helpful staff, great view of the city and the mountains, comfy bed, wonderful pillows, very tastefully decorated rooms and everything was well maintained. We had a 2 bedroom unit, which in this case is a 1-bedroom suite with full kitchen adjoining a hotel room with wet bar, 2 queen beds, microwave and mini fridge.  It was wonderful.  It's right next door to the Westgate resort and a couple of blocks from the Sahara.  Both places have nice bars and restaurants and you can catch the monorail from both places.  This was the nicest timeshare resort we've stayed at and we would highly recommend it to anyone looking to be in Vegas and not directly on the strip.

reviews.title: Great people. Lackluster property.
reviews.text: The staff was great, but we never were able to see anybody at the experiences desk. The pool hours are too short. The rooms are very small and we could hear the people in the next room through the adjoining doorway. They forgot to shuttle us from there to the flagship property for the vacation package sales pitch. There is no bar or restaurant, just a grocery store and coffee/sandwich cafe.

reviews.title: Ehhhh...
reviews.text: I booked two different rooms here and both were not up to par at check in. The first room had hair and dust everywhere things weren’t wiped down well so they switched the room no problem and gave me a $25 credit which was great cause I was not expecting it. The other room was nice and clean except for the tub was clogged and every morning I had to take a shower/bath because the water wouldn’t drain when taking a shower. The next day I speak to my mother in-law and she says the bathroom was not clean at all and shows me clumps of black hair they found in the bathroom and garbage that wasn’t ours in the garbage can. The Day after I text the front desk and tell them about the other room and they say we see you have a $25 dollar credit on your room already Which was from the screw up on the first room and apologized but nothing was done. Last but not least there was no warning that an alarm test would be conducted and it went off excessively and was extremely disturbing overall experience was disappointing

reviews.title: A Great Grand Vacation
reviews.text: I believe that the first 30 seconds when you meet somebody sets the tone for the whole experience. Maria was a wonderful person when she handled our check in. Smart, friendly and very professional. Our room was clean, nicely updated and well stocked. The room was well lit with a very nice flat screen television, The beds were very comfortable with soft linen, The Hilton Grand Vacations property is nicely landscaped. The parking is free which is a big plus. This place is fantastic. I truly enjoyed my stay here and have decided to make this a "go to" hotel when I have business or needs in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice quiet hotel
reviews.text: Stayed here for five nights in a one-bedroom suite.  We also had family members staying in a separate studio room.  Check-in was smooth and staff were friendly.  In fact, all of the staff members we encountered throughout our stay were courteous and friendly.  The one-bedroom suite was clean and spacioius. It had a full kitchen, but we didn't use anything except the microwave and refrigerator.  All of the appliances were clean, which was nice.  The hotel is off the strip so not near many restaurants or casinos.  The nearest casino is the Westgate, about a 5 minute walk away.  The monorail to the Strip is also about a 5 minute walk away.  The Sahara is about a 10 minute walk away.  Only issue we had is that we had low water pressure from our shower head.  We called the front desk twice about it and both times they sent a maintenance person right away.  First time they cleaned it, which didn't help much, and second time they replaced it, which was better.

reviews.title: Superb hotel, great location
reviews.text: We stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise in August 2019 for 1 week.You cannot fault the location of the hotel at the top of the strip, close to the monorail and close to The Stratosphere.The hotel is really well appointed, the rooms are exceptional, and feel like a home from home.Exceptionally clean. Great modern conveniences. The pool area is great and we did make the most of it, and loved spending days relaxing in the sun.Certainly a resort I would stay at again

reviews.title: Nice hotel, quiet location, just a few minutes drive to all attractions
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel with my husband, daughter and her family of four.  We got a two bedroom suite.  Both of the bedrooms were spacious.  One bedroom had one king size bed and a big bathroom with a huge bathtub.  The other bedroom had two queen size beds and its own bathroom with bathtub.   In between the two bedrooms was a living room and kitchen.  There is a washing machine/dryer which is very convenient.  The kitchen is well equipped with a fridge, stove, microwave and coffee maker.  However, amenities are not replenished everyday so it is advisable to bring your own shampoos, soap, dishwashing liquid, detergents, coffee supplies.  The hotel is very stingy with them.  Considering that we were a big family, the lone small shampoo, conditioner, bath wash for each room was definitely not even enough for the first day.    Nonetheless, we enjoyed our stay in this hotel as there are a lot of things that we could do.  There's a fitness room, games room for the kids, swimming pool and a small shop, like a small convienient store/coffee shop.  Being a vacation rental used a lot by families with time sharing, the rooms are only cleaned once a week (every Tuesday).  The hotel has a shuttle van to bring guests to the Strip.  Guests are also given coupons for free bottled water which you have to get from the front desk.  In all, we enjoyed our stay in this hotel.

reviews.title: A great Vegas property
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed 8 wonderful days at the HGVC on Paradise.  This is great property located just minutes from the heart of Las Vegas Boulevard, “The Strip”.  The property itself is beautiful and very well maintained.  Every aspect of our one bedroom suite was perfect, with the exception of a few cabinets starting to show some wear.  The suite was very nicely and amply furnished. Our king sized bed was extremely comfortable.  The property has more than adequate free self parking in either their open lot or a covered lot they share with another resort.  Their Marketplace store has an excellent assortment of freshly made food and drinks along with a good variety of sundries and prepared foods and drinks.  Every resort employee we met could not have been more helpfully and friendly.  Over the last 25 years we have stayed at no less than 15 different hotels, resorts and timeshare properties in Las Vegas and this is our new favorite.

reviews.title: Wanted to take the bed home!
reviews.text: Spacious, clean and well equipped apartments. High quality furnishings and linen, was sad to say goodbye to the bed! Bit of a walk to the main area of the strip but nice and quiet at night. Great coffee and food available at the marketplace alongside anything else you may need on vacation.

reviews.title: No Room Cleaning for Stay less than 7 Days - In spite of paying daily fee for room cleaning.
reviews.text: The room was spacious and very clean, however, the fact that I was required to pay a fee for services (i.e., room cleaning services) that I did not receive negatively affect my experience at the resort.

reviews.title: Nice room in a nice city.
reviews.text: Clean, bright and large one bed room made for an excellent vacation.  I really enjoy my stay in the Las Vegas area.  The strip was a drive but with plenty of free parking, had a great time.  Went to Zion National Park and Death Valley Nation Park while there.  Just a wonderful time.

reviews.title: Average resort!
reviews.text: It is an average resort.  There is no shuttle for LV strip or airport. There are no good amenities.  They charge $25/day resort fee, which is useless. In spit of the big brand name, they have not tried to make it a reasonably good resort.

reviews.title: Very Nice Stay
reviews.text: The room was smaller than other vacation point  rooms I've stayed.  But very doable for two people.  The location was great as it was walking distance to monorail. The staff was both friendly and helpful.  I would stay again.

reviews.title: Hilton Grandvacation club on Karen and Paradise Las Vegas
reviews.text: We've stayed at this resort serveral times and as always it is a most pleasent experience. We arrived early at the resort at around noon, was alset to put my bags with bellman but what a surprise our room was ready. Check out was just as easy just texted to let them know we were checking out. Room was well equiped with all the esentials, the only thing if you"re going to cook bring spices and bring coffee filters if you plan on making coffee. We had a wonderful stay, everything is well kept and staff alson friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Very large rooms, clean rooms, great location, very polite personnel. Great amenities, Very clean restaurant with large selection of items and food. Nice large and clean Lounge pool table. Nice size pool.

reviews.title: Don't check in with Brandon Mejia, Front Desk Lead.
reviews.text: The front desk lead, Brandon Mejia, is rude and insensitive. Everyone else is wonderful, but avoid having to work with this man. Otherwise, the property is nice. You're surrounded by construction and road work, but Vegas is growing. I like the location because you can drive anywhere easily. The Strat is awesome. The property is really clean.

reviews.title: On a Scale of 1 - 10, Our Stay was a 20!
reviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

reviews.title: Another Very Good Stay
reviews.text: Stayed here in a 2 bedroom for quick weekend getaway. Check in was quick and front desk was cordial.  Managment does a good job of keeping the furnishings up to date. Room was spacious and television had variety of channels. Internet speed was good and it was good to have a small onsite deli store.  The location is off strip which has its pros and cons.  If staying here definitely need a car, Uber or take the nearby monorail.

reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel does not recognize Hilton HHonors lifetime diamond or Diamond members very well. Stayed at this hotel back from 2012 to 2017 thought I would give it another chance I regret I did. My only complaint with this hotel is they don't value Hilton Honors very much and they also show no appreciation to a lifetime Diamond member that has stayed over a Thousand Nights with Hilton the front desk did not even know what a lifetime Diamond was I gave them my lifetime Diamond Card she handed it back to me and told me this is not a credit card at the same time she had my American Express card in her hand I asked her for a room with one king bed instead of two queens she was kind enough to Grant my request only to place me on the bottom floor with a view of a metal fence in front of my window facing the back of the pool I've stayed at many rooms in this hotel she could have given me a nicer room I asked she goes we don't do that here. This hotel is a great hotel if you can get it off TripAdvisor Expedia hotels.com if you are a diamond member with Hilton or lifetime diamond there is zero benefits at this property they charge you $25 a day for two bottles of water cheap water at that they used to give Avion back in 2017 now they've went to the plain wrap brand being a lifetime diamond we already get high speed internet we already get water but this property charges you $25 a day for two bottles of water they do not give you room upgrades they do not give free breakfast all you get are your Hilton points you're much better off staying at a beautiful Embassy Suites DoubleTree Hampton Inn Homewood Suites this property is good if you can find a cheap on Expedia and you're not a Hilton Honors member the housekeeping is amazing the snack bar and the employees that work there make very delicious food and take care of the customers exceptionally well the security team is also very friendly always on the property and always looking out for the guests and keeping the property safe the hotel is spotless beautiful inside and out it's just too bad they do not appreciate Hilton honor Diamond members are lifetime Diamond members nor is there any benefits for us being Hilton honor members sad to say I will not be visiting this property again too many other nice  properties out there that take care of us members and appreciate our business. I didn't get to see the one lady who's a supervisor at the front desk her name is Leanne she is amazing .

reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Near monorail but off strip in sketchy neighborhood. Walls are thin and had to call front desk for people next door being too loud. Items stolen from my room by housekeeping. Overall would not recommend to stay here.

reviews.title: Nice stay off the Strip
reviews.text: We used our HGVC points to stay here. Good value for 2000 points. Off the Strip, which wasn't the most convenient, but Uber was fast to pick us up.  The nice thing about not being right on the Strip was that it was quiet, and we didn't have a lot of loud partiers coming and going. On all but one small occasion, the guests we encountered seemed to be having fun while also in control of themselves.  (Not always the case in the middle of Vegas ;)  )  We didn't utilize much in our suite because we were gone most of the time.  We were only in the room to change, shower, and/or sleep. But everything we did use worked (fridge, stove, TVs, all bathroom features).  We didn't use the safes, but they did have them in the room. Although we didn't even open them, they appeared to be bigger than standard room safes, which is nice.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: Accommodations were very good. The room was clean and only adequately supplied, I.e. 4 items of each. Only 4 towels for 4 people for 4 days. Expect a $25 a day additional fee. Staff was friendly. Pool area is fair. Linens were a little rough.

reviews.title: The Pied Piper Noise
reviews.text: Overall, the stay was very satisfactory, except for the pipe/plumbing gurgling noise you hear at night in our bathroom. The  exhorbitant extra fee you are charged if you are an owner and decides not to stay the full 7 days, in my case I only stayed 5 nights. I asked why, and said it is for the housekeeping fee.It does not make sense because whether I stayed 5 or 7 days regardless, you still need to clean the room when vacated. besides, the room is not even cleaned everyday. For a 7 days stay, housekeeping will only come 2, I assumed before I checked in and in then 3 days later.

reviews.title: Best place to stay for LVCC activities.
reviews.text: This location is convenient for many Las Vegas activities, but particularly for events associated with the Las Vegas Convention Center. The parking garage is close and convenient to the resort property.

reviews.title: Ups and downs
reviews.text: Going during and a convention is very risky and annoying.. other than that the place is amazing. It is not the fault of the resort but they should of took care of the people that double parked in the entrance driveway. It was annoying

reviews.title: Ummmmm....
reviews.text: Now I'm going to say this, I am the kind of person to give a place a chance. But Dear Lord! The whole stay was a little disappointing, we arrived in the evening the parking lot was shut down for sema fine ok, but the parking garage is such a pain to get to. Secondly we walked in and there are 4 people behind the counter not one looked up from their screens until we were in front of them and they just stared and asked checking in? No hi, no hey, no how are you? Not even a smile. Then she proceeds to tell me all these fees the hilton has I'm a rewards member and I told her and she didnt even care and ignored me. Then she said parking is over in the garage and I said how done get around the construction and the police and the cars everywhere and she gave me this long worn out directions. So we drove around for 10mins trying to find the entrance. Once we did they dont tell you you gotta cart all your luggage from the garage to your room I wasnt even offered bell service lol. Anyways we get up to the room and it's hot! I turn on the ac and barely feel anything. We had to sweat all night. The next day we went out and about and came back to the room hot again so I contacted the desk and they sent a engineer now he tested the ac and said everything was ok I'm like u have to turn the thermostat down to 60 for it to work? He said you can adjust it.... ummmm? Then he left. We literally ubered all over town because of how crappy the parking was and how inconvenient it is to go back and forth to your car. I will probably never stay here again.

reviews.title: SEMA show trip
reviews.text: Hotel was in the right spot for me. Easy walking to the SEMA show at the Convention Center as well as next to one of the monorail stops. Easy to hop on an hit the strip. Easy to get anUuber as well to go anywhere, to and from airport was easy with Uber.

reviews.title: Full Service Quality
reviews.text: As an Honors Member I was provided with an upgrade to a one bedroom full sized suite that met my every expectation. The hotel shares the location with the WestGate Hotel & Casino however it is not co-located. I liked least having to park in the garage and walk to the hotel although on my first night I was able to grab one of the precious few available legal spots near the main entrance to the HGV.

reviews.title: Relaxation.
reviews.text: Time share presentation.  It was a great place to stay. The rooms were clean. Very  quiet. Plenty of space. Great location away from the Las Vegas strip. Great staff. No slot machines at this locations. Free parking.

reviews.title: Clean modern timeshare accommodation off the strip.
reviews.text: This place is great. Good internet, free business center, great Market Place food. The only thing I would add would be a shuttle to the strip like other timeshares in Vegas. We spent a lot of time at the Westgate Casino next door. Best Sports Book in town. we saw the show Brooklyn Wanderers and loved it.

reviews.title: Great people... poor customer service!
reviews.text: I was discriminated against when I had a severe reparatory issue and was treated like I was drunk/sick without understanding that I could not breathe. It made me feel like I was less than and not valued.

reviews.title: No LVH anymore...  For Vegas, this is a plain Jane stay without decent (or any) restaurant.
reviews.text: Room was clean.  FurnItiure and appliances a little dated.  Longer walk from Convention Center than LVH.  I put in about 8 miles of walking a day going back and forth to Hilton and Convention Center.  Nto what I expected.

reviews.title: Vegas Hilton Convention Stay
reviews.text: Location was great for the convention center.  Relatively quick 17 min walk.  Rooms were very nice, clean and the layout was great.  Ample space.  Nice views of the area on higher floors.Lots of road construction around the hotel, but should be gone in a couple of months.

reviews.title: Nice property near the Convention Center and monorail
reviews.text: This is a nice property if you are looking for a place to stay near the convention center and within walking distance of the monorail.  Very clean and spacious rooms. Not a casino.  The monorail is a short walk and can take you all the way down to the south end of the strip for $5 with several stops along the way.  Highly recommend this as an alternative to the larger casinos if you are looking for something quieter.

reviews.title: Beautiful and Convenient
reviews.text: I recently stayed at this property because it was close to the convention center, as I was in town for a convention. It's a 5 minute walk to the Westgate Monorail Station which is 1 stop away from the convention center. Walking to the Westgate casino was also just as easy. The property itself is beautifully decorated and the staff was wonderful. They have a full service deli with just about anything you could need while you stay there. The suites are spacious, modern, and very comfortable. I will choose this hotel above any others when I come for my next convention.

reviews.title: Another Excellent stay, amazing!!!
reviews.text: We just came back from Vegas and had a 5 night stay at the Hilton Grand vacation on Paradise and this was our second time here. We had such a great first time stay last year that we didn’t even look for other hotels when booking second trip.Clean and spacious rooms, fridge, toaster, coffee facilities, ice machine, great air con, nice and relaxing pool and hot tub. Bbq facilities and great friendly staff. Large and free car park and around $6 for a Uber to the main strip. This is definitely everything we wanted for a relaxing stay.Front desk staff were super helpful when we requested a change of room due to the next door guests being extremely loud and they relocated us to another floor which made the rest of our stay even more enjoyable. Check in/out were super quick too.I would definitely stay again and recommend to to friends and family.

reviews.title: Great location and hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is clean, very calm and relaxing in a quiet street at the northern part of the strip. The quiet pool gives a good opportunity to flee from the noise and hustle of Vegas during the sun and the shop in the hotel offers a good variety of products and warm meals for breakfast, lunch or dinner at reasonable prices. Definitely recommend this hotel and would always come back.

reviews.title: Vegas in October
reviews.text: Have been to Vegas 20+ times. The strip is great but the HGV on Paradise is a great location one block off the strip. You are walking distance to the Sahara and Westgate. Both of which have monorail stops. Highly recommend the monorail day passes especially if its your first trip and want to see the strip without the hassle of traffic. I had some minor issues with the unit upon check in but they were resolved. Staff was friendly and professional. Concierge was very helpful. Common areas inside and out were clean and well maintained. This was a family trip. Took my to "boys" ( 22 and 27) for their first Vegas experience. If you  are planning a family vacation with young children, don't do it. Vegas is an adult only Disney World.

reviews.title: nice hotel close to convention center
reviews.text: A very nice hotel.  Very nice staff.  When we checked in they changed our room from what we booked.  We booked 2 queens.  they put us in a 1 queen room.  after calling down they were prompt in correcting.  Beds were very comfortable.  the market/deli downstairs was very convenient as was the fact that it was a short walk to the monorail.  My biggest complaint was the bathroom was tiny and had no fan.  having to wait for steam to clear before the next one could use was a pain.  Also the iron had some burning stuff on it when I went to iron my new cream blouse.  that was not nice.other than that a nice stay.  quiet and comfy hotel off the strip.

reviews.title: Well worth it
reviews.text: Great stay for the price.  Bed and pillow were very comfortable.  Hotel was very clean.   Close to public transportation.  Walking distance to the strip was only one block. Overall, great experience and very reasonable priced!

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: This was our 4th stay at this property and we love it more and more with each stay.  Rooms are wonderfully laid out and appointed, the bed is heavenly.  All staff are extremely pleasant, but you can tell it is genuine, not forced or fake.  Highly recommended, no matter the reason that you travel to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Convenient and Well Maintained
reviews.text: Very good facility with very friendly staff and well maintained facility. Gym and pool were nice and was not crowded. Convenient walking distance to Westgate Resort which fulfilled gambling needs. Free parking was nice.

reviews.title: Not worth it the fees!
reviews.text: Studio is a hotel room, not a studio.  2 beds, bath and very mini kitchenette.  Fees to stay there are ridiculous considering what we've already paid to arrange this trip.  Sketchy area, off the strip (unsafe to walk at night).  You'll need a car to get around.

reviews.title: Excellent Experience!
reviews.text: The facility was spotless. The staff was polite and and professional. A very quiet stay from the impact that Las Vegas is to the senses. The room chairs & sofa could be more comfortable. Minor issue.NICE Jacuzzi.

reviews.title: When in Vegas, we ALWAYS  stay here
reviews.text: We really like the quiet, off the strip, location.  We enjoy having apartment style lodging where we are able to relax in the living room,  cook a meal in the kitchen, and generally RELAX when not at our Conferences or other business meetings.

reviews.title: Watch out for the hidden fees
reviews.text: over 30 years as a resort traveler  I have only been charged a one time $25 fee. As you get closer to Vegas/down town they called it they charge you and everyday fee plus $6 per water bottle. Sorry but this is the first and last time  I will stay at a Hilton place in any of the RCI picks.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Great small hotel, staff are friendly and helpful, the one king suite is really nice with a nice view to the mountains, most of the places and Casinos are about 10 min in Uber from the hotel, definitely staying there again

reviews.title: Happy we stayed here
reviews.text: Staff was very knowledgeable and friendly. Rooms were very spacious. The kitchin was well equipped. Had a large television in living room and both bedrooms.location was just off the strip. Plenty of parking on property.

reviews.title: Nice and quiet
reviews.text: Great place if you want quietness.  If you are in Vegas to gamble this is not the resort for you.  Comfortable big room!  Great customer service from check in to check out.  Parking lot needs a facelift though that was pretty much our only thing we would like to see changed or improved.

reviews.title: Fees + Fees + More Fees!
reviews.text: The resort itself is great. Nice amenities, very clean, convenient. I stayed for three nights and on check out, was charged $139 in extra fees. They charged me $25 a day as a resort fee which apparently is pretty common in Las Vegas but I would not expect it at a timeshare. Isn’t that what maintenance fees are for? Also, they charged A $42 cleaning fee and said it was because I wasn’t staying a full week. This doesn’t make any sense to me. They said it wasn’t optional. Then there were several other small fees, adding up to $139 for 3 nights, on top of what it actually cost me to stay there.

reviews.title: Great 2-night Stay
reviews.text: We flew into Las Vegas to spend time in Utah.  After a week of hiking there, we were so glad to be welcomed at this property and have 2 days of rest and relaxation - along with exploring Las Vegas at night.

reviews.title: VERY RELAXING!
reviews.text: The property is quiet, clean, relaxing and close enough to the strip without all of the traffic.  The pool is heated, clean and they have lifeguards on duty. I will recommend this property to friends and family.

reviews.title: Our 3rd time here.
reviews.text: This is our 3rd time staying here. The units are clean and comfortable. Free WiFi. Free parking, very unusual in Vegas. No valet however but we didn't mind. Close to the Monorail which we used for almost our entire vacation. No casino but there is the Westgate right next door within walking distance.

reviews.title: Dirty and Unsanitary
reviews.text: When turning down for bed we noticed the blanket was dirty with some brown stuff across the lower part of the blanket. Upon closer review, we found what looked like blood on the towels, the pillow cases has what looked like dirt and makeup, the sheets were also dirty with brown stuff.  We called and security had we to settle for whatever security had available. The next morning we let the front desk know. They promised to send house keeping to remove the dirty linens and remake the bed. When we returned that night we found nothing was fixed. We will not be returning.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise
reviews.text: This a very clean hotel that has very friendly staff and great service. The strip is far away enough from Las Vegas boulevard to avoid the noise at night, but it’s close enough for a quick taxi ride to the activities on Las Vegas Boulevard.

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: We loved our timeshare unit.  It was very roomy and suited all our needs.   The staff  is very friendly and accommodating. It was nice being off the strip to have some quite but close enough to go anywhere within just a few minutes.

reviews.title: good value in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is one of the many Hilton Grand Vacation Club properties in Las Vegas. It is a little far from the stirp but it is very close to the convention center. The property is slightly dated but everything works. The price is reasonable for what you get. Depending on what you are looking for in Las Vegas - this property is not a bad option for the price and location.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: I love this location very convenient and only 10 to 15 miles to all my destinations I will be back to Vegas soon again I appreciate this hotel.And another thing about this hotel I love is that it’s very secured and safe cause you can’t even us the elevator with your room key their security is awesome .

reviews.title: Business Trip
reviews.text: We had a very pleasant experience.  The Staff is Awesome....and they have updated it nicely. We look forward to staying there again.The rooms are clean and very spacious....and when we needed . anything the staff were quite helpful....

reviews.title: Very disappoiinted
reviews.text: Charged special fees for cleaning and daily $25.00 fees for services.  Then informed that since we were staying for less than a week, we were informed that we would not receive services.  Very quiet and off the strip so that was a plus.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay with all needed amenities. Place is clean..service is great and staff are friendly, very accommodating.close to places we want to go and public transit is close. We get around the area with no problem.

reviews.title: Excellent resort.
reviews.text: Very clean with a convenient store/lunch area.  Excellent pool area also.  The distance from the strip is a bit much, but the tram makes it less of a problem.  Very convenient business area within the QUIET LOUNGE.  (I said it that way because it needs to have better signage.)  Very helpful and courteous staff as well.  This resort also does not bother you several times to take a tour of the facility.

reviews.title: Quiet place to sleep off Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Very comfortable and clean location to relax away from the Strip. Short walk to the Monorail. Just be aware you can hear the neighbors shower from your bedroom. Other than that there was very little to no noise.

reviews.title: Place is AWESOME!
reviews.text: We booked a 2BR unit through RCI. The rooms were huge, with full kitchen,  washer/dryer, 2 bathroom with a HUGE jacuzzi, great views of Vegas, large LR, 3 flat screen TV with all the latest apps, spotless clean, and last but not least a very friendly and efficient/professional staff. There is plenty of free parking and 2 lounges. My family came to visit and the lounge was perfect.  I recommend Hilton GVC Paradise.

reviews.title: Dont get carried off by the ROACHES!
reviews.text: The staff was great but other then that there is nothing special about this property. Bring an extension cord as the wall plugs are very limited.I highly recommend avoiding the pool area after dark unless you want to be carried off by ROACHES!

reviews.title: Everyone wants more money
reviews.text: The daily 25 dollar fee for use of amenities is not optional even if you don't use them. They should use the word required and stop listing the services as if it's optional. Road construction blocking access also.

reviews.title: Happy Camper
reviews.text: I like the resort in generalI feel that the extra $25.00 / day seems somewhat of a cash grab after paying maintenance dues at home resort, paying annual RCI fees and paying the exchange fee...what is next??RCI exchanges will out price the average consumer

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: Will stay again, loved this place. Felt like home away from home. Was very impressed. Nice to have some quiet time away from the strip. Super relaxing. Very accommodating in every way possible. They never said no.

reviews.title: As good as ever
reviews.text: We have been coming to this hotel for many years and always feel welcomed and enjoy our stay. In our opinion much better than being on the strip with free parking and near the monorail. Will return again when we return again to LV

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: Room was decent, but the sinks drainage was bad the sinks overflowed, when I turned up the air to 72 it smelled like something was burning for about 2 minutes. No shuttle  to the airport or to the strip. Because I was not staying 7 days I had no cleaning service, but had to pay a cleaning fee so my room could  be cleaned after I leave even though is was going to be cleaned anyway. I had to pay a total of 130.00 extra in fee's when I checked in. but no services

reviews.title: Travel
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights in September.Pros: very clean; no gambling or smoke; it’s off the strip so it’s quiet; free parking; nice staff.Cons: you need to Uber to get around; there were people hanging around the parking lot, I didn’t feel comfortable going to my car alone; no hot food—staff directed us to go to westgate.  (It’s right next to this property and they share parking). As we walked there ,westgate security was escorting people off the property.  They are really pushy about getting you to one of their seminars—don’t do it!   Took over three hours.

reviews.title: A Great Spot off the Strip
reviews.text: Very much enjoyed our stay at the HGV. The rooms were very nice with lots of room. It is conveniently located off the strip and away from all the mahem that Vegas brings. A short Uber ride and you are right back in the life either on the strip or on Fremont Street. The pool is nicely kept and the pool bar handy and very refreshing on those hot days.The lounge areas were very roomy and the cafe/store was good for those quick snacks.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our visit to this hotel
reviews.text: Quiet hotel, no gaming machines or casino, off the strip. Lovely gated pool area with a lifeguard from 0800 to 2200. Nice shop on site where they will cook meals for you. Thanks to all in the shop as they looked after us for the two weeks we were there. Bar only opens for a short time each day and is closed by 2000 needs to be open a little longer. Our thanks also goes to the people on reception, as on arrival we caused a problem.  Our booking paperwork says we booked a two bedroom apartment for two weeks, but reception advised they had no two beds available, so they arranged for us to have two connecting rooms one studio and a one bedroom apartment.  This worked perfectly and all those on reception were lovely.  On checking the account on RCI  now states the booking is for a Studio which as we travel as three sometimes four this would not have been booked.   Lastly the strip can be visited by using a monorail nearby and the trips to Hoover Dam and the Grand Canyon were wonderful, also the Michael Jackson one show at the Mandaley Bay hotel was a big WOW.  Would recommend this hotel for a visit to anyone   but August is HOT HOT HOT.

reviews.title: Hilton Diamond avoid this place. No benefits.
reviews.text: No breakfast includedNo welcome snacksNo restaurantNo casinoNo extra towelsStaff was not helpful at all. They act like they dont care and do not give solution to issues.I will not stay here ever again.

reviews.title: Below expectations
reviews.text: Did not meet my expectations by any means.  I have stayed at other HGV hotels that were of premium quality and service. The room looked tidy until you took a closer look.  Dust covered surfaces. Kitchen and bathroom were clean though. A fall heavy cleaning due. No restaurant amenities including breakfast. Really market opens at 7?  Definitely a notch below other HGV sites

reviews.title: It works, but nothing will blow you away at this property.
reviews.text: You come to expect good things from the Hilton brand, and the rooms are well appointed, tidy and good size, but this location doesn't have the footprint to have any good draw to it, it just works to sleep, cook and eat at with a big family, nothing is keeping you on property.

reviews.title: Family & Friend Get-A-Way
reviews.text: The Decor at this resort was so nice!  The stdio was spacious and the one bedroom left nothing to be desired.  The view was great and the monorail was steps away.  It was also steps away the Westgate Resort which had a lot to do including shows.  If you want to enjoy the strip, but not be on the strip, this is the place for you!

reviews.title: Best stay ever!
reviews.text: When we walked into the suite, we were very pleased with the cleanliness and setup of the suite. There was a lot of room to entertain and relax. The kitchen had everything we needed including utensils. We will always try to stay here in the future.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our Stay.
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand was the perfect location. My husband was in a pool tournament being held at the Westgate. It was super convenient! The room (the whole hotel) was very clean and housekeeping staff went above and beyond  to accommodate you! The pool was lovely. This is a quiet hotel, no casino, family atmosphere and a common area with a pool table. There were many people from the pool tournaments staying at the Hilton. I would definitely stay there again or at another other Hilton Grand!

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the HGV on Paradise.  Room (2 bedroom) was spacious, clean and nicely furnished.  The HGV is only a 5 minute walk to the Monorail station, so access to the hustle and bustle of the Strip was great.  The staff was quite friendly and helpful.  We enjoyed the convenience of and selection in the Market Place for groceries/lunch/late night snacks.  Definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Great place to stay, just not much in the area
reviews.text: Great place to stay but not much in the area.  Had to take taxis or ubers to get any where unless you are prepared to walk, so do not go in August if you are going to walk, very hot 🥵. Oh there is a casino there.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise
reviews.text: This property provides  an excellent guest experience. The staff was very helpful and assisted us well with every aspect of our stay. We received texts to ensure our stay was going well and our needs met. The rooms are a very nice size and very comfortable.

reviews.title: Troy
reviews.text: I was suppose to have a gd view which I requested and got a roof view, their store closes early in the evening and the bar opens late in the afternoon and early in the evening so their is not much for relax time, like have a drink or get a late night snack.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This Hilton property is very clean, very comfortable and well maintained. We had the suite which is nicely sized with a complete kitchen and it feels like home. No casino on the property which cuts out the crowd and the smoke.The staff is very helpful and courteous.

reviews.title: Lovely staff, large room
reviews.text: We stayed here in the heat of August. Firstly the staff were friendly even at 1am, the room was huge with a kitchen and separate bedroom. Parking for guests is free and the pool is lovely. Downsides are it’s quite far from the strip, once you get north of the sls hotel the area is a little seedy. And the shop in the basement is sooo expensive, almost 6 Canadian bucks for a Starbucks drip coffee?! 11 us for a Folgers tin selling for less than 4 in a normal grocery store.

reviews.title: Great for having a rest of busy Vegas
reviews.text: Hotel is conveniently located close to the Convention Center, if you plan on having busy days and want to have a nice, quiet rest at night, this is definitely the place.  Not so far from the strip in case you want to live a bit of Las Vegas night life.

reviews.title: Improvement Needed
reviews.text: Overall experience was bad at Hilton this tome. I have stayed and preferred Hilton for all my trips so far but at this place it was a mistake. Staring with 1 hour wait for my check in, room location, staff interaction nothing was upto the par.

reviews.title: Event
reviews.text: I traveled to Las Vegas for an event at the Las Vegas convention center. Chose the hotel through Hilton Honors due to how close it was to the event. Food and fitness center were great. Best choice I made

reviews.title: Very comfortable stay
reviews.text: It was like home away from home. The room was very spacious. It allowed us to have family time together. Except for the fact that it’s bit away from LA’s Vegas strip, the advantage was the quietness. We could always Uber to all the places with ease. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Hilton

reviews.title: Nice, family friendly vacation resort
reviews.text: Located in Northern end of the Strip and affords some quieter, more relaxation atmosphere for when your day in the busy, noisy, hectic downtown area is done.  Convenient taxi or Uber ride to alll attractions, about $8.00.  Average gym/spa facility. Very nice pool and pool bar service.  Very good breakfast and grill but no on site restaurant which is no problem considering what is available nearby.  A negative observation- the Market Place store is vastly over priced for everything, especially bottled water.  For provisions just walk a few blocks south and get what you need from a large and modern Walmart.

reviews.title: Close to tournament venue, quiet stay
reviews.text: I enjoyed a quiet, restful stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations hotel. It is next door to the Pool Tournament at the Westgate so it was very convenient to walk back and forth as needed. The only problem I had was on Saturday morning when I stopped by the “Experiences” desk for event coupons, and no one showed up for work, and no one else there seemed to know anything about it. All in all it is a clean hotel with nice staff, the room was very comfortable, and I enjoyed my stay.

reviews.title: Excellent for family stay
reviews.text: This hotel has great amenities for travelling families. All cookware and utensils are clean and in good working order. Rooms are spacious and clean. Some noise from the streets nearby but manageable. Overall an outstanding value.

reviews.title: Great staff, Clean property
reviews.text: The resort is clean and has some onsite activities (pool, billards, free DVDs). The front desk staff was fantastic. You will need transportation to get to the Vegas Strip, but there is a monorail that does a great job and is inexpensive.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location next to the Convention Center and a three minute walk to the Westgate Hotel and Casino. Right next to the Monorail and this Hotel has a grocery located inside. Nice swimming pool surrounded by Palm trees. Free movie rentals and two bottles of Evian water daily.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience from the time we arrived until we left. Such friendly and helpful staff. I highly recommend this resort. It is in a great location. Close to the Monorail for travel to the strip.

reviews.title: Mother daughter trip
reviews.text: Exceptional resort close to the strip. Quiet, relaxing, perfect for a family vacation. Rooms were very clean, housekeeping exceptional. Spacious room, large kitchenette which we used. Will definitely return.

reviews.title: Service #1
reviews.text: This property has all that you may need. Front desk is second to none. Always willing to help or answer any questions. Lots of outside parking and it's free. You get two bottles of water each day. (free) It may be a little off the strip but I would stay there again.

reviews.title: Family Getaway
reviews.text: We visit Vegas often, but this time we were looking for a more family oriented hotel. Especially since we are a party of 8, to include 3 kids. I had 3 family members who have never been to Vegas before. This Hilton was perfect. For the following reasons: Affordable 2 bedroom suite which sleeps 8, with 2 bath, and full kitchen w/utensils, pots, pans, etc. We wanted something more on the quiet and on the relaxing side. No casino hustle and bustle and crowd. This place is half a block from the strip, great views, nice pool, business center, and small market. So you can relax when you want to, and go party on the strip, best of both worlds.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: Not right on the strip but not a bad walk.  Took a little while to get checked in but staff was very friendly.  Room was nice, large and clean.  Very quite.  Loved the large soaking tub and separate walk in shower.  Nice small gift shop (does not take cash).  Plenty of free parking.

reviews.title: Huge suites with huge kitchens! Pretty good location too!
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the size and amenities of the room.  Huge kitchen.  En suite laundry.  Lots of good stuff.  Easy 4 minute mostly covered walk to the Westgate (which is OK despite its hideous signage) and monorail stop.  10-15 minutes to the SLS and LV Blvd.  So its a pretty decent place to stay without a car.  The little market on site is pretty decent and serves ok food, but you have to head a mile east if you want to stock up on groceries.Good: Close to monorail and Westgate.  Free EV charging and parking in the neighboring Westgate structure.  Huge suites with huge kitchens stocked full of kitchenware.  Washer and dryers en suite.  Lots of nice common areas if you there with a big group.  Daily bottles of Evian and DVD rentals.  Housekeeping staff was very attentive and the room was spotless.  Slept great.Meh:  What's up with the huge light fixtures?  Access panels EVERYWHERE!  Builders grade everything in the rooms.  Pool gets really crowded.Bad:  Water pressure in my suite sucked.  This is a timeshare/vacation club site... so they will ask you and try to bribe you to go to one of their sales presentations.

reviews.title: Friends With Walkers
reviews.text: I was traveling with a friend with a walker and I also was using one.  The staff was so accommodating and provided assistance from bellmen to concierge to front desk.  The room easily accommodated all our needs.  Easy to use access.  Great beds and pillows.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Stay
reviews.text: Staff are extremely nice, and helpful.  We had all the comforts of home and everything we needed in our room.  On check out day we were running late and they were very nice to extend our check out time to give us enough time to pull ourselves together to leave.

reviews.title: A week stay for family of five
reviews.text: We had a great time at Hilton. Great place to stay for basketball tournament, washer and dryer is a priceless feature when you have to deal with sweaty uniform every day. Complimentary water with LV weather is also. Great bonus. Thank you for the complimentary movie rental - kids barely used it because we were busy, but I know they wanted to. Very friendly and helpful staff, spacious rooms, clean and quiet. Great for family time. I took advantage of the gym, great to have it available 24/7. We will definitely stay again if we visit Vegas

reviews.title: More than I expected
reviews.text: I have many food allergies and needed to be able to cook my own food while on my business trip. I found this room with a kitchen and it was truly more than I was expecting. I was like staying in an apartment! It had a full kitchen, living room, large bathroom with a shower and a soaker tub and a large comfortable bed. I hated to leave!

reviews.title: Off-strip, but still conveniently located
reviews.text: This location is just far enough to get away from the chaos of the Strip. The Westgate monorail station is a short walk next door, so you can be at the Strip quickly. The streets (Paradise and Karen) do have some traffic, but they calm down at night. If you lack plans off the Strip, then you can probably avoid renting a car. (If you do any tours, tell them it is the one *by Westgate*.) Great and helpful service. Beautifully maintained facility. The Marketplace shop has enough to take care of breakfast and snacks.

reviews.title: Best stay ever
reviews.text: Great staff. Easy check in. Great price. Easy access parking lot. Very big. Lit. Quiet halls. you need card to use elevator. I like that. Free water. Free WiFi. Free dvd rental. Love it. Will stay again

reviews.title: OK Place to Stay
reviews.text: Don't forget the 'resort fee" added tp the room.  Go next door to eat.  Can't use cash in the mini-mart.  Has a guest game room but then charges to play the games (pool, foosball).  Does have close access to the monorail but not near anything else.

reviews.title: Girls get away
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand On Paradise was perfect for 4 Girls getting away to Celebrate a Birthday in Vegas.The room was spacious. A great location to hoop on the Monorail or take Uber . We liked the quiet at the end of the day.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Paradise Las Vegas
reviews.text: As HGVC Elite members the manager and staff greeted us and treated us very well.  We were also able to get as much water as we wanted.  We were  given the top floor with a great view.  One of the best experiences as Elite members.

reviews.title: Another nice stay
reviews.text: I've stayed at this location several times and have always had a pleasant time. The rooms are clean and well appointed. Very convenient location if you are going to a convention at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Monorail is within easy walking distance too.

reviews.title: Well-Thought-Out Resort
reviews.text: Service: Great customer service from all I had in contact with at the resort -- from the receptionists, housekeeping, store clerks, etc. Staff was courteous and friendly.How I liked the room:  Room was clean and well-furnished; all items within were in good working order.Location: Conveniently located within walking distance to the strip and more conveniently to the Westgate Casino (has a nice spa) and Convention Center. Less than a mile walk to the SLS and Stratosphere Casinos as well. Room Amenities: Included a well-supplied kitchen (eating utensils, cooking utensils, pots/pans/colander/pitcher, coffee-pot-maker, bread slice toaster, sink garbage disposer, small bottle of liquid dish detergent and a new sponge, dishwasher machine, two dishwasher detergent tabs); a 4-person dining table setting; a comfortable living room set that included a queen-size sofa bed (the beddings can be found in a clear plastic bag inside the closet of the bedroom); 2 modern flat-screen TVs; 2 thermostat controls (one in bedroom and one by the door to your room); hot tub in bedroom;  bathroom with shower and 2 sinks; and washer/dryer.Hotel Amenities We Used: Swimming pool, whirlpool spa, gift shop/deli, exercise/fitness room, computer/printer What I Liked Best: No one bothered us about sales presentations. Non-smoking hotel.What I Liked Least: No blender in kitchen, but this is not a deal-breaker at all. It would have been nice to be able to make my own smoothies.Tips: (1) They don't accept cash at the Gift Shop/Deli, so if you're sending your kids to the store, it's best to go with them so that you can sign for the credit card charge or sign for the room charge. (2) If you plan on using the washer/dryer, they only provide you with one detergent box for one wash -- save some money by bringing your own laundry "pods" and dryer sheets (you can put these things in zip lock bags in your luggage). You can also try to ask extra detergent, but I didn't.

reviews.title: Stay at Hilton Grand
reviews.text: Good facility.  Good staff.  Unfortunately two of the three elevators were out of order.  That made the experience not so great. We stayed for four days.  We travel to Vegas twice a year for basketball tournaments.  We typically stay at the Westgate, but we preferred the more private environment the Hilton Grand offers.

reviews.title: Divided
reviews.text: This property was very clean and near the convention center with great amenities but if your invitation/reservation was marketing package please be aware that your going to be limited to service provider by the property. However there's a great outdoor bar with tasty drinks/ reasonable drink specials...

reviews.title: Right in the middle of everything
reviews.text: This is a great location from which to explore Vegas.  Right next to the low-cost monorail system, and just far enough off the boulevard to miss the traffic and noise.  Take a ride on the High Roller, swim in the pool, gamble at dozens of casinos, walk or ride to a show.  The suites are large and comfortable, and the inside deli has just about anything you want for a quiet drink, snack or meal inside.

reviews.title: Great rooms okay location
reviews.text: This is a great hotel in terms of rooms and amenities especially if you need a kitchen.  Rooms are very clean.  The marketplace food was horrible.  I could have done a better job making my own sandwich.  The cheeseburger and fries tasted like a school cafeteria.  The two panini sandwich were heated but no butter or condiments.  We wasted 30 dollars.  I would not stay here because the location is not convenient to the strip.  There are no decent restaurants in walking area.

reviews.title: Vegas with kids
reviews.text: I am not a Vegas fan especially with kids. We had a basketball tournament and had to go this place was perfect for our family. Smoke free and casino free not super fancy but totally sufficient and clean. We had a one bedroom small dining table full kitchen washer and dryer. When not at the tournament we played boardgames & pool swam watched movies and were able to prepare full meals in the kitchen. Food in Vegas is outrageous this place saved us a ton of money and the grocery store was just about a mile down the road. If we have to come back to Vegas I would happily stay here again.

reviews.title: My stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay. The staff was great. Hotel was very clean. They gave me two bottles of water everyday which was great because it was 108 degrees each day I was there.  They provide a quite space for relaxation after a long day.  Will stay there on the next visit.

reviews.title: Clean and close to Mcdonalds
reviews.text: Rooms were impressively clean. Staff was very pleasant. If I had any reservation about hotel, it would be the location. $15 taxi ride to strip.  But, perfect for a family trip. Life guard in pool area was a huge bonus!

reviews.title: Great location, nice resort
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week on timeshare exchange.  This resort is in a good location.  It was conveniently located only 0.3 mile from either the Westgate Casino or the SLS Casino (my preference), and two monorail stations.  It is close to I-15 and the Las Vegas convention center.  Lots to do here within walking distance but a car is recommended for stays of more than a day or two. There is free parking either in an outdoor lot, or, in a parking garage although the garage is not directly connected to the hotel.The resort was nice.  The outdoor pool looked pleasant, but a little small for the size resort that it was.  However, the pool and hot tub never really looked overcrowded while we were there.  A small fitness center is on site.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  They had a laundry facility available for free to their patrons, though we didn’t use it.  Ice and coke machines on our floor, and I assume all floors.  A room key is required to use the elevator for guests to go up to their floor.  This is pointless when you consider that there was always someone on the elevator that had forgotten their key and simply used someone else’s key to access the floor they wanted.  There is no security advantage to this system as it is easily defeated, and, therefore it is just a nuisance for guests.  We observed several guests struggle with the system which seemed confusing and did not work the same in every elevator in this resort.  A room key was also required for entrance into the trash chute closet located on each floor.  The redundant use of room keys to access every amenity is really a nuisance… especially for use of a trash chute!  That is 'overkill' with no clear security benefit.  Check-in was smooth.  The air conditioning worked well.  The rooms were nice and clean.  We had a studio, which had a smallish refrigerator, microwave, coffee pot, and small safe in the room.  Bedding was comfortable.  The pillows were firmer than average, but comfortable. They had decent outlets between the beds with 2 outlets and a few USB plugins.  I always carry a plug strip to be sure I have plenty to handle my many devices.  The bathrooms are very small with tub shower, sink and toilet all in an area barely big enough for one person to turn around.   The noise levels from neighboring rooms were excessive and even some hall noise was clearly audible in the rooms.   You can hear babies crying, conversations, and, the TV in the room next door without any problem.  That seemed unusual for a higher end resort which was built in 1999 and refurbished in 2018.  There was a market off the lobby with salads and sandwiches and an array of grocery items to choose from.  2L sodas were available.  As would be expected, prices were a little high though I’ve seen worse.  Staff were friendly and helpful here, too.  Grills were available for outdoor cooking just off the market and pool deck.All things considered we would revisit this resort on a future trip.  If you find this information helpful please click the link below to let us know..

reviews.title: Cleanliness of the room
reviews.text: Room had trash from previous guest and was never cleaned out of the room. I requested for the room to be recleaned after my first night there and the thrash was still there. Maid did not take it out nor notice any other trash

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: The people at the HGV Convention Center was great. This is the place to stay when in Las Vegas. You can take that to the Bank. The site is off strip and Quite. The comfort is great. The people are fantastic. Thanks for a good, worry free time.

reviews.title: A rare occurrence
reviews.text: A very rare enjoyment.  This kind of experience may come along once in a life time.  Very professional and very attentive to guest needs.  I was not their fit pleasure but they made my trip much more tolerable!

reviews.title: A Great Place for Family and Non-Gamblers
reviews.text: The accommodations are spacious and well-appointed and the staff is courteous and eager to please. The location offers easy access to the Westgate casino next door and the Las Vegas Monorail, taking you anywhere you'd want to go on the Strip. The quiet setting is the perfect location for families and those who prefer non-casino experience that is close to the action.

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Great hotel and excellent location for a family vacation. The hotel staff was amazing and my daughter really enjoyed the large pool. The king size bed was very comfortable and the full sized kitchen was great.

reviews.title: Overall stay was Fantastic.
reviews.text: This accommodation  was very clean and the suites allowed you to bring in your own food. We found the proximity to the strip great on the monorail and it was nice to not have a smokey casino to walk through to get to your room. We are not gamblers but the Westgate was very accessible for this and restaurants .

reviews.title: Great times
reviews.text: Great for family trip to VegasRight next to monorail and easy to get all aboutExcellent service and clean well done remodeled facility Store onsite very helpful Pool great - needs a Hilton waterfall feature! (hot tub even better) Great spot to enjoy Vegas and come home to clean, fun safe environment

reviews.title: Luxurious King Suite
reviews.text: The King Suite is great with a lot of space and a fully equiped kitchen. There is also a washing machine and dryer. TV in the bedroom as well as the living, where a sofa-bed is available. Only the breakfast is just a coupon that allows you to get a hamburger, a coffee and an orange juice.

reviews.title: Always very good
reviews.text: This hotel is ideally situated close to the Las Vegas convention center. Quick check in and NO SLOT MACHINES! Very quiet. Nice pool too at the end of a day for quick refresh. All in all my go to stay place if it is still available that is............

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Extremely clean and affordable.   Staff is excellent.  Hotel has great amenities.    Parking is free and plentiful.   Will return to this location.  Very conveniently located.  Rooms are very clean.  Beds are comfortable

reviews.title: Girl's Trip Meets Luxury and Style
reviews.text: It was wonderful to be in a smoke free, luxury setting with great decor, a washer/dryer and enough room for the long term visiting we did during the trip.  No casino, family friendly atmosphere and every detail of the stay was handled by the staff especially Carlos who is in charge of the front desk.  We arrived early and left for a two day trip to the Grand Canyon then returned and Carlos arranged to store our luggage so the day trip was so easy.  We were all treated like the "Queens" we desire to be.

reviews.title: Our First HGV Experience
reviews.text: Our First HGV experience was positive. The staff and front desk were awesome and answered all of our questions promptly. The pool and exercise room were nice.The parking was easy.The location of the property was great and close to all the action on the LV Strip.We had a great time.

reviews.title: Great Family Resort
reviews.text: We went with 2 families, they were able to accommodate rooms close for us and have everything we could need! The rooms were clean and pool was perfect temperature.  The bed was very comfortable. The staff was always friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Little known gem
reviews.text: An excellent stay with wonderful amenities! The location is away from the hustle and bustle of the strip, yet close to public transportation. It was only 5-10 minutes by car to the strip.The rooms have a complete kitchen, so no need to go out to eat unless you want to.

reviews.title: Good room but the resort fee is reduce
reviews.text: The room was nice and staff was nice but $25 fee, daily resort fee for what?! There was nothing “resort” or “extra” about this hotel. The pool is a standard hotel pool and there were no other “resort perks” that we were made aware of other than 2 bottles of water, per room a day. I can buy a case of water from Walmart for a hell of a lot cheaper than the $170 resort fee I was charged upon check out, and that’s with us leaving a day early. Overall clean room but be prepared to be gouged.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Hotel is clean, quiet, no casino, and easy to get anywhere you want to go in Vegas. Strip is close, but back streets provide the fastest access anyplace. Staff is very attentive and warm. You won't regret the visit.

reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: Great place to enjoy a week stay. No problems with other residents while visiting, staff was friendly and helpful. The pool was always clean and the bar prices were reasonably priced. The marketplace was pricey but they have everything you need. Overall, the hotel was great and my husband and I along with my sister really enjoyed the stay and will visit again in the future

reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text: Great location and great facilities. It seems the hotel has been renovated lately. Elevators got an upgrade so was the fitness center. Swimming pool areas and in general all areas in the hotel are well maintained.

reviews.title: Premium Property
reviews.text: We booked a one bedroom condo through a discount website.  We had stayed at the hotel years ago and so we were pleased when the hotel name popped up, as we'd had a good experience previously.  I hate resort fees, but it has become a fact of life.  At least in this case, they do not charge for parking. One gets free water, DVD check-out, and the use of the pool.  Really there isn't  a reason to charge a "resort fee", except to make more money.  But I am still giving the hotel an excellent rating as the facility is better than most upscale hotels I have stayed in, in large cities.1.  Condominium- Large bedroom, bathroom with a full sized jacuzzi tub, living space, and kitchen with a full size refrigerator. 2.  Immaculate.3.  Very quiet.4.  Lots of help, and friendly.5.  Full service market with hot foods and friendly staff.6.  Clean pool with large towels.7.  Location convenient to get to and from the strip (there is a $5 one way charge for the nearby monorail, per person, so we drove ).I highly recommend this facility.

reviews.title: HGV on paradise
reviews.text: hotel is located between two stations on the monorail - westgate and sls - this is close to both train easy access to strip.  lots of parking onsite for rental cars.  relaxing and quiet resort. great friendly staff.

reviews.title: Clean and convenient
reviews.text: This place is just off the strip and right on the monorail. We used it to get every where and it was super convenient! Also, this property was very clean! The kitchen was well stocked and the washer and dryer was great.

reviews.title: They charge resort fee for water!
reviews.text: Resort fee charge is $25 a day. Stayed 7 nights unaware of this information. At checkout was the first time I realized this while looking over my bill. They don’t except cash on the property so you charge to your room to the card they have on file.  You had to have in order to check in. When I asked what the charge was for one of the things it covered was the complementary water they gave me. Two bottles a day for seven days. $12.50 a bottle.

reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text: Checking in I felt pre judged and unwelcomed let alone not thoroughly helped. The construction kept me up all night long the booms and bangs were so loud and heavy my heart dropped each time that’s how loud it was I even had to call the front desk. Security is a joke. Very unkempt looking and Jason one of the officers was so confrontational, rude, and disrespectful! I can’t believe he represents this brand and legacy of the Hilton and I’ve stayed at all of the properties and for this to be a vacation home you’d think they’d have better staff and customer service. Management was called serveral times and no response was given or responded to.

reviews.title: Austin - Freeport, Bahamas
reviews.text: Las Vegas was great but our stay at the Hilton Paradise was even better. The staff was helpful and the location and room was incredible. My family had an awesome time. We will be back for another great vacation at the Hilton.

reviews.title: Don’t wast your time or money, horrible property not worthy of the Hilton brand
reviews.text: This property was dirty, old and substandard. Hilton should get rid of this property. My stay was four days, not even complimentary coffee, they charged $4.80 a cup, room was dirty and they will not clean your room at all until your stay exceeds 5 days. Fine for us because we came to visit Vegas not stay in the room. However when asked questions about Hilton and where to go for our your, I was referred to literally 4 different people, 2 at the service desk, then concierge, then promotional agent before I was given a 1-800 number to call because no one was aware of there product or the company they were working for “Hilton”

reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: The resort was clean, our accommodations had everything we needed for the week.  We had a nice view of the pool area. The staff were very helpful and pleasant.  The resort is about a 10 minute walk from the mail strip.  It is away from the noise and daily activity.  Overall a very pleasant stay.

reviews.title: Great location for the Las Vegas Conference Center!
reviews.text: Close to the conference center and a non-smoking property! Easy to get around town with the Monorail a few minutes away. The pool was big and comfy lounge chairs with large umbrellas.  Enjoyed a relaxing day with a great book! Nice wine selections in the Market.

reviews.title: Nice accommodations in a fairly good location.
reviews.text: This is like a time share rental with kitchenware etc provided. Had a two bedroom suite and the larger had one large bed and the other had 2 queen beds. A block away from the main Strip area and about the same to get to the Vegas Monorail serving some portions of the Strip. At the store near the lobby can buy many food type items as well as a few prepared items to take to room. No gambling in that facility and has a very nice pool area.

reviews.title: Volleyball tournament 2019
