reviews.text: We were on a quick trip to Vegas and just wanted a solid hotel near things. This place was great. Staff - very efficient & friendlyRoom - very clean, large, full kitchen, huge jacuzzi bathParking - lots of it in a garage WiFi - goodPool - a bit small, but sufficient if you are not looking for a "pool" vacation I'd definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Nice and quiet hotel
reviews.text: This is a nice off the Strip hotel. Relax and quiet environment. Away from the crowded and noisy Strip, but very close to the Strip. Just 5 minutes driving, you can get to all attractions on the Strip.My suite has one large bedroom, living room and a kitchen with dining table.Bathroom with jetted bathtub.If you want to stay a little off the Strip and get there by car, this hotel is recommended.

reviews.title: Unhappy Hilton Member
reviews.text: Was married to a Diamond Member and NEVER experienced this lack of service and Hilton Quality - Maybe Gold Membership at Hilton mean Zero - The jetted tub might have never been cleaned - After running the water and turning on the jets, the water turned brown! Disgusting! The

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vatcation (Paradise) UNDER RENOVATION
reviews.text: Just experienced a horrible, noisy five day stay at Hilton Grand Vacation (Paradise) on Karen Avenue, Las Vegas area.  The hotel is under going renovations which made my stay noisy as hammering, and all sorts of vibrations woke me each morning PRIOR to 9 AM.  Hilton still has not posted this long term, planned renovation on their website, so be warned if you stay here!  Not romantic or restful.  Also had soiled sheets--not changed!  GROSS!!!

reviews.title: Pleasant stay in a tranquil setting
reviews.text: Only stayed 3 nights and thoroughly enjoyed this place. Quiet, spacious rooms housing mainly families. My partner said she could live in this room.Clean, roomy luxurious with friendly staff.Monorail only 5 min walk so for those who don't want the hype of the strip, this is your place. The extra you pay for this (suggest multi day passes)is well worth the reasonable room rates.If only we had this accomodation throughout our entire 5 weeks in the USA. Sigh.

reviews.title: Convenient off-strip location
reviews.text: Having stayed in the strip before (Mirage and Cosmopolitan), I decided to use my Wyndham points for an exchange here. Paid $99 for four nights and I was extremely satisfied with this decision. How cool is it that you don't have to walk thru a casino to go to the pool or your room? Family oriented, clean and suites are beautiful! We stayed in a one-bedroom suite (for 2 people) and it was more than we could have asked for. The close proximity to the monorail station is a huge plus! We saved a lot of money by purchasing the multi-day pass instead of paying uber. If you still feel like uber is better, it cost between $9 and $13 from the strip, not bad considering that you stay away from chaos. We would stay again in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Comfort and luxe
reviews.text: Wr attived tired from a tre day tour in frand canyin, bryce canyon and monument valley... we really needed a very comfortable and cozy place where to spend the night and hilton grand vacation was a good solution.  The room is more like an apartment, huge and comfortable bedroom, awesome bathroom and the living room and kitchen are great There is everything you can wish.Till very late you can also use the market inside the hotel and prepare a good dinner.I recommend this hotel even if without casino

reviews.title: Vegas Business
reviews.text: Trip was for business. The hotel was clean. The hotel staff was friendly, helpful and professional. The room was well equipped plus stylish. The hotel was quiet. Good amenities pool, rec room & biz ctr

reviews.title: Great for family
reviews.text: Big suites perfect for families.  The no smoking property was so refreshing for smoky Vegas.  Loved that this hotel did not have a casino.  Wished they would of had a regular restaurant, it would of been much more convenient.

reviews.title: Traded in through RCI - Excellent stay!
reviews.text: We traded into this property through RCI and were very impressed.  Our two bedroom with a full kitchen was clean, spacious, and fully equipped with everything we needed.The two bedroom units are a one king single with a little kitchenette on one side of a lock out, and a full huge living room, full kitchen, table w/4 chairs, laundry closet in the middle, and then a full king bedroom with a large jacuzzi tub, shower, and bath on the other end.  Plenty of room and plenty of privacy for two couples.  I signed up for text messaging service from the concierge, which was perfect.  We texted to ask about nearby grocery stores for cases of water, breakfast food, and snacks.  Not only did they text back immediately with directions, they let us know that they have carts to borrow to bring the groceries up to the room.  The pool area was clean and offered plenty of lounging space and the pool bar offered daily specials that helped cool us down from the 110 degree heat.  Parking is free, safe, and easy to negotiate.  The property is centrally located to get quickly to the strip, Fremont Street, or the airport via Uber or taxi.  The business center offered only two computers, but guests can print using their own computers from two wireless printers.  The front desk and concierge were very helpful and offered excellent suggestions for free parking on the strip and show ideas.  The property offers free dvd rentals, a store, and a game room for kids.  Overall, I would absolutely recommend this property for business, family vacations, or Vegas get aways.

reviews.title: Not a Hilton Hotel
reviews.text: This is not a Hilton Hotel; it's a timeshare.  So don't expect a Hilton Hotel experience.  Pros:  Great staff!  Great location off the strip ... near the monorail for easy access to the Strip.   Cons:  Uncomfortable beds.  Paper thin walls (lots of noise of every type).  No free coffee service in lobby.   Just don't expect a Hilton Hotel experience.

reviews.title: Not this Hilton Grand
reviews.text: Just didn't like the area there are two other Hilton Grands in Vegas should have stayed at the strip or Alara! the staff was helpful not there fault that the hotel is a half a block from CrackVegas! the concierge did give great advice on the show to see there is not a restaurant on site just a store that has food some of it premade not really good. This is in a town that prides itself on great food choices! I go to 3 trade shows a year there will make to cross this on off my list.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for a week in July and have only good things to say about this property.  Every staff member I encountered was very helpful and friendly.  Special thanks to Alejandro at the front desk, who took the time to help me with printing problem.  He went above and beyond in helping me, and he was so professional.Five adults shared a 2 bedroom suite, and we had plenty of room.  The full kitchen and washer/dryer were super convenient.  We bought groceries and ate in the room several times.  The pool was so relaxing, and never was overcrowded.  It closes at 10pm, so even though our room was poolside, the noise did not interfere with sleeping.  We did at times experience noise from the hallway, however, and I would recommend ear plugs if you're a light sleeper.The Westgate monorail stop is about a 3-5 minute walk away.  I never felt unsafe.  There's no casino, so there's no smoky smell.  We took advantage of the Mary Kay pampering session.  TeriLyn is a sweetheart, and she shared many interesting Vegas stories with us.  The session is no charge, with the option of purchasing the products used.  Very low pressure and relaxing.  The only available food is from a small shop next to the lobby.  It's a bit pricey.  There are restaurants next door at the Westgate, and a McDonald's is about 2 blocks north.  Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Hilton Vacation Suites Las Vegas (on Paradise Road)
reviews.text: Second time we have stayed at this place.  Very happy as with the last time.  I really like the fact that there is no casino and it is non-smoking.  Very easy to get to the Strip via monorail or Uber/Lyft.

reviews.title: Fantastic spot
reviews.text: We are a family of 6 on the trip of a lifetime and spent our 1st week here. It was more than we could have hoped for. The room was spotless and clean and had enough space for a family with 4 pre teen and teen boys. Staff were attentive and knowledgeable. You just had to think it and it was done. Really could not recommend a better spot

reviews.title: What a team:)
reviews.text: I had a great stay from start to finish. The team at this resort was great. They also have the cleanest and nicest rooms for the price would rebook in a minute. Service in the shop was also very good. Thanks

reviews.title: For those who want a little quite while in Vegas
reviews.text: You are located two blocks from the strip and on the north side, so it is a walk to walk the whole strip. The great part is it is relaxing and quite. Parking is very easy compared to the casino hotels. If you want to enjoy a little peace and quite sometime during your stay, this is the place.

reviews.title: Great Accommodations
reviews.text: We were very satisfied with this hotel.  Convenient location, quiet, and great service.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  They were very knowledgeable about the area which was helpful for us as we were new to the area.

reviews.title: Love the Hilton properties
reviews.text: We own Hilton and love to stay when we travel. Wether it's business or personal it's always great! We own at the Elara in Vegas but the point system allows us to convert timeshare points to honors points! It's amazing!

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: We liked this Hotel, space was nice for a family of 4, friendly staff. Only issue was pool closing for some construction without a heads up, but they provided a solution, so overall good stay and would recommend this place.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The hotel was very clean and the staff was very helpful. My only complaint would be that there was no breakfast but it would be hard with a hotel that size. And they require extra charges be put on your room and I would have rather paid in cash. But other than that it was perfect. Free covered parking and a lifeguard at the huge pool with pool toys provided. Perfect place for families.

reviews.title: Great Off Strip Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is great if you need to be close to the convention center or if you prefer to stay in a non casino hotel.  It is a walk to the strip, in the heat it is not really an option.  Getting to the strip is an easy monorail ride from the Westgate or SLS, or cheap Uber ride, around $5.  The Westgate hotel/casino is only a 5 minute walk and the SLS is a quick 10 minute walk.  The pool at the Hilton was great, family friendly but has a bar nearby for adults. The bar had a happy hour daily from 4-6pm with $2 off all drinks.We had a one bedroom suite with a whirlpool tub, full kitchen and washer and dryer.  The suite was large, bigger than some one bedroom apartments.  The linens were nice quality and the bed was comfortable.I have no complaints and would return, all of staff were wonderful too.

reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was fantastic.  When we arrived check in was seamless, quick and efficient and my request for quiet room on a low floor were met without any issue.  Rooms were very spacious with large flat screen TV and kitchenettes were well stocked with Washing up liquid and utensils etc.  Large fridge and microwave.  Beds large and very comfortable.  Bathroom well stocked with complimentary toiletries and towels.  Our two bedroom adjoining units had washing machine and tumble drier.  Washing powder available from reception.  Everyone including cleaning staff, concierge and reception staff could not have been more helpful.  Really close to monorail too. Such a comfortable stay and memorable experience.

reviews.title: Quiet Hotel Off-But-Near-the-Strip
reviews.text: Stayed in a 2-bedroom suite for 4 nights during Memorial Day weekend. For larger parties, or for those who simply want the space, these 2-bedroom suites are nice. Three TVs; full kitchen with pots, pans, and utensils; dining table with living area; two pull out-sofas; dual heat thermostats; two microwaves, two sinks, and two refrigerators; whirlpool bath, shower, and standard shower/tub combo; and stackable washer and dryer. As a Hilton-Honors member, wifi was included at no additional fee. This off-the-strip, but relatively close to the strip, is a quiet gem. No casino, but located next to the Westgate Casino. Within a 10 minute walk to Circus Circus and then a little further walk to all the glory the LV strip has to offer. Free surface and garage parking. Plenty of amenities, but the only thing used during our stay was the business center, pool, and Starbucks/gift shop. Business Center - spacious, only two PCs but good internet speeds, printer. Pool - small, the first time used it was Thursday midway so it was nearly empty, the other weekend days packed and sunbathers it's advised to get there at least by 10 so that you can claim a spot. The Starbucks/gift shop - a gem. You need your hotel key to access the floors on the elevator. Now, I understand the security aspect of this elevator set-up; but, after the second day, it became annoying. Early check-in was greatly appreciated by the staff. That same evening when trying to use the stove, it was locked and could not figure out how to unlock it. Supposedly, after the cleaning cycle completes, the stove remains locked. Knew it was a simple fix, but could not figure it out. Maintenance was very responsive and had it resolved in 5-10 minutes. Other than that...No major issues or complaints! All in all, a pleasant stay!

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Great Hotel!!  Very family friendly-safe and quiet. A great place to 'come home to' after a busy day on the strip or sightseeing! Extremely friendly and helpful staff!!  Had 2 AAU girls basketball teams with us (14-17 age) and would stay again in a heartbeat.  Great pool table/game room location for a group to visit.  Clean facility, great business computer area and pool area was immaculate.  Everyone in our entire group was pleased and would return!!

reviews.title: Fantastic Week in Vegas
reviews.text: Every summer dance nationals are held at the big strip casino/hotels in Vegas. I wanted to be off the strip and to have a kitchen. This Hilton was perfect. Quiet, comfy, clean. Well appointed kitchen with dishwasher and washer/dryer. Only 7 minutes drive to Treasure Island. Or you can hop on the monorail next door at the Westgate (shares a parking structure) which takes you to Harrah's ($5 single ticket). Nice little game room, nice pool (although smoke from bar does blow that way) and gym. Free movie rentals too. Great grocery/convenience store with good pizza and snacks and friendly service. The only other negative was that the sofa bed may be ok for kids, but isn't comfortable at all for adults. Otherwise a fantastic week. Would definitely return.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, great location off the strip
reviews.text: This was our third stay - we returned because of the proximity to the LV Convention Center, the spacious room with kitchenette and cleanliness.  For Hilton Honors members there are unlimited movie rentals and free bottles of water each day.  We will return.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacations is just off the strip so is not so busy but is easily walkable to the monorail. The one bedroom suite was enormous and beautifully appointed. We were only there a night but longer would have been very easy with a full kitchen included. It was a nice change from the standard hotel rooms we usually stay in. A really good alternative.

reviews.title: Top notch!
reviews.text: We were very impressed with our 2 bedroom suite and would 100% stay here again. We are Hilton Honors members and got a great deal in these accommodations. A bit far off strip and no shuttle, so you will need your own car or take Uber or taxi, but it is so quiet and relaxing to be away from the casinos. Great pool and exercise facilities. A++ There is a resort fee,  but this is expected in Vegas.

reviews.title: Last minute
reviews.text: I booked this hotel last minute. It was a short ride from the airport. We check in and immediately had a problem. I booked thru TripAdvisor for 2 nights, called ahead and made sure our reservation was good. I had asked about any hidden charges or fees and was told no. The site had said the same. As we're getting checked in I'm told I have to pay a deposit for each night ($100.00/Per Night). They didn't care what information i had about the person who worked there, if I wanted to pay in cash, or I can have my card on file. Was told either way I would get my money back same day I checked out.The pool was a decent size not very big or deep but it did the job the buildings shadow covers the pool at certain hours and makes it The staff would vary as far friendliness. We never saw the same set of people each day we stayed. The people staying at the hotel are very rude, and nosey. They'll ask if you have a time share and how you got the room and stuff like that. The room was a good size, the bed was the best part.

reviews.title: Great Location for a Laid Back Vegas Trip
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 nights in June 2017. The suite had a bedroom, living room with a sofa- bed, full kitchen and a washer/dryer.  Bathroom had a double sink, shower and Jacuzzi tub. All very nice. The location is away from the strip, but the strip is easily accessible by using the monorail which is a few minutes walk away near the Westgate Casino and hotel. There is a small store in the hotel with a Starbucks and miscellaneous foods. If you are travelling with family and want to stay somewhere off the strip, this is a great location.

reviews.title: Relaxing!
reviews.text: This hotel is conveniently located near the monorail so getting to the strip is quick and easy. Because the hotel is off the strip you can get a nice room without the chaos the strip hotels have. Sleeping is great since the rowdy crowd is on the strip!!!

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: We spent a couple of days here and enjoyed our stay. It is an ideal place for you if you would like to avoid the noise of the Strip at the same time would like to be close to it. The room was very clean and I liked that it has a little kitchen and a relatively spacious bathroom.

reviews.title: Very Uneven Stay
reviews.text: We were in Vegas for a conference and stayed at this property.  As a business traveler, I expected much more, but I now understand at time share properties, your Hilton benefits don't mean anything.  Let's start with the bad.  I could not understand why the radio was on in the room until the next am, when I could hear every single word of a phone conversation from the room next door.  The walls are like tissue paper - so just hope no one is next door or you will hear everything down to you know what....Then there is the $50 daily fee - the little card does not adequately explain the real cost of this as it is simply a revenue generator for the property...does their internet really cost $50 a day?  No way...I was hassled at check-in as my company credit card did not scan properly - the front desk clerk would neither hand key the number in or look me up in the Hilton system - in the end, she called security and I called Hilton corporate.  At the end of it, this pathetic employee should be completely retrained - and the clueless associate who stood there watching - think Dr. Dao of the United Aiirlines fiasco.I was able to meet with the resort director who was cordial and offered all kinds of future freebies with no value.  I would have taken a room reduction or points but that was not offered.My shower was also not operable and it took 3 calls for the maintenance guy to show up - while he fixed it, I almost missed my flight.Overall, I would never come back and recommend you do the same.  It is not worse the hassle-- stick with corporate owned business hotels that acknowledge your points...as here you are treated as a second class guest!p.s.  There are no slot machines which is a plus...

reviews.title: Survey regarding Hilton Grand Vacations
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay since I am not a fan of the Las Vegas Blvd. It was comfortable, clean and wonderful parking area. The staff was friendly and helpful. The price accommodated my budget. Also enjoyed the fitness center and the swimming pool. I would recommend this place to a friend and co-workers.

reviews.title: It's OK
reviews.text: We own timeshares. This is a timeshare property. Nice, friendly staff. The room was clean. The bed was HORRIBLE! Definitely time for them to replace it.There are no restaurants on the property, but several located within a few minutes walk or drive. We used the monorail to go to the strip and drove everywhere else. Probably won't stay here again.

reviews.title: Short Stay
reviews.text: Short stay for my family and I.  requested and received high floor, away from pool & near end of hallway.  Accommodations were extremely pleasant and comfortable.  Had an issue with TV in master Bedroom and Garbage disposal; both repaired / replaced immediately.  Job well done by the maintenance team and resort staff.

reviews.title: ...always enjoy a weekend stay at HPVC
reviews.text: This has become our "go to" while in Las Vegas. Great location, easy access to the strip, downtown, and Cashman Field make HPVC the perfect hotel for our Vegas weekends. We love the easy access to the Monorail from the Westgate next door.

reviews.title: Staff were helpful but room needs maintenance
reviews.text: Staff were helpful to change room for us upon our check-in due to the next room was very noisy partying. Room needed some maintenance as our bath tub was clogged and the fridge was very noisy that I had to request Housekeeping to swap another fridge for us.

reviews.title: Great staff and very comfortable stay
reviews.text: The staff was excellent and my stay was comfortable.  Clean accommodations and enjoyed the kitchenette which had a mini refridgerator, microwave, dishes and a sink.  I was able to get a pizza from the deli downstairs and eat it for a couple of meals.

reviews.title: Great Family Hotel for us
reviews.text: We stayed here for a number of days with our 4- and 1-year olds. It was a mostly quiet hotel. We could hear the guest in the room next to us through the adjoining door, but they were pretty quiet people. Our kids slept pretty well here thanks to the sofa pull-out bed in the living room, black-out curtains, and a pretty quiet hotel. (We did have a white noise machine for them.) One night, we all woke up around 3:30 a.m. because another guest somewhere was smoking and it was a really strong smell. I should have called the front desk right away so they could send security to investigate as it's a no-smoking hotel. My biggest complaint would be that with the way the master bedroom is situated with the big jetted tub in the room instead of a separate bathroom, it was really loud when the upstairs guest would fill up their tub and they used it every night. Other than that, a good pool, super friendly staff, great location off of the strip and close to the convention center, free parking, and great price for us.
